Bava Metzia 107b:4-11: Rabbi chanina amar: zo tzinna, deamar rabbi chanina: hakkol bide shamayim, chutz mitztzinnim pachim. shenneemar: "tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem".
Rabbi yose bar chanina amar: zo tzoa. deamar mar: tzoat hachotem, vetzoat haozen – rubban kashe, umiutan yafe.

Rabbi elazar amar: zo mara. tanya name hachi: "machala" – zo mara, velamma nikra shemah "machala" – shehi machala kol gufo shel adam. davar acher: "machala", sheshshemonim ushelosha cholaim teluyin bammara. vechullan, pat shacharit bemelach vekiton shel mayim mevattaltan.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha asar devarim neemru befat shacharit: matztzelet min hachamma, umin hatztzinna, umin hazzikin, umin hammazzikin, umachkimat peti, vezoche baddin, lilmod tora ulelammed, udevarav nishmain, vetalmudo mitkayyem beyado,
Veen besaro maale hevel, venizkak leishto, veeno mitavve leishsha acheret, vehoreget kinna shebbivne meayim. veyesh omrim: af motzia[5] et hakkina umachnese[400] et haahava.

Amar leh rabba lerava bar mari: mena ha milleta deamri inashe: shittin rahoyte rehut vela meto legavra demitztzafra kerach. vaamaru rabbanan: hashekem veechol, bekayitz mippene hachamma uvachoref mippene hatztzinna.
Amar leh, dichtiv: "lo yiravu velo yitzmau velo yakkem sharav vashamesh", lo yakkem sharav vashamesh – kevan dela yiravu velo yitzmau.

Amar leh: at amrat li mehatam, vaana amena lach mehacha: "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem uverach et lachmecha veet memecha". "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem" – zo keriat shema utefilla. "uverach et lachmecha veet memecha" – zo pat bammelach vekiton shel mayim, mikkan veelach: "vahasiroti machala mikkirbecha".
Berakhot 12a:23-12b:5: Amar rabba bar chinnana sava mishshemeh derav: kol shello amar "emet veyatztziv" shacharit, veemet veemuna" arvit — lo yatza yede chovato, shenneemar: "lehaggid babboker chasdecha veemunatcha ballelot".
Veamar rabba bar chinnana [sava] mishshemeh derav: hammitpallel, keshehu korea korea bevaruch, ucheshehu zokef — zokef bashshem
Amar shemuel: may tama derav — dichtiv: "Adonai zokef kefufim".
Amar leh shemuel lechiyyay bar rav: bar oryan, ta veema lecha milleta meallayyta deamar avuch. hachi amar avuch: keshehu korea — korea bevaruch", keshehu zokef — zokef bashshem.
Rav sheshet, ki kara — kara kechizra. ki ka zakef — zakef kechivya.

Veamar rabba bar chinnana sava mishshemeh derav kol hashshana kullah adam mitpallel "hael hakkadosh", "melech ohev tzedaka umishpat", chutz measara yamim shebben rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, shemmitpallel "hammelech hakkadosh", vehammelech hammishpat".

Verabbi elazar amar afillu amar "hael hakkadosh" — yatza. shenneemar: "vayyigba Adonai tzevaot bammishpat vehael hakkadosh nikdash bitzdaka". ematay "vayyigba Adonai tzevaot bammishpat" — ellu asara yamim shemmerosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim, vekaamar "hael hakkadosh".
Amar rav yosef: "hael hakkadosh" umelech ohev tzedaka umishpat". rabba amar: "hammelech hakkadosh" vehammelech hammishpat". vehilcheta kerabba.
Ezekiel 43:10-15: Atta ven-adam hagged et-bet-yisrael et-habbayit veyikkalmu meavonotehem umaddu et-tochnit

Veim-nichlemu mikkol asher-asu tzurat habbayit utechunato umotzaav umovaav vecholtzurotav veet kol-chukkotav vecholtzurotav vecholtorotav hoda otam uchetov leenehem veyishmeru et-kol-tzurato veet-kol-chukkotav veasu otam
Zot torat habbayit al-rosh hahar kol-gevulo saviv <small>׀</small> saviv kodesh kodashim hinne-zot torat habbayit
Veelle middot hammizbeach baammot amma amma vatofach vechek haamma veamma-rochav ugevulah el-sefatah saviv zeret haechad veze gav hammizbeach
Umechek haaretz ad-haazara hattachtona shetayim ammot verochav amma echat umehaazara hakketanna ad-haazara haggedola arba ammot verochav haamma
Vehaharel arba ammot (umehaariel) [umehaariel] ulemala hakkeranot arba
Ezekiel 43:16-19: (Vaheareayl) [vehaariel] shetem esre orech bishtem esre rochav ravua el arbaat revaav
Vehaazara arba esre orech bearba esre rochav el arbaat revaeha vehaggevul saviv otah chatzi haamma vehachek-lah amma saviv umaalotehu penot kadim
Vayyomer elay ben-adam ko amar adonay Adonai elle chukkot hammizbeach beyom heasoto lehaalot alav ola velizrok alav dam
Venatatta el-hakkohanim haleviyyim asher hem mizzera tzadok hakkerovim elay neum adonay Adonai lesharteni par ben-bakar lechattat
Ezekiel 43:20-24: Velakachta middamo venatatta al-arba karnotav veel-arba pinnot haazara veel-haggevul saviv vechitteta oto vechippartahu
Velakachta et happar hachattat userafo bemifkad habbayit michutz lammikdash
Uvayyom hashsheni takriv seir-izzim tamim lechattat vechitteu et-hammizbeach kaasher chitteu bappar
Bechallotcha mechatte takriv par ben-bakar tamim veayil min-hatztzon tamim
Vehikravtam lifne Adonai vehishlichu hakkohanim alehem melach veheelu otam ola laAdonai
Ezekiel 43:25-44:3: Shivat yamim taase seir-chattat layyom ufar ben-bakar veayil min-hatztzon temimim yaasu
Shivat yamim yechapperu et-hammizbeach vetiharu oto umilu yadav

Vayyashev oti derech shaar hammikdash hachitzon happone kadim vehu sagur

Et-hannasi nasi hu yeshev-bo (leechol) [leechol]lechem lifne Adonai midderech ulam hashshaar yavo umiddarko yetze
Ezekiel 44:4-8: Vayvieni derech-shaar hatztzafon el-pene habbayit vaere vehinne male chevod-Adonai et-bet Adonai vaeppol el-panay

Vayyomer elay Adonai ben-adam sim libbecha uree veenecha uveoznecha shema et kol-asher ani medabber otach lechol-chukkot bet-Adonai ulecholtorotav vesamta libbecha limvo habbayit bechol motzae hammikdash
Veamarta el-meri el-bet yisrael ko amar adonay Adonai rav-lachem mikkol-toavotechem bet yisrael
Bahaviachem bene-nechar arle-lev vearle vasar lihyot bemikdashi lechallelo et-beti behakerivchem et-lachmi chelev vadam vayyaferu et-beriti el kol-toavotechem
Velo shemartem mishmeret kodashay vattesimun leshomre mishmarti bemikdashi lachem {s}
Ketubot 50a:2-14: Amar rabbi ila, beusha hitkinu: hamevazbez — al yevazbez yoter mechomesh. tanya name hachi: hamevazbez — al yevazbez yoter mechomesh, shemma yitztarech labberiyyot. umaase beechad shebbikkesh levazbez [yoter mechomesh], velo hinniach lo chavero. umannu — rabbi yeshevav. veamri la: rabbi yeshevav, velo hinnicho chavero, umannu — rabbi akiva.
Amar rav nachman, veittema rav acha bar yaakov, may kera: "vechol asher titten li asser aasserennu lach".
Veha la dame issura batra leissura kamma! amar rav ashe: "aasserennu" levatra ki kamma.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: ushemuot hallalu mitmaatot veholchot. vesimanaych: ketannim katvu uvizbezu.

Amar rav yitzchak, beusha hitkinu sheyyehe adam mitgalgel im beno, ad shetem esre shana. mikkan veelach, yored immo lechayyav. ini?! veha amar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat: betzir mibbar shet — la tekabbel. bar shet — kabbel usefi leh ketora!
In, safe leh ketora, mihu eno yored immo lechayyav ad leachar shetem esre shana. veibbaet ema, la kashya: ha lemikra, ha lemishna.
Deamar abbaye, amara li em: bar shet — lemikra, bar eser — lemishna, bar telesar — letaanita meet leet. uvetinoket — bat teresar.

Amar abbaye, amara li em: hay bar shet detarka leh akrabba beyoma demishlam shet — la chaye. may asuteh — merarta dedayya chivvarta beshichra, nishpeyeh venashkeyeh. hay bar shatta detarek leh zibbura beyoma demishlam shatta — la chaye. may asuteh — atzvata dedikla bemayya, nishpeyeh venashkeyeh.

Amar rav kattina: kol hammachnis et beno pachut mibben shesh — ratz acharav veeno maggio. ikka deamri: chaverav ratzin acharav veen maggiin oto. vetarvayyhu itanhu: chalish ugemir. ibbaet ema: ha dichchish, ha devari.

Amar rabbi yose bar chanina, beusha hitkinu: haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah umeta, habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot. ashkecheh rav yitzchak bar yosef lerabbi avahu dahava kae beuchelusa deusha, amar leh: man mara dishmata deusha? amar leh: rabbi yose bar chanina. tena minneh arbein zimnin, vedame leh keman demannecha leh bechisteh.

"Ashre shomre mishpat ose tzedaka vechol et". vechi efshar laasot tzedaka bechol et? darshu rabbotenu shebbeyavne, veamri la rabbi eliezer: ze hazzan banav uvenotav keshehen ketannim. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ze hamegaddel yatom vitoma betoch beto umassian.
"Hon vaosher beveto vetzidkato omedet laad". rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: ze hallomed tora umelammedah. vechad amar: ze hakkotev tora neviim uchetuvim umashilan laacherim.

"Uree vanim levanecha shalom al yisrael". amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kevan shevanim levanecha" — "shalom al yisrael". dela ate lide chalitza veyibbum. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: kevan shevanim levanecha" — shalom al dayyayne yisrael, dela ate leinnetzoye.
Menachot 68a:13-68b:10: Gemara rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym – omer mattir, bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym – heir mizrach mattir.
May tama? tere kerae ketivi: ketiv "ad yom haviachem", uchetiv "ad etzem hayyom hazze". ha ketzad?
Kan – bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kan – bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym.
Rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: afillu bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, heir mizrach mattir. vehachtiv: "ad haviachem"! lemitzva.
Mishshekkarav haomer, huttar chadash miyyad! lemitzva.
Haomer haya mattir bammedina, ushete hallechem bammikdash! lemitzva.

Mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom henef kullo asur. may tama? mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, veyomru: eshtakad mi lo achalnu beheir mizrach? hasheta name nechol!
Vela yadi, deeshtakad la hava omer, heir mizrach mattir, vehasheta deikka omer – omer mattir. vei salka datach lemitzva, mishshum mitzva lekum veligzor?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: rabban yochanan ben zakkay beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah, deamar: min hattora asur, shenneemar: "ad etzem hayyom hazze" –
Ad itztzumo shel yom, vekasavar "ad" vead bakkelal.

Umi savar la kevavteh? veha miflag pelig aleh! ditnan: mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom henef kullo asur. amar rabbi yehuda: vahalo min hattora hu asur, dichtiv "ad etzem hayyom hazze"!
Rabbi yehuda hu deka tae, hu savar rabban yochanan ben zakkay midderabbanan kaamar, vela hi, middeorayyta kaamar. veha "hitkin" katane? may "hitkin"? darash vehitkin.
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua achli chadash beureta deshittesar naghe shivsar, kasavri: chadash bechutza laaretz derabbanan, velisfeka la chayyshinan.
Verabbanan deve rav ashe achli betzafra deshivsar, kasavri: chadash bechutza laaretz deorayyta.
Verabban yochanan ben zakkay midderabbanan kaamar, vechi takken leyom henef – lisfeka la takken.
Amar ravina: amra li em – avuch la hava achel chadash ella beureta deshivsar naghe temanesar, desavar la kerabbi yehuda, vechayesh lisfeka.
Mishnah Kelim 13:4-7:
Magrefa shennittela chappah, temea mippene shehi chekurnas, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim metaharin. megera shennittelu shinneha achat mibbentayim, tehora. nishtayyer bah melo hassit bemakom echad, temea. hammaatzad vehaizmel vehammafselet vehammakdeach, shennifgemu, temeim. nittal chissuman, tehorin. vechullan shennechleku lishnayim, temeim, chutz min hammakdeach. veharukeni vifne atzmah, tehora: 
Machat shennittal charirah o uktzah, tehora. im hitkinah lemittuach, temea. shel sakkayin shennittal charirah, temea, mippene shehu chotev bah. nittal uktzah, tehora. shel mittuach, ben kach uven kach temea. machat sheheelta chaludda, im meakkevet et hattefira, tehora. veim lav, temea. tzinnora sheppeshatah, tehora. kefafah, chazra letumatah: 
Etz hameshammesh et hammattechet, tame. vehammattechet hameshammesh et haetz, tehora. ketzad, potachat shel etz vehappin shellah shel mattechet, afillu achat, temea. potachat shel mattechet vehappin shellah shel etz, tehora. tabbaat shel mattechet vechotam shellah shel almog, temea. tabbaat shel almog vechotam shellah shel mattechet, tehora. hashshen shebbattas, shebbappotachat, veshebbammafteach, temea bifne atzmah: 
Hakkaddumin haashkelonin shennishberu vehaunkeli shellahen kayyemet, hare ellu temein. hammaber, vehammazre, vehammaggov, vechen masrek shel rosh shennittela achat mishshinnehen, vaasaan shel mattechet, hare ellu temein. veal kullan amar rabbi yehoshua, devar chiddush chiddeshu sofrim, veen li ma ashiv:
Mishnah Kelim 13:8-14:3:
Masrek shel pishtan shennittelu shinnav venishtayyer bo shetayim, tame. veachat, tahor. vechullan, achat achat bifne atzman, temeot. veshel tzemer shennittelu shinnav achat mibbentayim, tahor. nishtayyer bo shalosh bemakom echad, tame. hayta hachitzona achat mehen, tahor. nittelu mimmennu shetayim vaasaan lemalketet, temeot. achat vehitkinah lener o lemittuach, temea: 
Kele mattachot, kamma hu shiuran. haddeli, kede lemallot bo. kumkum, kede lechem bo. mecham, kede lekabbel selaim. hallefes, kede lekabbel kitonot. kitonot, kede lekabbel perutot. middot yayin, beyayin. umiddot shemen, beshamen. rabbi eliezer omer, kullan bifrutot. rabbi akiva omer, hamechussar chatifa, tame. vehamechussar letisha, tahor: 
Makkel sheasa verosho masmer kemin chazyana, tame. simmero, tame. rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyaase vo shelosha sedarim. vechullan sheasaan lenoy, tehorin. asa verosho menikat, vechen baddelet, tehora. hayta cheli vechibberah lo, temea. meematay hi tohoratah, bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyechabbel. bet hillel omrim, mishsheyyechabber: 
Hakkantar shel bannay, vehaddakor shel charash, hare ellu temein. yitdot ohalim veyitdot hammashochot, temeot. shalshelet shel mashochot, temea. haasuya laetzim, tehora. shalshelet deli gadol, arbaa tefachim. veshel katan, asara. chamor shel nappachin, tame. megera sheasa shinneha vetoch hachor, temea. asaah millemattan lemalan, tehora. vechol hakkesuyin tehorim, chutz mishshel mecham:
Mishnah Kelim 14:4-8:
Hattemein shebbaagala, haol shel mattechet, vehakkatrav, vehakkenafayim hamekabbelot et hartzuot, vehabbarzel shettachat tzavvere vehema, hassomech, vehammachger, vehattamchuyot, hainbal, vehatztzinnora, umasmer hamechabber et kullan: 
Hattehorin shebbaagala, haol hametzuppe, kenafayim haasuyot lenoy, ushefofarot hammashmiot et hakkol, vehaavar shebbetzad tzavvere vehema, hassovev shel galgal, hattassim, vehatztzippuyim, ushear kol hammasmerot, tehorin. sandele vehema shel mattachot, temein. shel shaam, tehorin. hassayif meematay mekabbel tuma, mishsheyyeshufennu. vehassakkin, mishsheyashchizenna: 
Kesuy teni shel mattechet sheasa vo mara, rabbi yehuda metaher, vachachamim metammein. mara shennishbera, im enah mara et rov happanim, tehora: 
Kele mattachot mittammein umittaharin shevurin, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, enan mittaharin ella shelemin. ketzad, hizza alehen, nishberu vo vayyom, hittichan vechazar vehizza alehen shenit bo vayyom, hare ellu tehorin, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, en hazzaya pachot mishshelishi ushevii: 
Mafteach shel arkubba shennishbar mittoch arkubbato, tahor, rabbi yehuda metamme, mippene shehu foteach bo mibbifnim. veshel gam shennishbar mittoch gummo, tahor. hayu vo chafin unekavin, tame. nittelu chafin, tame mippene nekavin. nistattemu nekavin, tame mippene chafin. nittelu chafin venistattemu nekavin, o sheppartzu ze letoch ze, tahor. mesannenet shel chardal shennifretzu vah shelosha nekavim millemattan ze letoch ze, tehora. vehaafarkes shel mattachot, temea:
Mishnah Kelim 15:1-4:
Kele etz, kele or, kele etzem, kele zechuchit, peshutehen tehorin, umekabbelehen temeim. nishberu, taharu. chazar veasa mehen kelim, mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba. hashshidda, vehatteva, vehammigdal, kavveret hakkash, vechavveret hakkanim, uvor sefina alekkesanderit, sheyyesh lahem shulayim, vehen machazikin arbaim sea velach, shehem korayim beyavesh, hare ellu tehorin. ushear kol hakkelim, ben mekabbelin, ben enam mekabbelin, temein, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, dardur agala, vekustot hammelachim, vaarevat haabbedanin, uvor sefina ketanna, vehaaron, af al pi shemmekabbelin, temein, sheenan asuyin littaltel ella vema shebbetochan. ushear kol hakkelim, hammekabbelim, tehorin, vesheenan mekabbelin, temein. en ben divre rabbi meir ledivre rabbi yehuda ella arevat baal habbayit: 
Aruvot shel nachtomim, temeot. veshel baale vattim, tehorot. serkan o chirkeman, temeot. daf shel nachtomin shekkevao vakkotel, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammeim. serod shel nachtomin, tame. veshel baale vattim, tahor. gippefo mearba ruchotav, tame. nifratz meruach achat, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, im hitkino lihyot koretz alav, tame. vechen hammaaroch, tame: 
Yam nafa shel sillatin, tame. veshel baale vattim, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, af shel godelet tame moshav, mippene shehabbanot yoshvot betocho vegodlot: 
Kol hatteloyim, temein, chutz mitteloy nafa uchevara shel baal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kullan tehorin, chutz mitteloy nafa shel sillatin, uteloy kivrat geranot, uteloy maggal yad, uteloy makkel habballashin, mippene shehen mesayyein bishat hammelacha. ze hakkelal, heasuy lesayyea bishat melacha, tame. heasuy litloy, tahor:
Mishnah Kelim 15:5-16:2:
Rachat shel garosot, temea. shel otzarot, tehora. shel gittot, temea. shel geranot, tehora. ze hakkelal, heasuy lekabbala, tame. lechinnus, tahor: 
Nivle hashshara, temein. venivle vene levi, tehorin. kol hammashkin, temein. umashke vet matbechayya, tehorin. kol hassefarim metammein et hayyadayim, chutz missefer haazara. hammarkof, tahor. habbatnon, vehanniktemon, vehaerus, hare ellu temeim. rabbi yehuda omer, haerus tame moshav, mippene shehaallayit yoshevet alav. metzuddat hachulda, temea. veshel haachbarin, tehora: 
Kol keli etz shennechelak lishnayim, tahor, chutz mishshulchan hakkaful, vetamchuy hammiznon, vehaefiforin shel baale habbayit. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammages, vekod habbavli kayyotze vahen. kele etz, meematay mekabbelin tuma. hammitta vehaarisa, mishsheyyeshufem beor haddag. gamar shello lashuf, temea. rabbi meir omer, hammitta, mishsheyyesareg bah shelosha vattim: 
Hassallim shel etz, mishsheyyachsom vikannev. veshel temara, af al pi shello kinnev mibbifnim, tame, shekken mekayyemin. kalkala, mishsheyyachsom vikannev veyigmor et hatteloya. bet halleginin, uvet hakkosot, af al pi shello kinnev mibbifnim, tame, shekken mekayyemin:
Mishnah Kelim 16:3-7:
Hakkenonin hakketannim, vehakkelatot, mishsheyyachsom vikannev. hakkenonim haggedolim, vehassugin haggedolim, mishsheyyaase shene durim larochav shellahem. yam nafa, uchevara, vechaf shel moznayim, mishsheyyaase dur echad larochav shellahen. hakkuppa, mishsheyyaase shete tzefirot larochav shellah. vehearak, mishsheyyaase vo tzefira echat: 
Kele or, meematay mekabbelin tuma. hatturemel, mishsheyyachsom vikannev veyaase kichotav. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyaase et aznav. sekorteya, mishsheyyachsom vikannev veyaase et tzitzatah. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyaase et tabbeoteha. katavolya, mishsheyyachsom vikannev. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyaase et kichoteha. hakkar vehakkeset shel or, mishsheyyachsom vikannev. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyitperem vishayyer bahem pachot mechamishsha tefachim: 
Patilya, temea. vachasina, tehora. signiyyot shel alin, tehorot. shel netzarin, temeot. chotal shehu noten letocho venotel mittocho, tame. veim eno yachol ad sheyyikraennu o ad sheyyattirennu, tahor: 
Kesaya shel zore geranot, shel holche derachim, shel ose fishtan, temea. aval shel tzabbain veshel nappachin, tehora. rabbi yose omer, af shel garosot kayyotze vahen. ze hakkelal, heasuy lekabbala, tame. mippene hazzea, tahor: 
Hammalkot shel bakar, vehechasim shello, vehammaddaf shel devorim, vehammenafa, hare ellu tehorin. kesuy shel kufsa, tame. kesuy kamtera, tahor. kesuy teva, kesuy teni, vehammachbesh shel charash, vehakkeset shettachat hatteva, vehakkimron shellah, veangelin shel sefer, bet hanneger, bet hammanul, uvet hammezuza, vetik nevalin, vetik kinnoret, vehaemum shel godle mitznafot, vehammarkof shel zammar, ureviit shel allayit, ugenognit heani, vesamochot hammitta, utefus shel tefilla, veemum shel ose sutot, hare ellu tehorim. ze hakkelal, amar rabbi yose, kol meshammeshe meshammeshav shel adam bishat melacha veshello vishat melacha, tame. vechol sheeno ella vishat melacha, tahor:
Mishnah Kiddushin 3:11-4:1:
Kiddashti et bittech, vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella oti, hu asur bikrovot ketanna, uketanna mutteret bikrovav, hu muttar bikrovot gedola, ugedola asura vikrovav: 
Kol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veen avera, havvalad holech achar hazzachar. veeze, zo chohenet, leviyya veyisreelit shennisseu lechohen ulelevi uleyisrael. vechol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veyesh avera, havvalad holech achar happagum. veezo, zo almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin. vechol mi sheen lah alav kiddushin aval yesh lah al acherim kiddushin, havvalad mamzer. veeze, ze habba al achat mikkol haarayot shebbattora. vechol mi sheen lah lo alav velo al acherim kiddushin, havvalad kemotah. veeze, ze velad shifcha venachrit: 
Rabbi tarfon omer, yecholin mamzerim littaher. ketzad. mamzer shennasa shifcha, havvalad eved. shichrero, nimtza habben ben chorin. rabbi eliezer omer, hare ze eved mamzer: 
Asara yochasin alu mibbavel, kahane, leviyye, yisreele, chalale, gere, vacharure, mamzere, netine, shetuke, vaasufe. kahane, leviyye veyisreele, muttarim lavo ze vaze. leviyye, yisreele, chalale, gere vacharure, muttarim lavo ze vaze. gere vacharure, mamzere unetine shetuke vaasufe, kullam muttarin lavo ze vaze:
Mishnah Kiddushin 3:2-6:
Haomer leishsha, hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheetten lach matayim zuz, hare zo mekuddeshet vehu yitten. al menat sheetten lach mikkan vead sheloshim yom, natan lah betoch sheloshim, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. al menat sheyyesh li matayim zuz, hare zo mekuddeshet veyesh lo. al menat shearech matayim zuz, hare zo mekuddeshet veyare lah. veim herah al hashshulchan, enah mekuddeshet: 
Al menat sheyyesh li vet kor afar, hare zo mekuddeshet veyesh lo. al menat sheyyesh li vemakom peloni, im yesh lo veoto makom, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. al menat shearech bet kor afar, hare zo mekuddeshet veyarenna. veim herah babbika, enah mekuddeshet: 
Rabbi meir omer, kol tenay sheeno chitnay bene gad uvene reuven, eno tenay, shenneemar (Bamidbar 32), vayyomer moshe alehem im yaavru vene gad uvene reuven, uchetiv, veim lo yaavru chalutzim. rabbi chanina ven gamliel omer, tzarich haya haddavar leamro, sheilmale chen, yesh bemashma sheafillu veeretz kenaan lo yinchalu: 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha veamar, kesavur hayiti shehi chohenet vahare hi leviyya, leviyya vahare hi chohenet, aniyya vahare hi ashira, ashira vahare hi aniyya, hare zo mekuddeshet, mippene shello hitattu. haomer leishsha, hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer o leachar shettitgayyeri, leachar sheeshtachrer o leachar shettishtachreri, leachar sheyyamut baalech o leachar shettamut achotech, leachar sheyyachalotz lach yevamech, enah mekuddeshet. vechen haomer lachavero, im yalda ishtecha nekeva hare hi mekuddeshet li, enah mekuddeshet. im hayta eshet chavero meubberet vehukkar ubbarah, devarav kayyamin, veim yalda nekeva, mekuddeshet: 
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheadabber alayich lashshilton veeese immach kefoel, dibber aleha lashshilton veasa immah kefoel, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. al menat sheyyirtze abba, ratza haav, mekuddeshet. veim lav ena mekuddeshet. met haav, hare zo mekuddeshet. met habben, melammedin haav lomar sheeno rotze:
Mishnah Kiddushin 3:7-10:
Kiddashti et bitti veeni yodea lemi kiddashtiha, uva echad veamar ani kiddashtiha, neeman. ze amar ani kiddashtiha veze amar ani kiddashtiha, shenehem notnim get. veim ratzu, echad noten get veechad kones: 
Kiddashti et bitti, kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehi ketanna, vahare hi ketanna, neeman. kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehi ketanna, vahare hi gedola, eno neeman. nishbet ufeditiha, ben shehi ketanna ben shehi gedola, eno neeman. mi sheamar bishat mitato, yesh li vanim, neeman. yesh li achim, eno neeman. hamekaddesh et bitto setam, en habbogrot bichlal: 
Mi sheyyesh lo shete chitte vanot mishshete nashim, veamar kiddashti et bitti haggedola veeni yodea im gedola shebbaggedolot o gedola shebbakketannot, o ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedola shebbakketannot, kullan asurot, chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, kullan muttarot, chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot. kiddashti et bitti hakketanna veeni yodea im ketanna shebbakketannot o ketanna shebbaggedolot, o gedola shebbakketannot shehi ketanna min hakketannot shebbaggedolot, kullan asurot, chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, kullan muttarot, chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot: 
Haomer leishsha, kiddashtich, vehi omeret lo kiddashtani, hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav. hi omeret kiddashtani vehu omer lo kiddashtich, hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi asura vikrovav. kiddashtich, vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella vitti, hu asur bikrovot gedola, ugedola mutteret bikrovav. hu muttar bikrovot ketanna, uketanna mutteret bikrovav:
Mishnah Kiddushin 4:11-14:
Ishsha nasati bimdinat hayyam, hare hi zo veellu vaneha, mevi reaya al haishsha veen tzarich lehavi reaya al habbanim. meta, veellu vaneha, tzarich lehavi reaya al haishsha veal habbanim: 
Lo yityached adam im shete nashim, aval ishsha achat mityachedet im shene anashim. rabbi shimon omer, af ish echad mityached im shete nashim bizman sheishto immo veyashen immahem befundeki, mippene sheishto meshammarto. mityached adam im immo veim bitto, veyashen immahem bekeruv basar. veim higdilu, zo yeshena vichsutah veze yashen bichsuto: 
Lo yilmad adam ravvak sofrim, velo tilmad ishsha sofrim. rabbi eliezer omer, af mi sheen lo ishsha, lo yilmad sofrim: 
Rabbi yehuda omer, lo yire ravvak behema, velo yishnu shene ravvakim betallit echat. vachachamim mattirin. kol sheisko im hannashim, lo yityached im hannashim. velo yelammed adam et beno ummanut ben hannashim. rabbi meir omer, leolam yelammed adam et beno ummanut nekiyya vekalla, veyitpallel lemi shehaosher vehannechasim shello, sheen ummanut sheen bah aniyyut vaashirut, shello aniyyut min haummanut velo ashirut min haummanut, ella hakkol lefi zechuto. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, raita miyyamecha chayya vaof sheyyesh lahem ummanut, vehen mitparnesin shello vetzaar. vahalo lo nivreu ella leshammesheni, vaani nivreti leshammesh et koni, eno din sheetparnes shello vetzaar. ella shehareoti maasay vekippachti et parnasati. abba guryan ish tzadyan omer mishshum abba gurya, lo yelammed adam et beno, chammar, gammal, sappar, sappan, roe, vechenvani, sheummanutan ummanut listim. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo, hachammarin, rubban reshaim, vehaggammalin, rubban kesherim. hassappanin, rubban chasidim. tov shebbarofim, legehinnom. vehakkasher shebbattabbachim, shuttafo shel amalek. rabbi nehoray omer, manniach ani kol ummanut shebbaolam veeni melammed et beni ella tora, sheadam ochel missecharah baolam hazze vekeren kayyemet laolam habba. ushear kol ummanut enan ken. kesheadam ba lide choli o lide zikna o lide yissurin veeno yachol laasok bimlachto, hare hu met beraav. aval hattora enah ken, ella meshammarto mikkol ra benaaruto venotenet lo acharit vetikva veziknuto. benaaruto, ma hu omer, (yeshaya 40) vekove Adonai yachalifu choach. beziknuto, mahu omer, (tehillim tzav) od yenuvun beseva. vechen hu omer beavraham avinu alav hashshalom, (Bereshit kad) veavraham zaken, vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. matzinu sheasa avraham avinu et kol hattora kullah ad shello nittena, shenneemar, (sham 26) ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vayyishmor mishmarti mitzvotay chukkotay vetorotay:
Mishnah Kiddushin 4:2-6:
Veellu hem shetuke, kol shehu makkir et immo veeno makkir et aviv. asufe, kol shenneesaf min hashshuk veeno makkir lo aviv velo immo. abba shaul haya kore lishtuke, beduke: 
Kol haasurim lavo vakkahal, muttarim lavo ze vaze. rabbi yehuda oser. rabbi eliezer omer, vaddaan bevaddaan, muttar. vaddaan bisfekan, (usefekan bevaddaan), usefekan bisfekan, asur. veellu hen hassefekot, shetuki, asufi vechuti: 
Hannose ishsha chohenet tzarich livdok achareha arba immahot shehen shemone, immah veem immah, veem avi immah veimmah, veem aviha veimmah, veem avi aviha veimmah. leviyya veyisreelit, mosifin alehen od echat: 
En bodkin lo min hammizbeach ulemala, velo min hadduchan ulemala, velo min sanhedrin ulemala. vechol shehuchzeku avotav mishshotre harabbim vegabbae tzedaka, massiin lakkehunna veen tzarich livdok acharehen. rabbi yose omer, af mi shehaya chatum ed baarche hayeshana shel tzippori. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, af mi shehaya muchtav beisteratya shel melech: 
Bat chalal zachar, pesula min hakkehunna leolam. yisrael shennasa chalala, bitto cheshera lakkehunna. chalal shennasa vat yisrael, bitto fesula lakkehunna. rabbi yehuda omer, bat ger zachar kevat chalal zachar:
Mishnah Kiddushin 4:7-10:
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, yisrael shennasa giyyoret, bitto cheshera lakkehunna. veger shennasa vat yisrael, bitto cheshera lakkehunna. aval ger shennasa giyyoret, bitto fesula lakkehunna. echad ger veechad avadim meshuchrarim, afillu ad asara dorot, ad shettehe immo miyyisrael. rabbi yose omer, af ger shennasa giyyoret, bitto cheshera lakkehunna: 
Haomer, beni ze mamzer, eno neeman. vaafillu shenehem omrim al haubbar shebbemeeha mamzer hu, enam neemanim. rabbi yehuda omer, neemanim: 
Mi shennatan reshut lishlucho lekaddesh et bitto vehalach hu vekiddeshah, im shello kadmu, kiddushav kiddushin. veim shel shelucho kadmu, kiddushav kiddushin. veim eno yadua, shenehem notnim get. veim ratzu, echad noten get veechad kones. vechen haishsha shennatna reshut lishluchah lekaddeshah, vehalcha vekiddeshah et atzmah, im shellah kadmu, kiddusheha kiddushin. veim shel sheluchah kadmu, kiddushav kiddushin. veim eno yadua, shenehem notnin lah get. veim ratzu, echad noten lah get veechad kones: 
Mi sheyyatza hu veishto limdinat hayyam uva hu veishto uvanav veamar, ishsha sheyyatzat immi limdinat hayyam hare hi zo veellu vaneha, en tzarich lehavi reaya, lo al haishsha velo al habbanim. meta veellu vaneha, mevi reaya al habbanim veeno mevi reaya al haishsha:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 1:6-2:2:
Hallokeach behema, shogeg, yachzeru dameha limkoman. mezid, toole veteachel bammakom. veim en mikdash, tikkaver al yede orah: 
En lokchin avadim ushefachot vekarkaot uvehema temea middeme maaser sheni. veim lakach, yochal kenegdan. en meviin kinne zavim, vekinne zavot, vekinne yoldot, chattaot, vaashamot, middeme maaser sheni. veim hevi, yochal kenegdam. ze hakkelal, kol shehu chutz laachila velishtiyya ulesicha middeme maaser sheni, yochal kenegdo: 
Maaser sheni, nittan laachila velishtiyya ulesicha, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lasuch davar sheddarko lasuch. lo yasuch yayin vechometz, aval sach hu et hashshemen. en mefattemin shemen shel maaser sheni, veen lokchin bidme maaser sheni shemen mefuttam, aval mefattem hu et hayyayin. nafal letocho devash utevalin vehishbicho, hashshevach lefi cheshbon. dagim shennitbashshelu im hakkaflotot shel maaser sheni vehishbichu, hashshevach lefi cheshbon. issa shel maaser sheni sheafaah vehishbiach, hashshevach lashsheni. ze hakkelal, kol sheshshivcho nikkar, hashshevach lefi hacheshbon. vechol sheen shivcho nikkar, hashshevach lashsheni: 
Rabbi shimon omer, en sachin shemen shel maaser sheni birushalayim. vachachamim mattirin. amru lo lerabbi shimon, im hekel bitruma chamura, lo nakel bemaaser sheni hakkal. amar lahem, ma, lo, im hekel bitruma hachamura mekom shehekel becharshinim uvetiltan, nakel bemaaser sheni hakkal mekom shello hekel becharshinim uvetiltan:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:3-7:
Tiltan shel maaser sheni, teachel tzimchonim. veshel teruma, bet shammay omrim, kol maaseha betohora, chutz mechafifatah. uvet hillel omrim, kol maaseha vetuma, chutz mishsheriyyatah: 
Karshine maaser sheni, yeachlu tzimchonim, venichnasin lirushalayim veyotzin. nitmeu, rabbi tarfon omer, yitchalleku leissot, vachachamim omrim, yippadu. veshel teruma, bet shammay omrim, shorin veshafin betohora, umaachilin betuma. uvet hillel omrim, shorin betohora, veshafin umaachilin betuma. shammay omer, yeachlu tzarid. rabbi akiva omer, kol maasehen betuma: 
Meot chullin umeot maaser sheni shennitpazzeru, ma shellikket, likket lemaaser sheni, ad sheyyashlim, vehashshear chullin. im balal vechafan, lefi cheshbon. ze hakkelal, hammitlakketim, lemaaser sheni. vehannivlalim, lefi cheshbon: 
Sela shel maaser sheni veshel chullin shennitarvu, mevi vesela maot veomer, sela shel maaser sheni, bechol makom shehi, mechullelet al hammaot haellu, uvorer et hayyafa shebbah, umechallelan aleha, mippene sheamru, mechallelin kesef al nechoshet middochak, velo sheyyitkayyem ken, ella chozer umechallelam al hakkasef: 
Bet shammay omrim, lo yaase adam et selaav dinre zahav, uvet hillel mattirin. amar rabbi akiva, ani asiti lerabban gamliel ulerabbi yehoshua et kaspan dinre zahav:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:8-3:1:
Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni, bet shammay omrim, kol hassela maot. uvet hillel omrim, shekel kesef veshekel maot. rabbi meir omer, en mechallelin kesef uferot al hakkesef, vachachamim mattirim: 
Happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim, bet shammay omrim, kol hassela maot. uvet hillel omrim, shekel kesef veshekel maot. haddanin lifne chachamim omrim, bishlosha dinare kesef vedinar maot. rabbi akiva omer, shelosha dinarin kesef, ureviit maot. rabbi tarfon omer, arbaa aspere chesef. shammay omer, yannichenna vachanut veyochal kenegdah: 
Mi shehayu miktzat banav temein umiktzatan tehorim, manniach et hassela veomer, ma shehattehorim shotim, sela zo mechullelet alav. nimtzeu tehorim utemeim shotin mikkad echad: 
Lo yomar adam lachavero, haal et happerot haellu lirushalayim lechallek, ella omer lo, haalem shennochlem venishtem birushalayim. aval notnim ze laze mattenat chinnam:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 3:11-4:1:
Tzevi shellekacho bechesef maaser, vamet, yikkaver al yede oro. rabbi shimon omer, yippade. lekacho chay ushechato venitma, yippade. rabbi yose omer, yikkaver. lekacho shachut venitma, hare hu cheferot: 
Hammashil kankannin lemaaser sheni, af al pi sheggafan, lo kana maaser. zalaf letochan setam, ad shello gafan, lo kana maaser. mishsheggafan, kana maaser. ad shello gafan, olot beechad umea, umishsheggafan, mekaddeshot bechol shehen. ad shello gafan, torem meachat al hakkol, umishsheggafan, torem mikkol achat veechat: 
Bet shammay omrim, mefatteach umeare laggat. uvet hillel omrim, mefatteach veeno tzarich learot. bamme devarim amurim, bemakom sheddarkan limkor setumot. aval bemakom sheddarkan limkor petuchot, lo yatza kankan lechullin. aval im ratza lehachemir al atzmo limkor bemidda, yatza kankan lechullin. rabbi shimon omer, af haomer lachavero, chavit zo ani mocher lecha chutz mikkankannim, yatza kankan lechullin: 
Hammolich perot maaser sheni mimmekom hayyoker limkom hazzol, o mimmekom hazzol limkom hayyoker, podehu cheshaar mekomo. hammevi ferot min haggoren lair, vechadde yayin min haggat lair, hashshevach lashsheni vitziot mibbeto:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 3:2-5:
En lokchin teruma bechesef maaser sheni, mippene shehu memaet baachilato, verabbi shimon mattir. amar lahem rabbi shimon, ma im hekel bezivche shelamim, shehu mevian lide figgul venotar vetame, lo nakel batteruma. amru lo, ma im hekel bezivche shelamim, shehen muttarim lezarim, nakel batteruma, shehi asura lezarim: 
Mi shehayu lo maot birushalayim vetzarich lo, velachavero ferot, omer lachavero, hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perotecha. nimtza ze ochel perotav betohora, vehalla ose tzarko bimotav. velo yomar ken leam haaretz, ella vidmay: 
Perot birushalayim umaot bammedina, omer, hare hammaot hahem mechullalin al perot haellu. maot birushalayim uferot bammedina, omer hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perot hahem, uvilvad sheyyoolu happerot veyeachlu virushalayim: 
Maot nichnasot lirushalayim veyotzot, uferot nichnasin veenan yotzin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af happerot nichnasin veyotzin:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 3:6-10:
Perot shennigmera melachtan veavru vetoch yerushalayim, yachazor maaser sheni shellahen veyeachel birushalayim. veshello nigmera melachtan, salle anavim laggat vesalle teenim lammuktze, bet shammay omrim, yachazor maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel birushalayim. uvet hillel omrim, yippade veyeachel bechol makom. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose, lo nechleku vet shammay uvet hillel al perot shello nigmera melachtan, sheyyippade maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel bechol makom. veal ma nechleku, al perot shennigmera melachtan, shebbet shammay omrim, yachazor maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel birushalayim. uvet hillel omrim, yippade veyeachel bechol makom. vehaddemay, nichnas veyotze venifde: 
Ilan shehu omed bifnim venote lachutz, o omed bachutz venote lifnim, mikkeneged hachoma velifnim, kelifnim. mikkeneged hachoma velachutz, kelachutz. batte habbaddim sheppitchehen lifnim vachalalan lachutz, o sheppitchehen lachutz vachalalan lifnim, bet shammay omrim, hakkol kelifnim. uvet hillel omrim, mikkeneged hachoma velifnim, kelifnim. mikkeneged hachoma velachutz, kelachutz: 
Halleshachot, benuyot bakkodesh ufetuchot lachol, tochan chol vegaggotehen kodesh. benuyot bachol ufetuchot lakkodesh, tochan kodesh vegaggotehen chol. benuyot bakkodesh uvachol ufetuchot lakkodesh velachol, tochan vegaggotehen mikkeneged hakkodesh velakkodesh, kodesh, mikkeneged hachol velachol, chol: 
Maaser sheni shennichnas lirushalayim venitma, ben shennitma veav hattuma, ben shennitma bivlad hattuma, ben bifnim ben bachutz, bet shammay omrim, yippade veyeachel hakkol bifnim, chutz mishshennitma beav hattuma bachutz. uvet hillel omrim, hakkol yippade veyeachel bachutz, chutz mishshennitma bivlad hattuma bifnim: 
Hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma, yippade. rabbi yehuda omer, yikkaver. amru lo lerabbi yehuda, uma im maaser sheni atzmo shennitma, hare hu nifde, hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma, eno din sheyyippade. amar lahem, lo, im amartem bemaaser sheni atzmo, shekken hu nifde vetahor berichuk makom, tomru velakuach bechesef maaser, sheeno nifde vetahor berichuk makom:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3:11-12: Hayta tzoa beguma omed besandalo al hagguma vekore. vehu shello yihye sandalo nogea bah. hayta kenegdo tzoa meuta beyoter kemo tippa rokek aleha rok ave ad shettitkasse vekore. hayta netishat tzoa al besaro o yadav metunnafot mibbet hakkisse velo haya lahen reach ra kelal mippene katnan o yavshutan muttar likrot lefi sheen lahen reach ra. aval im hayta bimkomah af al pi sheenah niret keshehu omed hoil veniret keshehu yoshev asur likrot ad sheyyekanneach yafe yafe mippene shehatztzoa lacha hi veyesh lah reach ra. vechamma geonim horu sheasur lo likrot im hayu yadav metunnafot vechach rauy laasot:

Reach ra sheyyesh lo ikkar marchik 4 ammot vekore im pasak hareach. veim lo pasak hareach marchik ad makom sheppasak hareach. vesheen lo ikkar kegon mi sheyyatza mimmennu ruach millematta marchik ad makom shettichle hareach vekore. geraf shel rei vaavit shel meme raglayim asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan veaf al pi sheen bahen kelum veen lahem reach ra mippene shehem kevet hakkisse:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3:13-15: Tzoa overet kegon shehayta shata al pene hammayim asur likrot kenegdah. ufi chazir ketzoa overet dami veasur likrot kenegdo ad sheyyaavru mimmennu arba ammot:

Haya kore vehiggia limkom hattinnofet lo yanniach yado al piv veyikra ella yafsik ad sheyyaavor meoto makom. vechen hakkore sheyyatzta mimmennu ruach millematta yafsik ad shettichle baashah vechozer likriato. vechen bedivre tora. yatzta ruach mechavero af al pi shemmafsik likriat shema eno posek ledivre tora:

Haya kore keriat shema bevayit venistappek lo im yesh sham tzoa o meme raglayim o en sham hare ze muttar likrot. haya kore baashpa venistappek lo im yesh sham tzoa o en sham lo yikra ad sheyyivdok shechezkat haashpa shehi mekom hattinnofet. aval sefek me raglayim afillu baashpa muttar likrot:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3:16-17: Keshem sheasur likrot keneged tzoa ume raglayim ad sheyyarchik kach asur likrot keneged haerva ad sheyyachazir panav. afillu kuti o katan lo yikra keneged ervatan afillu mechitztza shel zechuchit mafseket hoil vehu roe otah asur likrot ad sheyyachazir panav. vechol guf haishsha erva lefichach lo yistakkel beguf haishsha keshehu kore vaafillu ishto. veim haya megulle tefach miggufah lo yikra kenegdah:

Ucheshem shehu asur keneged ervat acherim kach hu asur likrot keneged ervato velo yikra keshehu arom ad sheyyechasse ervato. hayta chagora shel beged o or o sak al matnav af al pi sheshshear gufo arom muttar lo likrot keriat shema vehu shello yihye akevo nogea beervato. haya yashen betallito vehaya arom chotzetz betallito mittachat libbo vekore. aval lo yachotz tzavvaro veyikra mippene shellibbo roe et haerva venimtza kemi shekkore belo chagora:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3:6-8: Tzoat haadam vetzoat kelavim vachazirin bizman sheyyesh betochan orot vechol tzoa sherechah ra kegon ellu asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan. vechen keneged me raglayim shel adam. aval me raglayim shel behema korin kenegdan. katan sheeno yachol leechol kezayit dagan bichde sheyyochal haggadol kishlosha betze dagan en marchikin lo mitztzoato velo mimme raglav:

Hayta tzoa yevesha kecheres asur likrot kenegdah. veim hayta yevesha yoter mecheres ad sheim zerakah titparech hare hi keafar umuttar likrot kenegdah. me raglayim shennivleu bakkarka im hayu martivin hayyad asur likrot kenegdan veim lav muttar:

Kamma yarchik adam mitztzoa umimme raglayim veachar kach yikra, arba ammot. bamme devarim amurim bizman shehem millaachorav o mitztziddav aval im hayu keneged panav marchik mehen ad shello yire otan veachar kach yikra:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3:9-10: Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya immahen babbayit bemakom shave aval im haya sham makom gavoah mehen asara tefachim o namuch mehem asara tefachim yoshev betzad hammakom vekore shehare nifsak benehem. vehu shello yaggia lo reach ra. vechen im kafa keli al hatztzoa o al meme raglayim af al pi shehen immo babbayit hare ellu kikvurin umuttar likrot kenegdan:

Haya beno uven hatztzoa mechitztza shel zechuchit af al pi shehu roe otah meachare hazzechuchit muttar likrot betziddah. natan reviit mayim letoch me raglayim shel paam achat muttar likrot immahen betoch arba ammot:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:12-13: Posek adam im hannachri al hammelacha vekotzetz damim vehannachri ose leatzmo veaf al pi shehu ose beshabbat muttar. vechen hassocher et hannachri leyamim harebe muttar af al pi shehu ose beshabbat. ketzad. kegon shessachar hannachri leshana o lishtayim sheyyichtov lo o sheyyeerog lo. hare ze kotev veoreg beshabbat umuttar keillu katzatz immo sheyyichtov lo sefer o sheyyeerog lo beged shehu ose bechol et sheyyirtze. vehu shello yachshov immo yom yom:

Bamme devarim amurim betzina sheen makkirim hakkol shezzo hammelacha hannaaset beshabbat shel yisrael hi. aval im hayta yedua ugeluya umefursemet asura sheharoe et hannachri osek eno yodea shekkatzatz veomer sheppeloni sachar hannachri laasot lo melacha beshabbat:
Niddah 17a:20-17b:1: Nohagin tumea vetohora bishlagin. tenan hatam: sheleg eno lo ochel velo mashke, chishshev alav laachila — eno metamme tumeat ovchalin, lemashke — metamme tumeat mashkin.
Nitma miktzato — lo nitma kullo, nithar miktzato — nithar kullo.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat "nitma miktzato — lo nitma kullo", vahadar (tane) [amrat] "nithar miktzato — nithar kullo", lememra denitma kullo!
Amar abbaye: kegon sheheeviro al avir tannur, dehattora heida al keli cheres

Shabbat 140b:4-17: Amar rav kattina: haomed baemtza hammitta, keillu omed bichresah shel ishsha. velav milleta hi.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dezaven yarka — lizben aricha, kishsha ki chishsha, veureka mimmela.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dezaven kanya — lizben aricha, tuna ki tuna, veureka mimmela.

Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav [dela nefisha leh rifta] — la lechol yarka, mishshum degarer. veamar rav chisda: ana la baaniyyuti achali yarka, vela beattiruti achali yarka. baaniyyuti — mishshum degarer. beattiruti — deamena: hecha deayel yarka, leul bisra vechavvre.

Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dela nefisha leh rifta — la livtza batztzoe. (veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dela nefisha leh rifta — la livtza. may tama? — dela aved beayin yafa.) veamar rav chisda: ana meikkara la havay batzana ad dishday yadi bechulle mana, veashkachi [beh kol tzurki].

Veamar rav chisda: hay man deefshar leh lemechal nahama disare veachal dechitte kaavar mishshum "bal tashchit". veamar rav pappa: hay man deefshar lemishte shichra veshate chamra — over mishshum "bal tashchit". velav milleta hi — "bal tashchit" degufa adif.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav delet leh mishcha — nimshe bemayya dacharitzi.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dezaven umetza — lizben uneka, deit beh telata mine visra.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dezaven kittonita — lizban middinhar abba, venichavvevra kol telatin yomin, dimfatteya leh teresar yarche shatta, vaana arva. may "kittonita"? — kitta naa.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav la littiv atztzippeta chadta, dimchalleya maneh.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav la lishaddar maneh leushepizeh lechauoreh leh, delav orach ara, dilma chaze beh midde veate lemigganneya.
Amar lehu rav chisda livnateh: tihveyayn tzenian beappe gavrayychu, la techlun nahama beappe gavrayychu.
La techlun yarka belelya, la techlun tamre belelya, vela tishton shichra belelya, vela tippenon hecha demippenu gavrayychu.
Vechi ka kare inish abbava — la temrun "mannu", ella "manni".
Zohar, Tetzaveh 1: (Shemot 27:20) veatta tetzavve et bene yisrael vegomer. veatta hakerev elecha et aharon achicha vegomer. amar ribbi chiyyay, may shena hacha mivchol atar, dichtiv veatta hakerev elecha veatta tedabber el kol chachme lev. veatta tetzavve et beni yisrael. (Shemot 30:23) veatta kach lecha besamim rosh mar deror. ella kolla beraza illaa ihu, leachlela shechinta vahadeh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, nehora illaa, unehora tattaa kalil kachada, ikre (138 amud bet) veatta. kema deat amar (nechemya 9:6) veatta mechayye et kullam. veal da la ketiv, vehikravta et aharon achich. vetzivita et bene yisrael. vedibbarta el kol chachme lev. begin dehahu zimna sharya shimsha besihara, veishtattaf kolla kachada, lesharya al umanuta deovada. amar ribbi elazar, mehacha, (Shemot 36:1) asher natan Adonai chachma utevuna bahemma.

Ribbi shimon amar mehacha, veatta tedabber el kol chachme lev asher milletiv ruach chachma. asher milletim mibbae leh. ella asher milletiv, lehahu libba, milletiv ruach chachma. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 11:2) venacha alav ruach Adonai ruach chachma vegomer veal da itzterich asher milletiv ruach chachma, desharya shimsha besihara beashlemuta decholla, veal da itreshim kolla vechol atar. amar ribbi elazar, i hachi hane veatta veatta, heach mityayshshevan bikrae.

Amar leh, kullehu mityayshshevan ninhu. veatta hakkerev elecha: leyachada bahadeh, ulekarva bahadeh, raza dishma kadisha kedka yeot. veatta tedabber el kol chachme lev: begin dechullehu la atyayn lemebad avidta, ad deruach kudsha memallela begavvavyyhu, velachash lon bilchishu, ucheden avde avidta. veatta tetzavve et beni yisrael: ruach kudsha pakda alayyhu, veanhir alayyhu, lemebad ovada biruta shelim. veatta kach lecha: kema deokimna. (dichtiv) veatta hakerev elecha, vehani kullehu, hacha beovada demashkena. decholla itavid beraza da.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar (Tehillim 22:20) veatta Adonai al tirchak eyaluti leezrati chusha. veatta Adonai kolla chad. al tirchak: leistalleka minan, lemeheve salik nehora illaa mittattaa. deha kad istallak nehora illaa mittattaa, keden itchashach kol nehora, vela ishtechach kelal bealma.

Veal da itcharav be makdesha beyomoy deyirmeyahu. veaf al gav deitbene levatar, la ahdar nehora leatreh kadka yeot. veal raza da, shema dehahu nevia deitnabbe al da, yirmeyahu. istalkuta dinhora illaa, deistallak leela leella, vela ahdar leanhara levatar kedka yeot. yirmeyahu: istallak vela ahdar leatreh, veitcharav be makdesha veitchashachu nehorin.

Aval yeshayahu, shema garim lefurekana, uleahdara nehora illaa leatrih, (Yeshayahu leanhara hahu nehora illaa ulemebad purekana) ulemivne be makdesha, vechol tavin vechol nehorin, yahadrun kedibbekadmeta. veal da, shemahan ditren neviin illen, kayymin da lokovel da, begin dishma garim, vetzerufa deatvavn da beda, garmin ovada, hen letav vehen levish. veal raza da, tzerufa deatvavn dishmahan kaddishin, vechen atvavn begarmayyhu, garmin leitchazaa razin illain, kegavvna dishma kaddisha, deatvavn begarmayyhu, garmin razin illain kaddishin leitchazaa behu.
Zohar, Tetzaveh 4: Patach veamar (Bereshit 4:3) vayhi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama mincha laAdonai. vayhi mikketz yamim, raza ihu, mikketz yamim, vela mikketz (134 amud alef) yamin, dacha lekketz yamin, vekariv lekketz yamim. veha okimna, dichtiv, (Daniel 12:13) veatta lech lakketz. amar kudesha berich hu ledaniel veatta lech lakketz. amar leh, lean ketz, lekketz hayyamim o lekketz hayyamin, ad deamar leh lekketz hayyamin.

Veal da dachil david, dichtiv, (Tehillim 39:5) hodieni Adonai kitztzi. o lekketz hayyamim, o lekketz hayyamin. vehacha ma ketiv, vayhi mikketz yamim vela mikketz yamin. uvegine kach la itkabbal karbaneh deha missitra achara hava kolla.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, (Bereshit 4:4) vehevel hevi gam hu. may gam hu. leasgaa kolla da beda. karbana kolla veikara dileh hava lekudesha berich hu, veyahiv chulakeh lesitra achara, kema deat amer umechelvehen. vekayin, ikkara aved mikketz yamim, veyahav chulaka lekudesha berich hu, veal da itdacha ihu vekarbaneh.

Beiyyov ma ketiv, (iyyov 1:Adonai) vehalchu vanav veasu mishte vegomer. uchetiv vayhi ki hikkifu yeme hammishte. uchetiv veshalchu vekaru lishloshet achyotehem leechol velishtot immahem, deda ihu ikkara lesitra achara. ulevatar akriv olot, veola ihu dechar, vela nukeba, vesalleka leella, vekarbana la kariv leachlela leh kedka yeot.
Zohar, Tetzaveh 6: Et chag hammatztzot tishmor, ribbi yehuda patach, (Yeshayahu 2:22) chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo ki vamme nechshav hu. hay kera ukemuha. aval may chidlu lachem min haadam, vechi azhar leh levar nash leitman mishshear bene nasha. uf innun name legabbeh, yishtachchun bene nasha dela yikrevun illen beillen lealmin. ella ha ukemuha beman deashkim lefitcha dechavreh lemehav leh shelam.

Vaana okimna leh bikra achara, dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:14) mevarech reehu bekol (226 amud bet) gadol babboker hashekem kelala techashev lo. veaf al gav decholla shappir. aval may chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo. hacha pakid kudesha berich hu levar nash, veazhir leh leistammera meinnun bene nasha, desatu archayyhu meorach tav leorach bish, umesaave nafshayyhu behahu mesaavu achara.

Deha kad bara kudesha berich hu levar nash, aved leh bediyyukena illaa, venafach beh rucha (nusach acher nishmeta) kaddisha, dechalil bitlat kema deokimna, deit beh nefesh ruach uneshama, veella mikkolla neshama, deihi chela illaa leminda, ulemetar pikkudoy dekudesha berich hu. vei hahi nishmeta kaddisha ail lah befulechana achara, hay ihu masiv lah, venafik mippulechana demareh. begin ditlat chelin illen, kullehu chad, nefesh ruach uneshama mishtattefe kachada, vahavu chad, vecholla kegavvna deraza illaa. (al da neemar (sham 13) holech et chachamim vegomer)

Vei chazenan lehay bar nash, dahavo beh illen dargin kullehu. ad la kayyeyma bekiyyumeh leminda man ihu, bemay ityeda (dela) lekarva bar nash bahadeh, o leitmana minne. (sefer acher bar nash deit beh dargin illen kullehu vekayyeyma bekiyyumeh da ihu gevar shelim avda mehemana demareh uvae leishtattefa beh uleitchabbera bahadeh lemelaf orchoy minneh. uvemay ityeyda bar nash leminda man ihu lekarva bahadeh o leitmenaa minneh) berugezeh mammash, yeda leh bar nash, veyishtemoda man ihu. i hahi nishmeta kaddisha natar beshaata derugezoy, (atya aleh) dela yekar lah meatraha, begin lemishre techotah hahu el zar, da ihu bar nash kedka yeot. da ihu avda demarih, da ihu gevar shelim.

Vei hahu bar nash la natir lah, veihu akar kedushsha da illaa meatreh, lemishre beatreh sitra achara. vadday da ihu bar nash demarid bemareh, veasir lekarva bahadeh uleitchabbera immeh, veda ihu (iyyov 18:4) toref nafsho beappo. ihu tarif veakar nafsheh, begin rugezeh, veashre begavveh el zar. veal da ketiv chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo, dehahi nishmeta kaddisha tarif lah, vesaiv lah, begin appo. asher neshama achlaf beappo. ki vamme nechshav hu. kochavim umazzalot itchashiv hahu bar nash.

Uman deitchabbar immeh, uman deishtae (sefer acher mishtattef) bahadeh, keman deitchabbar bekochavim umazzalot mammash. may tama. begin dekochavim umazzalot mammash share begavveh. vela od, ella deakar kedushsha illaa meatreh, veshari beatreh kochavim umazzalot el zar. ma el zar ketiv beh (Vayikra 19:4) al tifnu el haelilim, kegavvna da, asir leistakkela beanpoy.

Vei tema ha rugeza derabbanan. rugeza derabbanan tav ihu lechol sitrin, deha tanenan deorayyta eshsha ihi, veorayyta ka martecha leh, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 23:29) halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai. rugeza derabbanan bemille deorayyta. rugeza derabbanan lemehav yekara leorayyta, vecholla lefulechana dekudesha berich hu havi, lechach neemar (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna.

Aval i bemillin acharanin, lav pulechana dekudesha berich hu hay, begin divchol chattaim deka avid bar nash, lav ihu kochavim umazzalot mammash kehay, veasir lekarva bahadeh dehay. vei tema ha leshaata hava, deavar vehadar ahdar. lav hachi, dechevan deiakar kedushsha denafsheh minneh umeatreh, vehahu el zar, makpach hahu atar, ittakkaf beh, vela shavik leh. bar kad itdache bar nash mikkol vachol, veakar leh lealmin, ulevatar ishtaddal leitkaddesha uleamshacha kedushsha aleh. keden ulevay deitkadesh. amar leh ribbi yose, itkaddash mammash. (sefer acher amay veha itdache veitkaddash)

Amar leh ta chaze, beshaata deihu akar kedushsha denafsheh, vesharya beatreh hahu el zar deikre tame, isteav bar nash, vesaiv leman dekariv bahadeh, vehahi kedushsha akrat minneh, vechevan deakrat minneh zimna chada, kamma deyaavid bar nash od, la tituv leatraha.

Amar leh i hachi, kama misavin innun demmitdakkan. amar leh shani misavu achara, dela yachil lemebad yattir. aval da shanya mikkolla, dechol gufa saiv miggo umibbar, venafsha, vecholla masiv. ushear misavu dealma, lav ihu ella gufa levar bilchodoy, ubbegin kach ketiv chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo, deachlaf kedushsha demareh begin appo, deda ihu misavu demasiv kolla. ki vamme nechshav hu. bama kochavim umazzalot vadday nechshav ihu.

Ta chaze, hay ihu rugeza deihu kochavim umazzalot, sitra achara, kema deamaran, devae bar nash leistammera minneh uleitparasha mealoy, veal da ketiv (Shemot la) elohe massecha lo taase lach. lach: begin leavasha garmach. uchetiv batreh et chag hammatztzot tishmor. tishmor: da sitra dikdushsha, devae bar nash lenatra leh, vela yachlaf leh begin sitra achara. vei yechlaf leh ha ihu masiv, vesaiv lechol man dekariv bahadeh.
Zohar, Tetzaveh 7: Et chag hammatztzot tishmor, hay ihu atar deikre shamor. ubbegin kach ketiv, et chag hammatztzot tishmor shivat yamim tochal matztzot kaasher tzivviticha. shivat yamim illen, lav innun keshivat hayyamim desukkot, deinnun illain veillen tattain. veal da, beinnun hallel gamur, uvehani lav hallel gamur, veal deinnun letatta, shivat yamim tochal matztzot. matztzot ketiv chaser bela 6, dead la sharan innun yomin illain, raza dev.
Vei tema, kevan dehay raza dechag hammatztzot itkaddash, amay nachta, deha tanenan maalin bakkodesh vela moridin, amay nachta letatta beinnun yomin tattain.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Vayikra 16:6) vechipper baado uvead beto vegomer, man diychapper, itzterich (nusach acher lechappara) aleh bekadmita, uvatar al beteh. kegavvna da, hay darga, shaari leitkaddesha ulenafka bikdusha, lechappera aleh, vechevan deihu itkaddash, bae lechappara al beteh, ulekaddesha lon, veal da nachta letatta lekaddesha beteh. uvemma mekaddesh lon, beyisrael diltatta. bechushebana deomer vechevan deillen mitkadshan, baenan lesalleka lah leella, deha kad beta dematronita itkadshat, keden salkat leella, leitkashshera beinnun yomin illain leella.

Veal da anan avdin chushebana, bekiyyuma al kayymin, begin deinnun yomin, yomin illain innun, vechen bechol zimna deal bar nash leinnun yomin illain, ben bitzlota, ben bishvacha, itzterich lekayyeyma al ragloy, yarkin vegufa kachada tamman. yarkin vegufa lekayyeyma, kidchura dekayyeyma becheleh, vela kenukeva dearchaha lemetav. veod begin shevacha dealma illaa.

Uvegin deihu raza didchura, nashim peturot mechushebana da, vela mitchayyvan lemimni bar dechurin, leitkashshera kol chad kedka yeot. kegavvna da, (Shemot 23:17) yerae kol zechurecha, dechurin, vela nashin. begin deraza divrit bidchura ihu, vela benukeba, uvegin dekayyeyma raza leella, nashin la mitchayyvan.

Veraza olifna hacha, divchol shivat yomin, meillen yomin illain, natla kedushsha yoma chad (vametaachad) deillen tattae, vehay tattaa ikre shavua, deitkaddash beshiva yomin illain. vechen bechol shiva veshiva meinnun chamshin yomin, ad vela ad bichlal, vechad ishtechachu arbein utesha yomin illain, ishtechachu letatta sheva yomin, deitkaddashu behu vechol chad ikre shavua, deal beinnun sheva. veal da ketiv, (Vayikra 23:15) sheva shabbatot temimot tihyena. begin deinnun nukevin, nakat kera lishana denukevin.

Vechad itkaddashu behu, uveta, mittatkena leitchabbera itteta bevalah, keden ikre chag shavuot, meinun nukeve desharu alayyhu innun yomin illain, deitkaddashu behu. ubbegin kach ketiv beshavuotechem, innun dilchon, vela ketiv beshavuot, begin dehachi name mitkaddeshin yisrael letatta immehon.

Veal da kad matun letesha vearbein yomin, hahu yoma illaa dealayyhu, deihu yoma dechamshin, deshallit al tisha vearbein yomin, raza dichlala deorayyta, betisha vearbein anpin, ucheden hahu yoma illaa, yoma dechamshin, beitaruta diltatta, appik orayyta kelala betisha vearbein anpin.
Zohar, Tetzaveh 9: Teren nahame achlu yisrael, chad, kad nafku mimmitzrayim, achlu matztza, lechem oni. vechad bemadbera, lechem min hashshamayim. (chad befesach vechad bishvuot) dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim veal da karbana deyoma da nahama ihu. veal nahama, itkerivu kol shear karbanin. denahama ihu ikar, dichtiv, (Vayikra 23:18) vehikravtem al hallechem shivat kevasim vegomer, uchetiv (Vayikra 23:17) mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa vegomer, deda ihu nahama deachkimu beh yisrael, chachmeta illaa deorayyta, vealu bearchaha.

Hasheta it lan leistakkela, bappesach nafku yisrael minnahama deitkere chametz, ketiv, (Shemot 13:7) vela yerae lecha chametz, uchetiv (Shemot 12:19) ki kol ochel machmetzet may taama. begin yekara dehahu nahama deitkere matztza. hasheta dezachu yisrael lenahama illaa yattir la yeot hava leitbattela chametz, vela itchazya kelal. vaamay karbana da, chametz hava, dichtiv solet tihyena chametz teafena. vetu, dehashta beyoma da itbattal yetzer hara, veorayyta deitkere chiru ishtechachat.

Ella, lemalka dehava leh bar yechiday, vechalash. yoma chad hava taiv lemechal, amru yechul bereh demalka (sefer acher mechla deasvavta da) asvavta da, vead deyechul leh, la yishtekach mechla umezona achara beveta. avdu hachi. kevan deachal hahu asvavta, amar mikkan ulehala yechul kol ma deihu taiv, vela yachil lenazka leh.

Kacha kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, la have yade ikara veraza dimhemnuta, amar kudesha berich hu, yitamun yisrael asvavta, vead deyechlun asvavta da, la itchaze lehon mechla achara. kevan deachlu matztza, deihi asvavta lemeal uleminda beraza dimhemnuta. amar kudesha berich hu, mikkan ulehala itchaze lon chametz, veyechlun leh, deha la yachil lenazka lon. vekol shekken divyoma deshavuot, izdaman nahama illaa, deihu asvavta becholla.

Veal da mekarvin chametz, leittokda al madbecha. umekarvin teren nahamin acharanin kachada. vechametz, ittokda benura demadbecha vela yachil leshalletaa, ulenazkka lon leyisrael. uvegine kach, yisrael kaddishin itdavaku beh bekudesha berich hu, beasvavta deorayyta beyoma da. veilmale havo natre yisrael teren sitrin denahame illen, la havo ayylin bedina lealmin.

Beyoma derosh hashshana, deihu yoma dedina, (bechol yoma) delav ihu, ella leinnun dela natlu mechla deasvavta, veshavku leasvavta deorayyta, begin mechla achara deihu chametz. deha beyoma da derosh hashshana, hahu chametz salleka, umekatrega aleh devar nash, vealshin aleh, veihu kayyeyma beyoma da mekatrega al alma. vekudesha berich hu yativ bedina al kolla vedain alma.

Uvegine kach kad yahav kudesha berich hu orayyta leyisrael, atim lehu mehahu nahama illaa, dehahu atar, umiggo hahu nahama, havo yadin umistakkelin beraze deorayyta, lemehach beorach meshar, veha ukemuha milla innun chavrayyay berazin (sefer acher illen dekaamaran) illen kidkamran.

Ribbi shimon veribbi elazar bereh, havo azle bearcha, vahavu azlin immehon, ribbi abba veribbi yose, ad dahavo azle iarau bechad sava, vahava achid bideh chad yannuka, zakaf enoy ribbi shimon vechama leh, amar leh leribbi abba vadday millin chadtin it gabban behay sava.

Kad matu legabbeh, amar ribbi shimon, bematul dekkufetrach begabbach ka atit, man ant. amar leh, yuday ana. amar, millin chadtin vadday yoma da legabbach, amar leh lean hu arach. amar leh, diuri hava beinnun perishe madbera, dahavena, mishtaddal beorayyta, vehasheta atena leyishuva, lemetav betzilla dekudesha berich hu, beillen yome deyarcha sheviaa da.

Chadde ribbi shimon, amar, netiv, devadday kudesha berich hu shadrach legabban. amar leh, chayyecha denishma milla mippumach, meinnun millin chadtin attikin, dintatun tamman bemadbera, mehay yarcha sheviaa. vaamay itperashtun hasheta mimmadbera, lemete leyishuva. amar leh hahu sava, bishelta da, yedana dechachmeta gabbach, umillach matu lirkie dechachmeta. (sefer acher natu latekayav dechachmeta)
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: Bemifkad habbayit. tirgem yonatan: "baatar dachazi leveta", kelomar: bemakom kadosh; velashon bemifkad habbayit – makom shehabbayit kale, kemo "lo nifkad mimmennu ish" (Bamidbar 31:49). vehu par hammilluim, kederech sheasu bammishkan (Vayikra 8:2), venisraf oto par velo neechal; vechen darshu rabbotenu bimnachot (45.): milluim hikrivu bime ezra kederech shehikrivu bime moshe:
targum: Vetisav yat tora dechatata veyokdineh baatar dachazi leveta mibbara lemakdesha:

rashi: Maase charash even. maase umman shel avanim, charash ze davuk hu latteva shelleacharav ulefichach hu nakud pattach besofo, vechen charash etzim nata kav (Yeshayahu 44) – charash shel etzim, vechen charash barzel maatzad, (sham), kol elle devukim ufetuchim:
Pittuche chotam. ketargumo ketav mefarash kiglof deizka, charutzot haotiyyot betochan kemo shechortzin chotme tabbaot shehem lachtom iggerot – ketav nikkar umeforash:
Al shemot. kemo bishmot:

Musabbot mishbetzot. mukkafot haavanim bemishbetzot zahav, sheose moshav haeven bezahav kemin gumma lemiddat haeven umeshakkeah bammishbetzet, nimtzet hammishbetzet sovevet et haeven saviv umechabber hammishbetzot bechitfot haefod:

ohc: Et hakkeves haechad vegomer. amar et hakkeves kede shello tistappek shehu zulat shene kevasim haamurim besamuch, laze amar et hakkeves perush echad mehammuzkarim. veamro haechad nitkavven lomar shehagam shello haya lahem ella keves echad bannimtza – yakrivuhu babboker, veen keves sheni shel ben haarbayim meakkev. vehinne amro haechad perush, hagam sheyyesh echad veen lo sheni, vaafillu bachinnuch shemmeakkev rishon lashsheni keamram beferek hattechelet (menachot 84,4), en sheni meakkev larishon.

rashi: Lo taalu alav. al mizbeach ze:
Ketoret zara. shum ketoret shel nedava – kullan zarot lo chutz mizzo:
Veola umincha. velo ola umincha, ola shel behema vaof, mincha hi shel lechem:

ohc: Veasita vegomer lechavod uletifaret. tzarich ladaat ma hi kavvanat Adonai beamro lechavod vegomer, achar shemmodia maasehem veafnehem, veim lehodio shebbegadim ellu yesh bahem leaharon kavod vetiferet, ma yetze lanu mizze. veulay sheyyitbaer al pi ma sheamru beferek en maamidin (avoda zara lod,1) veze leshonam: shaalu et rabbi akiva bamme shimmesh moshe shivat yeme hammilluim, lo hava bideh. ata veshaal be midrasha, amar leh: bechaluk lavan sheen bo imra, ad kan. hinne mimma sheshshimmesh moshe beshivat yeme hammilluim bechaluk ze, yaggid sheen habbegadim meakkevin ella leaharon ulevanav, aval zulat hakkohanim titratztze avodat hakkarbanot belo vegadim. vehu ma shemmodio beamro kavod vegomer, lomar, lo tachshov ki habbegadim letzarche avoda levad, veyitchayyev haddavar lelavsham moshe baavodat yeme hammilluim, velo chen hu. enam ella lechavod vegomer lammesharet kavua laavodato, aval letzad haavoda levad keshettihye bezulat aharon uvanav, yaavdu bechaluk lavan, uchemo shekken shimmesh moshe kannizkar.

O yomar ki va Adonai latet taam lamma tzivva shemona begadim, arbaa lavan vearbaa zahav, veamar hattaam hu lechavod uletifaret. perush, al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (hakedamat Tikkunim) ki hashshemona begadim, arbaa shel bigde lavan yirmezu el arba otiyyot shel shem havaya baruch hu, vearbaa bigde zahav yirmezu el arba otiyyot shel shem 65. veda ki shem havaya baruch hu yityaches elav kinnuy hattiferet kayyadua, veshem 65 yityaches elav kinnuy hakkavod. vehu amro veasita vigde kodesh vegomer lechavod keneged bigde zahav, uletifaret keneged bigde lavan. vesidder hakkatuv seder haderagot hakkedushsha zo lemala mizzo, vehikdim lechavod, vehaven.

Vetzivva Adonai asot shemona begadim, shebbeemtzautam yitkapper pegamim asher yesabbevu bene haadam asher yaggia lemakom elyon, uvaze yechuppar heavon hahu. ulederech ze yesh latet tuv taam lamma hikpid Adonai al habbegadim beaharon velo bemoshe, al derech amram zichronam livracha (arachin 16,1) ki shemona bigde kehunna mechapperim al shemona mine averot sheyyihye bivne yisrael, asher al ken lo tzivva Adonai haddavar ella lehakkohen haomed lesharet hu uvanav kol hayyamim lechapper al bene yisrael. ma sheen ken moshe shekkol ma sheshshimmesh beshivat yeme hammilluim lo haya ella lechapparat aharon uvanav lemalle et yadam laavod lifne Adonai, lo haya tzorech lema sheyyechapperu habbegadim kannizkar, laze shimmesh bechaluk vegomer.

rashi: Gam anosh latztzaddik lo tov. lo amar hakkadosh baruch hu limchot shem yisrael meal haaretz, ki lo tov beenav laanosh kullam:
