Lehakkot nedivim al yosher. lehakkot hattovim shebbahem shehayu nedivim ale yosher, shenneemar: "vehisharti veyisrael shivat alafim kol habbirkayim asher lo charu labbaal" (Melachim 1 19:18):
Nedivim al yosher. dugmat haamur bemakom acher "venadiv nedivot yaatz vehu al nedivot yakum" (Yeshayahu 32:8), nimtza "nadiv" al "nedivot":
targum: Lemittach letzadika la shapper af la lemimche tzadikaya deamrin teritzuta:

rashi: Hachelev. ze chelev haddakkim o hakkeva:

Vehaalya. min hakkelayot ulematta, kemo shemmeforash bevayyikra shenne (Vayikra 3), leummat heatze yesirenna – makom shehakkelayot yoatzot (chullin 11), uveemure happar lo neemar alya, sheen alya kereva ella vecheves vechivsa veayil, aval shor veez en teunin alya:
Veet shok hayyamin. lo matzinu haketara veshok hayyamin im haemurim ella zo vilvad:

Ki el milluim hu. shelamim; leshon shelemut – shehushlam bakkol; maggid hakkatuv shehammilluim shelamim, shemmesimim shalom lammizbeach uleoved haavoda velabbealim, lechach ani matzricho hechaze, lihyot lo leoved haavoda lemana, vezehu moshe sheshshimmesh bammilluim, vehashshear achlu aharon uvanav shehem bealim, kamforash bainyan:
Vattesimun leshomre mishmarti, bemikdashi lachem. tesimun lachem, ledatechem, bemikdashi anashim rotzchim sheenam reuyin lihyot shomre mishmarti:
targum: Vela netartun metrat kudeshi umanitun lenatre matrat memri vemakdeshi lechon:

rashi: Umilleta vo. al shem shehaavanim memalleot gummot hammishbetzot hametukkanot lahen, kore otan bilshon milluim:
Shochad mechek rasha yikkach. hakkadosh baruch hu mekabbel divre hachenaa ufiyyus mechek harshaim, kelomar: basseter beno levenam:
Lehattot archot mishpat. lahafoch dino meraa letova:
targum: Shuchada min uva yisav rashia lemitzle archa dedina:

rashi: Vehaya hammizbeach kodesh. uma hi kedushshato? kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash. afillu karban pasul sheala alav kiddesho hammizbeach lehacheshiro shello yered; mittoch shenneemar kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash, shomea ani ben rauy ben sheeno rauy – kegon davar shello haya fesulo bakkodesh, kegon harovea vehannirba umuktze veneevad vehatterefa vechayyotze bahen – talo veze asher taase hassamuch acharav, ma ola reuya, af kol rauy shennira lo chevar venifsal mishshebba laazara, kegon hallan vehayyotze vehattame veshennishchat bemachashevet chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo vechayyotze bahen (zevachim 83):
Velo yamut. mikkelal lav atta shomea hen – im yihyu lo lo yitchayyev mita, ha im yikkanes mechussar echad min habbegadim hallalu, chayyav mita vide shamayim (sanhedrin 83):
ohc: Uvetzeto velo yamut. nire sheim lo hayu lo happaamonim shemmashmiim et hakkol, chayyav mita lashshamayim. sheim lo chen, velo hayta kavvanato ella limchussar begadim, haya omer "velo yamut" achar tashlum habbegadim, o lefachot achar tashlum arbaa bigde kohen gadol, velo baemtza. ella lelammed al happerat ba, shechayyav afillu al happaamonim. uvappasuk haamur besof maase habbegadim dichtiv "vehayu al aharon vegomer velo yisu avon vametu" (Shemot 28:43), sham chiyyev al haoved mechussar begadim.

rashi: Vecheshev afuddato. vechagor sheal yado hu meappedo umetakkenehu lakkohen umekashsheto:
Asher alav. lemala bisfat hassinar, hi hachagora:
Kemaasehu. kaarigat hassinar maase choshev umechameshet minim, kach arigat hacheshev maase choshev umechameshet minin:
Mimmennu yihye. immo yihye arug velo yaargennu levad vichabberennu:

ohc: Velakachta et shete vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar et vegomer. veulay sheyyechavven el avne shoham shekkevar hizkir bitchillat hammitzva befarashat teruma (shemot 25:7). veze hu shiur hakkatuv "velakachta et shete avne shoham asher tzivviticha lehavi". uvaze nitkavven bemetek devarav yitbarach latet lo taam lamma perat avne shoham mikkelal kol haavanim, ki avne shoham yesh bahem mitzva achat peratit millevad avne hammilluim, velaze amar elav velakachta otam avne shoham shepperatti lecha.

rashi: Veasita leaharon ulevanav kacha. shana hakkatuv vechafal leakkev – sheim chasar davar echad mikkol haamur bainyan, lo nitmalleu yedehem lihyot kohanim vaavodatam pesula:
Otacha. kemo otach:
Shivat yamim temalle vegomer. bainyan hazze uvakkarbanot hallalu bechol yom:

Al shete chitfot millematta. shehammishbetzot netunot berashe chitfot haefod haelyonim habbaim al ketefav, keneged gerono, venikpalot veyordot lefanav, vehattabbaot tzivva litten beroshan hashsheni, shehu mechubbar laefod, vehu shenne leummat machbarto, samuch limkom chibburan baefod, lemala min hachagora meat, shehammachberet leummat hachagora, veellu netunim meat begova zekifat hakketefot, hu shenneemar mimmaal lecheshev haefod, vehen keneged sof hachoshen, venoten petil techelet beotan hattabbaot uvetabbeot hachoshen verochsan beoto petil leyamin velismol, shello yehe tachtit hachoshen holech lefanim vechozer leachor, venokesh al kereso, venimtza meyushshav al hammeil yafe:
Mimmul panav. baever hachitzon:

Al petil techelet. uvemakom acher hu omer vayyittenu alav petil techelet? veod ketiv kan vehaya al hammitznafet, ulematta hu omer vehaya al metzach aharon? uvishchitat kadashim shaninu searo haya nire ben tzitz lammitznefet sheshsham meniach tefillin? lamadnu shehammitznefet lemala begova harosh veenah amukka likkanes bah kol harosh ad hammetzach, vehatztzitz millematta, vehappetilim hayu vinkavim uteluyin bo bishne rashim uveemtzao, shishsha bishlosha mekomot hallalu, petil milmala echad mibbachutz veechad mibbifnim kenegdo, vekosher rashe happetilim meachore haoref shelashtan, venimtzeu ven orech hattas ufetile rashav makkifin et hakkadkod, vehappetil haemtzai shebberosho, kashur im rashe hashshenayim, veholech al pene rochav harosh milmala, nimtza asuy kemin kova; veal petil haemtzai hu omer vehaya al hammitznafet, vehaya noten hatztzitz al rosho kemin kova al hammitznefet, vehappetil haemtzai machaziko sheeno nofel vehattas taluy keneged mitzcho, venitkayyemu kol hammikraot – petil al hatztzitz, vetzitz al happetil, ufetil al hammitznefet milmala:

Ketoldotam. kasseder shennoldu – reuven, shimon, levi, yehuda, dan, naftali al haachat, veal hashsheniyya gad, asher, yissashchar zevulun, yosef, binyamin male, shekken hu chatuv bimkom toladto, 25 otiyyot bechol achat veachat:
ohc: Shishsha mishshemotam vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar mishshemotam velo amar shishsha shemot vegomer veshishsha shemot al vegomer ketoldotam. gam lo haya tzarich lomar "hannotarim", ki roe ani shennotarim hem. uvehechreach lefaresh notarim happechutim, al derech amro "al elazar vegomer hannotarim", vedarshu zichrono livracha (yoma paz,1; zohar 11 56:) happechutim kulei, uchemo sheddarshu gam ken (Bereshit Rabba 83,9) befasuk "tzon lavan hannotarot" yeuyyan sham. veze yavhil, ki meamro ketoldotam mashma kasseder shennoldu leyaakov, veim ken lamma hannoladim baacharona pechutim meharishonim, uma gam sheyyesh baacharonim bene haggevirot, yosef uvinyamin, zevulun veyissashochar ben tora, veyesh barishonim mibbene hashshefachot, veech yikra hakkatuv livne haggevira notarim beerech bene hashshefachot.

Ulehavin hainyan el ze abbit lema sheamru besota (36,1) veze leshonam: tanu rabbanan, shete avanim hayu lechohen gadol al ketefo vechulei, ushemot bene yisrael katuv alehen, shishsha al even zo veshishsha al even zo, shenneemar "shishsha" vegomer, sheniyya ketoldotam velo rishona ketoldotam, mippene sheyyehuda mukdam, vachamishshim otiyyot – esrim vechamesh al even zo veesrim vechamesh al even zo. rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: lo kederech shechalukim bechummash happekudim, ella kederech shechalukim bechummash sheni, ketzad? bene lea kesidran, bene rachel echad mikkan veechad mikkan, uvene hashshefachot baemtza. veella ma ani mekayyem "ketoldotam"? kishmotam shekkara lahem yaakov, velo kashshemot shekkara lahem moshe "reuveni shimoni" vegomer, ad kan. peshatan shel devarim hu ki letanna kamma "ketoldotam" chozer al shemot shete haavanim, ella sheyyakdimu yehuda liruven al ze hadderech: yehuda, reuven, shimon, levi, dan, naftali beeven achat, uvaeven hashsheniyya: gad, asher, yissashchar, zevulun, yosef uvinyamin keseder ledatan. ucheshettachshov haotiyyot timtza esrim vechamesh beachat veesrim vearba beachat. veamru bashshas (sota lo,1): rabbi yitzchak amar hosif lo yehosef, rav nachman amar binyamin male. vecheshbon ze lo nirmaz bappasuk ella shekkach baa lahem hakkabbala – esrim vechamesh beachat veesrim vechamesh beachat. vehakedamat yehuda liruven ani omer ki mehakkatuv doresh lah, mimma shekkatav "ketoldotam" baacharona, velo katav al ze hadderech "ufittachta alehem shemot bene yisrael ketoldotam", veaz yihye nishma shebbaa mitzvat "ketoldotam" al seder shete haavanim.

Veen lehakeshot: mi gilla ki ma sheeven rishona enah ketoldotam hu letzad hakedamat yehuda, vedilma lomar sheen bahem seder kol ikkar? ze eno, ki behechreach keshettavo lomar beeven rishona seder acher sheeno ketoldotam, tivchar beechad mehassedarim sheyyeshnam bakkatuv, o seder shekkatuv bechummash happekudim o bechummash sheni. ulechol echad mehem keshettavo lesadder even rishona shello ketoldotam, tetze behechreach even hashshenit shello ketoldotam. veim ken, hare bittalta "ketoldotam" bishte haavanim, asher al karchacha titchayyev lomar shehashshinnuy shemmevattel "ketoldotam" beeven rishona hu beofen sheeno mevattel gam bashsheniyya. vehechi dame? behechreach bichhay gavna sheyyakdim yehuda. vedavar ze sevara hu, ki hu melech velo rauy lehakedim, vegam matzinu lo shekkadam behakeravat chanukkat hammizbeach. vahagam sheggam yissashchar kadam, im banu lehakedimo kan hare bittalnu "ketoldotam" shel even sheniyya. ulederech ze ma sheddikdaknu beferusho bimkomo munnach. veefshar lomar ki nitkavven lomar sheen hasseder mafsil beavne haefod, sheim hikdim shimon liruven eno meakkev. laze amar shishsha mishshemotam vegomer, veet shemot vegomer hannotarim – perush, en lichtov ella hannotar beyadcha shello katavta oto al harishona. veyesh lehochiach ken mimma shello tana betosefta dimnachot (tosefta menachot 5) seder ketivat hashshemot meakkevin ze et ze, kidtane bigde kohanim meakkevin ze et ze, avne shoham veavne milluim meakkevin ze et ze, ketav sheal gabbehen meakkevin ze et ze – haya lo lomar gam ken seder hashshemot meakkevin ze et ze. efshar shessover sheen meakkev.

Verabbi chanina ben gamliel sover: beeven rishon bene lea kullan kesidran, perush – veen lehakedim bene zilpa hagam shekkadmu balleda, uvashsheniyya binyamin berosh haeven kodem bene hashshefachot, shekken katuv bechummash sheni, veacharav bene hashshefachot keseder ledatan, veyosef besof haeven, vehu amro "echad mikkan". ulefi seder ze nimtza cheshbon haotiyyot enam chalukim esrim vechamesh al even zo veesrim vechamesh al even zo, ki even rishona shebbah bene lea kesidran yesh bah esrim ushemone otiyyot, uveeven sheniyya esrim veachat, velichshettosif haot o hei beyosef o yod bevinyamin yihyu esrim ushetayim. velisvara zo yitbaer ma sheddikdaknu bakkatuv al ze hadderech: shishsha mishshemotam – perush shello kesidran, mehem shennoldu techilla umehem shennoldu achar hashshishsha hannotarim, vehem yissashchar uzevulun shennoldu achar kol bene hashshefachot. veamro hannotarim – perush shennaasu notar misseder hacheshbon, keshettavo lesadder seder hannoladim techilla timtza shehashshenayim kadmu lishne bene lea vehotiram Adonai acharehem, velaze kara lahem notarim. vahagam sheimmahem yosef uvinyamin, amar "hannotarim" letzad haarbaa shebbahem.

Vaavo el haayin ma shekkatav harambam beferek 9 mehilchot kele hammikdash, veze leshono: shishsha al even zo veshishsha al even zo, vechotvin shem yehosef, venimtza esrim vechamesh otiyyot beeven zo veesrim vechamesh otiyyot beeven zo, vechach hayu chotvin, ad kan. udevarav zichrono livracha enam lo ketanna kamma velo kerabbi chanina ben gamliel (sota lo,1), en ze ella binyan chadash, velo kisvarat rav kahana shehevi hashshas udechaah, shehu amar beeven rishona: reuven, gad, asher, zevulun, dan, naftali, uvaeven hashshenit shimon, levi, yehuda, yissashchar, yosef, binyamin vegomer. umaharik (bechesef mishna) dachak uferesh ki pasak rambam kerabbi chanina ben gamliel, umefaresh divre rabbi chanina ben gamliel al ze haofen: bene lea kesidran, perush echad kan veechad kan, bene rachel echad mikkan veechad mikkan bishne ketzot haavanim millematta, uvene hashshefachot baemtza, perush beemtza shete haavanim, ad kan.

Veli nire sheen devarim ellu mitkabbelim belev kol chacham lev mearbaa teamim: 1, ech yanniach tanna kamma veyifsok ker chanina, uma sheamar harav shettamo shel Rabbi chanina ben gamliel mistabber, adrabba tamo der chanina ben gamliel lo mistabber kelal, demappik hakkatuv mimmashmauto, shepperesh "ketoldotam" – kashshemot shekkara lahem avihem velo kashshemot shekkara lahem moshe, ki minnayin yaale al daat enosh sheyyichtov reuveni vegadi sheyyutzerach lemaatam. veod, "ketoldotam" lo mashma shappir shertzono lomar al shemotam beledatam, veen hechreach lehotzi hatteva mippeshatah shehu keseder ledatam kisvarat tanna kamma, veyoter mistabber tameh detanna kamma. vekusheya zo kalla mimma shelleachareha.

2: Lisvarat harav sheamar shebbene lea echad mikkan kivne rachel, lamma amar rabbi chanina ben gamliel: bene lea kesidran, bene rachel echad mikkan veechad mikkan, shemmore beetzba shebbene lea enam echad mikkan veechad mikkan? sheim perush "kesidran" hu echad mikkan veechad mikkan, gam bene rachel kesidran shel bene lea hem, velo haya lo lomar ella "bene rachel levassof". veod, mashmaut "echad mikkan veechad mikkan" lo yaggid kidvarav, ki haya lo lomar "echad beeven zo veechad beeven zo", ki "echad mikkan" vechulei yaggid kedivre Rashi, shehu echad berosh haeven veechad besofah. vekushya zo kalla mishshelleachareha.

3: Kefi perush divre harav en seder ze bechummash sheni, ki bechummash sheni bene lea baze achar ze uvinyamin acharehem, uvene hashshefachot achar binyamin, veyosef levassof. ulerabbi chanina ben gamliel ledivre rambam yosef achar shene bene hashshefachot baeven harishona, uvinyamin meuchar achar shene bene hashshefachot haacharonim baeven hashshenit, veech kaamar rabbi chanina ben gamliel kederech shechalukim bechummash sheni, vahalo bechummash sheni binyamin kodem kol bene hashshefachot? veod lamma hikdim yosef levinyamin vahalo bechummash sheni binyamin kodem, veen lidchot shehafacham kede ledayyek cheshbon esrim vachamishsha bechol even shehare cheshbonam shave hu chamishsha bechol echad. uveemet im yaamod rabbi chanina ben gamliel veyomar ki lechach nitkavven, lo yutzdeku devarav, kevan shettala haddavar veamar kederech shechalukim bechummash sheni, vegam en devarav mitkabbelin ki hakkatuv hikdim binyamin livne hashshefachot, velidvarav hu baacharona shebbaacharonot.

Had: minnayin matza rambam lesadder bene lea chetzyam beeven zo vechetzyam beeven zo? halo pashtan shel devarim sheamar rabbi chanina ben gamliel "bene lea kesidran" lo mashma ken, uminnayin nithavva lerambam sevara zo bedivre rabbi chanina ben gamliel? veacharon hichbid, ma shekkatav hakkesef mishne betaam rambam shekkatav lehashelim hachamishshim otiyyot betosefet hei beyosef, vehiksha al ze mehashshas dekaamar hatam (sota lo,1) veze leshonam: hane chamishshim – chamishshim neche chada havyayn, amar rabbi yitzchak yosef hosifu lo ot achat, shenneemar (tehillim 81:6) "edut bihosef", matkif lah rav nachman "ketoldotam" beenan! ella bechol hattora binyamin vehacha binyamin shalem, dichtiv (Bereshit la,18) "veaviv kara lo binyamin", ad kan. hare sheddacha hashshas terutz yehosef delo mittokma yehosef, veheela ella binyamin katuv bishne yodin. veteretz harav ki kushyat hashshas mikketoldotam" lo have ella lisvarat tanna kamma, aval ledateh derabbi chanina ben gamliel lo makshe, ki hu lo amar sheshshalal "ketoldotam" ella shello yichtov reuveni shimoni, vechevan shekken okimta rishona dihosef bimkomah omedet, verabbenu pasak kerabbi chanina ben gamliel kannizkar ad kan.

Udevarav temuhim beenay ad limod. halo ledaat tanna kamma lo dikdek bashshemot kelal, umefaresh tevat "ketoldotam" al seder ledatam, rishon rishon, uma makom lehakeshot hashshas ledaat tanna kamma mikketoldotam"? ella vadday shello hiksha meikara ella ledaat rabbi chanina ben gamliel shemmefaresh "ketoldotam" kashshemot shekkara lahem avihem, veteretz rav nachman "binyamin" male. velichshennanniach hannacha soveret ki tihye hakkushya ledaat tanna kamma, kol shekken vekal vachomer shettihye lisvarat rabbi chanina ben gamliel shemmedayyek "ketoldotam" al hashshemot. veod middivre rambam muchach shemmefaresh "ketoldotam" al hasseder velo al hashshemot, shekkatav veze leshono: shishsha al even zo veshishsha al even zo ketoldotam, ad kan. veim hayta kavvanat rambam lifsok kerabbi chanina ben gamliel, lo haya sotem lomar "ketoldotam", shemmatzinu rainu ki hashshas hiksha otah vehutzrach lefarshah, ella vadday shello pasak kerabbi chanina ben gamliel. asher al ken yoter haya nachon lehanniach haddavar betzarich iyyun millomar kaze.

Veefshar lomar ki rambam lo garas bemilteh detanna kamma mippene sheyyehuda rishon, ella al ze hadderech: sheniyya ketoldotam, perush behitztarfut sheniyya hu sheyyihyu nimtzaim sedurim ketoldotam al ze hadderech: reuven baachat, shimon bashsheniyya, levi baachat, yehuda bashsheniyya, vechen al ze hadderech. nimtzet kesheatta ba likrotam beseder shete shurot yihyu ketoldotam. vehu amro sheniyya ketoldotam aval rishona enah ketoldotam, ki hem sedurim bah al ze hadderech: reuven, levi, yissashchar, veen ze ketoldotam beshum ofen. uferush ketoldotam lefanenu shene derachim: haechad hu seder chummash happekudim shehu al ze hadderech – bene lea yachad, bene rachel acharehem, bene hashshefachot acharehen. vehashsheni haamur bechummash sheni – bene lea rishonim, bene hashshefachot baacharona, bene rachel – yosef levassof uvinyamin ben bene lea uven bene hashshefachot. vetanna kamma lo beer bema bachar, vahagam sheamar "ketoldotam" en hochacha lisvarato, ki yachol leamer ketoldotam hagam sheyyakdim kol bene lea letzad shello yafsik ben bene em achat, vahagam shehammiut mehem noldu achar bene bilha, yachol leamer "ketoldotam" beseder haimmahot – lea yalda rishona vechol habbanim yechashvu keven echad lehakedim kullam yachad, o gam ken letzad sherov habbanim hem kadmu. vegam letzad shello matzinu shennisderu bechol hattora kullah keseder ledatan al ze haofen. vediyyek rambam divre rabbi chanina ben gamliel sheamar lo keseder shechalukim bechummash happekudim chalukim vechulei, ze yaggid ki davar ze yachol likkanes bedivre tanna kamma shebba lishlol oto. veze lecha haot ki kavvanat tanna kamma beamro "ketoldotam" shehu beechad mishshene hadderachim: o keseder chummash happekudim o seder chummash sheni, uva rabbi chanina ben gamliel veshalal chummash happekudim uvachar bechummash sheni. vesavar rambam sheen hechreach bedivre tanna kamma, veefshar shekkach hi daat tanna kamma lefaresh bo keseder chummash happekudim. vahagam shemmiddivre rabbi chanina ben gamliel nire ki tanna kamma sover ken, leheyot sheddevarav shekulim hem, laze hutzrach levaer, aval anu en lanu lefaresh bedivre tanna kamma ella kedaat rabbi chanina ben gamliel kol shello nimtza beferush shechalak alav.

Umachloket rabbi chanina ben gamliel vetanna kamma hi bemashmaut ketoldotam. tanna kamma sover sheniyya ketoldotam al derech shepperashnu, aval rabbi chanina ben gamliel amar bene lea kesidran, perush, beeven achat bene rachel, echad berosh haeven veechad bassof, uvene hashshefachot beemtza haeven, im ken enam ketoldotam vehutzrach lefaresh kashshemot vegomer. ufasak harav ketanna kamma vesidder bene lea echad beeven zo veechad beeven zo kede shettavo hashsheniyya ketoldotam, uvene hashshefachot acharehem kasseder hannizkar. vetaam shehikdimam ki hem nisderu bechummash sheni kodem yosef, vegam baze yitzdak amro "ketoldotam", sheim yakdim yosef uvinyamin az afillu hashsheniyya enam ketoldotam shehare kadmu bene rachel livne hashshefachot. vetaam shehikdim naftali ledan lehashelim esrim vechamesh otiyyot kemo sheamar tanna kamma, ki lo rabbi chanina ben gamliel amar davar ze, vahagam sheyyesh makom lomar ki min hassetam eno cholek, meemtzaut haddevarim titchayyev lomar shecholek, kevan shechillek otam beseder sheyyihyu esrim ushemone beachat veesrim ushetayim beachat. veachar kach sidder yosef uvinyamin vehishlim hamminyan beot bihosef, ki lo dacha hattalmud sevara zo ella lerabbi chanina ben gamliel aval lo letanna kamma, ki eno mefaresh "ketoldotam" al hashshemot. velo katav yehuda bitchilla ki lo garas lah bashshas kemo shekkatavnu. ze hu ma shennire lidchok leyashshev habbarayta lisvarat rambam. veulay shennizdammena lo eze barayta ufasak otah.

Vihi ma lederech zo shel rambam yityashshevu haddikdukim sheddikdaknu bakkatuv al nachon. amro shishsha mishshemotam velo amar shishsha shemot, sheaz tavin shehem kesidran ketoldotam bechol even vaeven, ella mishshemotam perush, mikkol shenayim ushenayim mehem tikkach echad vetichtevennu al haeven haachat, veyihye notar echad, vechen lezug hashsheni vehashshelishi vechulei, veachar kach tikkach otam hashshishsha shennotru mikkol zug vazug veyihye al haeven hashshenit, veal ze dikdek lomar veet shemot hashshishsha hannotarim perush, shennotru beyadcha kaamur. uchefi ze amro ketoldotam hu al sidran bishte haavanim, velaze icher lomar ketoldotam achar shehizkir shete haavanim, vehaven:

rashi: Veatta tetzavve. zach. beli shemarim, kemo sheshshaninu vimnachot megargero verosh hazzayit vechulei:

Katit. hazzetim kotesh bammachteshet veeno tochanan barechayim, kede shello yihye vo shemarim, veachar shehotzi tippa rishona machnisan larechayim vetochanan; vehashshemen hashsheni pasul lammenora vechasher limnachot shenneemar katit lammaor – velo chatit lammenachot (menachot 86):
Lehaalot ner tamid. madlik ad shettehe shalhevet ola meeleha (shabbat 21):

Tamid. kol layla velayla karuy tamid, kemo sheatta omer olat tamid veenah ella miyyom leyom; vechen beminchat chavittin neemar tamid veenah ella machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baerev, aval tamid haamur belechem happanim mishshabbat leshabbat hu:
ohc: Veatta tetzavve. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "veatta" achar sheimmo haya medabber, od lamma amar "tetzavve" velo "tzav", od lamma amar leshon tziuuy. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru baze derashot, mehem amru (torat kohanim sof parashat emor) en "tzav" ella zeruz letzad sheyyesh chesron kis.

Veulay ki letzad shehaddavar eno min hammusar letzauot Adonai sheyyadliku nerot bevet Adonai asher mimmennu tetze ora, asher al ken amar lemoshe ki mitzva zo lo yomrenna leyisrael al pi Adonai ella hu yetzavve, perush mippi atzmo, sheyyinhagu kavod ze lehavi shemen lehadelik, velaze amar veatta, perush millevad ma shetztzivviticha hosef atta letzauotam al ze. vedikdek lomar tetzavve velo "tedabber", lehatzedik devarenu elle sheyyezarzem hu al haddavar, sheim amar "tedabber" yihye hannishma ki yedabber divre Adonai kasseder haragil ledabber mibbeli tzorech hazzeruz, velaze lo amar "tzav", sheaz yihye nishma sheyyomar ki Adonai amar elav letzauot, ella tetzavve perush meatzmecha. velo yerae beenecha ki mitzva zo kalla hi kevan sheenah ella mippi moshe, lo chen hu, sheen ze ella mishshum derech kavod leel elyon, aval hammitzva hare anu roim ki Adonai amar elav sheyyetzavve. veulay ki laze amar veyikchu elecha, perush lema sheatta bedatecha tetzavve.

Od yirtze, letzad shetztzivva Adonai kol maase hammishkan veinyanav lenocheach, sheyyerae shemmetzavve lo sheyyaase hu kol hannidbar elav veyavi kol hannedava el hammishkan, letzad hitlahavuto baavodat Adonai gam yaase melechet hammishkan vaavodato, laze amar elav veatta tetzavve, perush, ma sheyyesh lecha mehayyitron al kol yisrael eno ella ma shettetzavve otam levad, velaze amar tevat veatta, vetosefet havvav letzad sheyyesh osim levad moshe, viduyyak gam ken amro tetzavve velo amar "tzav".

Od yirmoz letzad ki haggia zeman tet hakkehunna leaharon, berar Adonai lemoshe hammalchut vehimlicho al yisrael, vehu amro tetzavve et bene yisrael, al derech amro (Shmuel 1 13:14) "vaytzavvehu Adonai lenagid" vegomer. vehagam shebbeeretz mitzrayim amar hakkatuv (Shemot 6:13) "vaytzavvem el bene yisrael", uferashnu sham sheasaam moshlim baam, kan yiched moshe lemalchut yisrael veaharon kohen. veulay ki laze nitkavven ma sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 19:6) "veattem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh", mamlechet chozer el moshe, kohanim aharon uvanav, vegoy kadosh ellu haleviyyim.

Veulay sheyyirmoz beamro tetzavve al derech amram zichronam livracha (zohar 9 83.) ki kol talmid chacham yesh lo nitzotz minnishmat moshe, velaze rabbotenu zichronam livracha (socha lat.) hayu korim ze laze moshe, ki hu ze hammedabber bivchinat nefesh hallomedet tora, vehu amro veatta tetzavve al derech amro (tehillim 91:11) "ki malachav yetzavve lach" shehu leshon tzavta, liuuy leish yisrael hannichbadim, uchevar yadata ki en chashivut ella beemtzaut esek hattora. uvachar Adonai lirmoz remez ze bemitzvat shemen ki hu bechinat hattora shehu or haolam. veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

Veyikchu elecha. taam amro elecha yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bemassechet shabbat daf 22,1 veze leshonam: "michutz lefarochet haedut" – edut hi lechol bae olam shehashshechina shora beyisrael, may edut? amar rav: ze ner hammaaravi, vechulei ad kan. vehinne amru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 52,2): letzane haddor hayu mitlotztzim al moshe lomar, efshar shehashshechina shora al maase shel moshe vechulei, ad kan. hare ki lo hayu matzdikim afillu miyyisrael shettishre shechina bammishkan, uchefi ze hagam sheshsharta shechina beyom 1 benisan, im kol ze en ze siman litmidut shettikba hashshechina mekomah bammishkan, aval benes ner hammaaravi hu edut lechol bae olam shehashshechina shora beyisrael. vehu maamar Adonai veyikchu elecha, perush, elecha nogea haddavar, ki baze titchazzek nevuatcha sheyyakkiru veyatzdiku nevuatcha shehashshechina tishre betocham kesheyyiru nes sheyyease beshemen hammenora. veulay ki laze nitkavven beamro veatta tetzavve, lomar shello yachush shello yeamnu devarav leheyot haddavar tamuah sheyyadur el elyon battachtonim, uchemo shekken haya. veim tomar minnayin yatzdiku – veyikchu elecha, perush, bedavar ze yesh lecha chizzuk vehatzedakat haddevarim kannizkar.

Uvederech remez yitbaer hakkatuv al derech maamar huva besefer zohar chadash (Bereshit 8) ki arba galuyyot shel yisrael kol echad mehem nigalu mimmennu bizchut echad, galut harishon nigalu bizchut avraham avinu alav hashshalom, sheni nigalu bizchut yitzchak, shelishi bizchut yaakov, veharvii taluy bizchut moshe, velaze nitarech haggalut, ki chol od sheen oskim battora uvammitzvot en moshe chafetz ligol am batlanim min hattora. veze hu sheramaz hakkatuv kan beamro veatta tetzavve et bene yisrael al derech (tehillim 91:11) "ki malachav yetzavve", o al derech amram zichrono livracha en tzav ella malchut ki hu yimloch alenu leatid, utenay hu haddavar sheyyaasku yisrael battora. veze hu amro veyikchu elecha shemen zayit zach, yirmoz el hattora shennimshela leshemen, ma hashshemen meir laolam kach hattora, vehem divre hazzohar shekkatavnu besamuch.
Vedikdek lomar zach, shetztzerichin laasok battora lishmah beli shemarim, shehem lekanter chas veshalom o lehitgaddel vechaddome, elle hem shemareha.

Veamar od katit, perush shetztzerichin laasok battora velichtot gufam vechocham, al derech amro (Bamidbar 19:14) "zot hattora adam ki yamut" (berachot 63:), uchevar katavti inyan ze becheftzi (chafetz Adonai, perek Adonai) beinyan hammayminim bah, yeuyyan sham.

Veamro lammaor titparesh gam ken kefi darkenu, ki bizman haggalut nechshach meor hallevana shennikret hammaor hakkatan, venifrad alluf mimmenna veshifcha tirash gevirtah. velaze yetzav ki yechavven beshemen zayit lehair lammaor uleyachado bimchuvvan, gam yechavven el hammaor haggadol, ki kevar yadata maamaram zichronam livracha (Megila 29,1) befasuk (Devarim 30:3) "veshav Adonai" mimma shello amar "veheshiv", gam maamaram zichronam livracha (taanit 5,1) befasuk "lo avo beir", vehaven.

Veamro lehaalot vegomer, ola tamid, vetamid ze en lo shiur, velo tashuv ledaava od vehaya lah Adonai leor olam. veulay shekkivven od lomar lammaor lehaalot ner tamid, ki hammaor haggadol hu yaale hanner tamid, al derech amro (Yeshayahu 62:8) "nishba Adonai vegomer im etten et deganech", vehayita rak lemala.

rashi: Ki im behitgallot libbo. ki im begilluy libbo, hu chafetz legallot ma shebbelibbo:
targum: La tzave sichla besucheltana ela beshatyuta pache libbeh:

rashi: Temimim yaasu. leola:
targum: Shava yomin taabbed tzefira dechatata leyoma vetor bar tore udichar min ana shelemin yaavdun:

rashi: Veachlu otam. aharon uvanav, lefi shehem baalehem:
Asher kuppar bahem. kol zarut vetiuv:
Lemalle et yadam. beayil velechem hallalu:
Lekaddesh otam. sheal yede hammilluim hallalu nitmalleu yedehem venitkaddeshu lichhunna:
Ki kodesh hem. kadshe kadashim; umikkan lamadnu azhara lezar haochel kadshe kadashim, shennatan hammikra taam laddavar mishshum dekodesh hem (148 24):
ohc: Veachlu otam asher kuppar. perush, letzad shehem bealav velo letzad shehem kohanim, vehu amro asher kuppar bahem, ki achilat shelamim labbealim tafil hakkappara, vaafillu lemoshe asurim hagam sheochel hechaze sheasur leaharon.

rashi: Venasa aharon. leshon selicha; veaappiche eno zaz mimmashmao – aharon nose et hammassa shel avon – nimtza mesullak heavon min hakkodashim (chullin 138):

Et avon hakkodashim. leratztzot al haddam veal hachelev shekkarvu vetuma, kemo sheshshaninu: e ze avon hu nose? im avon piggul, hare chevar neemar lo yeratze (Vayikra 19), veim avon notar hare neemar lo yechashev (sham 7) – veen lomar sheyyechapper al avon hakkohen shehikriv tame, shehare avon hakkodashim neemar velo avon hammakrivim – ha eno meratztze ela lehacheshir hakkarban (yoma 7):

Vehaya al mitzcho tamid. i efshar lomar sheyyehe al mitzcho tamid, shehare eno alav ella vishat haavoda, ella tamid leratztzot lahem afillu eno al mitzcho – shello haya chohen gadol oved beotah shaa, uledivre haomer odehu al mitzcho mechapper umeratztze, veim lav eno meratztze, nidrash al mitzcho tamid, melammed shemmemashmesh bo beodo al mitzcho, shello yassiach dato mimmennu (sham):
ohc: Leratzon lahem lifne Adonai. tzarich ladaat ma inyan yaggidu shete tevot ellu shebbahem yihye leratzon lifne Adonai, veulay sheyyechavven beamro kodesh al yisrael keamro (yirmeya 2:3) "kodesh yisrael", vetevat laAdonai yirtze ki kelalut yisrael hannikraim, kodesh hem laAdonai, chashukim devukim meshubadim, velaze yihye leratzon lifne Adonai sheyyesh lo ratzon beyisrael beemtzaut hakketav, vehu sod (Shir HaShirim 6:3) ani ledodi – uvaze yitratztze dodi li.

rashi: Al hachoshen. bishvil hachoshen, lekavam betabbeotav, kemo shemmeforash lematta vainyan:

Sharshot. leshon sharshe ilan, hameachazin lailan leheachez ulehittaka baaretz, af ellu yihyu meachazin lachoshen shebbahem yihye taluy baefod, vehen shete sharsherot haamurot lemala beinyan hammishbetzot; veaf sharsherot patar menachem ben saruk leshon sharashim, veamar sheharesh yetera kemo mem shebbeshilshom umm shebberekam, veeni roe et devarav, ella sharsheret bilshon ivrit keshalshelet bilshon mishna:
Gavlut. hu migbalot haamur lemala, shettitkaem battabbaot sheyyihyu bigvul hachoshen, vechol gevul leshon katze, ashevameyyl belaaz:
Maase avot. maase kelia:
Lifne happarochet. shemma tomar mashuch mikkeneged haaron latztzafon o laddarom, talo lifne hakkapporet mechuvvan keneged haaron mibbachutz:

Et haurim veet hattummim. hu ketav shem hameforash, shehaya notno betoch kifle hachoshen, sheal yado hu meir devarav umetammem et devarav; uvemikdash sheni haya hachoshen – shei efshar lechohen gadol lihyot mechussar begadim – aval oto hashshem lo haya betocho, veal shem oto hakketav hu karuy mishpat, shenneemar (Bamidbar 27), veshaal lo bemishpat haurim (yoma 73):
Et mishpat bene yisrael. davar shehem nishpatim venochachim al yado, im laasot davar o lo laasot; ulefi mia shehachoshen mechapper al meavvete haddin, nikra mishpat al shem selichat hammishpat:
Et pene mevin chachma. hachachma lifne mevin hu:

Veene chesil biktze aretz. lomar: en hachachma metzuya lefanay ki rechoka hi mimmenni, ech uchal lishnot seder nezikin shehu sheloshim perakim, massechet kelim – sheloshim perakim, massechet shabbat – esrim vearbaa perakim. aval lechacham hu davar kal: hayyom shone shene ferakim umachar shenayim, veomer: kach asu otan shehayu lefanay meolam:
targum: Appoy desucheltana chadyan bechachmeta veaynoy desichla beumeka deara:

rashi: Rimmone. agullim vachalulim hayu kemin rimmonim haasuyim kevetzat tarnegolet:
Ufaamone zahav. zaggin im inbalin shebbetocham:
Betocham saviv. benehem saviv – ben shene rimmonim paamon echad davuk vetaluy beshule hammeil:
Lekach. kemo kach. ushete gezirot hen, achat shel kicha veachat shel lekicha, velahen pitron echad:
Par echad. lechapper al maase haegel shehu par:
ohc: Veze haddavar asher taase vegomer. hakkavvana leheyot shekkadam elav meniat hammaase kemo shepperashti (Shemot 27:20) sheen alav ella mitzvat haddibbur laosim, laze veze haddavar ze yatza mehakkelal hammushlal veyesh lo laasoto lehakeriv karbenotav shiva yamim, veamro veze letzad shekkadam vetzivva sheyyalbishennu leaharon ulevanav, vegamar omer veze gam ken taase. veim lo amar asher taase ella "lekach par" vegomer, yesh makom lomar ki yetzavve leaharon o levanav laasot, laze amar "asher taase" ki hu haose. veleheyot sheyyesh makom lomar shello huchshar lehakeriv ella karban shaa shehem karbenot yeme hammilluim shel aharon uvanav, aval karban shehu kavua ledorot shehem hattemidim shel keves echad babboker vecheves echad ben haarbayim – lo, laze chazar veamar veze asher taase vegomer kevasim bene shana shenayim layyom tamid. veshello yavin ki huttar bemaase hakkarbanot tamid, laze amar "veze", lomar en lo lehakeriv ella shiva yamim haamurim bainyan.

Veamro haddavar titbaer leman deamar beyoma (yoma 4,1) milluim kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev, laze amar veze haddavar kol haddavar haamur kan leikkuv, uleman deamar davar sheen meakkev ledorot en meakkev bammilluim, amro haddavar lomar velo kol davar meakkev.
Lekach par vegomer. ulay ki reshut netuna lehavi o mishshel aharon uvanav o mishshel moshe, veen ikkuva baddavar.

rashi: Vehem yikchu. otam chachme lev sheyyaasu habbegadim yekabbelu min hammitnaddevim et hazzahav veet hattechelet laasot mehen et habbegadim:
Vechikkar lechem. min hachallot:
Vechallat lechem shemen. mimmin harvucha:

Verakik. min harkikin, echad measara shebbechol min vamin. velo matzinu terumat lechem habba im zevach nikteret ella zo bilvad, shetterumat lachme toda veel nazir netuna lakkohanim im chaze veshok, umizze lo haya lemoshe lemana ella chaze bilvad:
Vehaharel. hu gova gag hammizbeach min hassovev ulemala; uvevayit olamim lo haya ella shalosh (zevachim 60.); veyonatan af hu tirgem kan: "umadbecha arba ammin":
targum: Umadbecha arba amin umimadbecha uleela karnata arba:

rashi: Lev sameach yetiv geha. keshehaadam sameach bechelko, panav meirin:
targum: Libba chadya mashpir gufa verucha rechichta meyabbesha garma:

rashi: Al karnot. lemala bakkeranot mammash:
Veet kol haddam. sheyare haddam:
El yesod hammizbeach. kemin belitat bet kibbul asuy lo saviv saviv, leachar sheala amma min haaretz:

Shete chetefot vegomer. hassinar millematta vecheshev haefod hi hachagora, utzemuda lo milmala dugmat sinar hannashim, umiggabbo shel kohen hayu mechubbarot bacheshev shete chatichot kemin shete retzuot rechavot, achat keneged kol katef vechatef, vezokfan al shete chitfotav ad shennikpalot lefanav keneged hechaze, veay chibburan letabbeot hachoshen neechazin millefanav keneged libbo sheen noflot, kemo shemmeforash bainyan, vehayu zekufot veholchot keneged ketefav ushete avne hashoham kevuot bahen achat bechol achat:

El shene ketzotav. el rachbo shel efod, shello haya rachbo ella keneged gabbo shel kohen vegavho ad keneged haatzilim, shekkorin 420 belaaz, shenne lo yachgeru bayyaza (Yechezkel 44) – en chogrin bimkom zea, lo lemala meatzilehem velo lematta mimmatnehem ella keneged atzilehem:
Vechubbar. haefod im otan shete chitfot haefod yechabber otam bemachat lematta bacheshev, velo yeergem immo ella orgam levad veachar kach mechabberam:
Vehaya fi rosho. pi hammeil shebbegavho – hu petichat bet hatztzavvar:
Betocho. ketargumo kafil legavve, kaful letocho, lihyot lo lesafa kefilato, vehaya maase oreg velo vemachat:
Kefi tachra. lamadnu shehashshiryonim shellahem pihem kaful:
Lo yikkarea. kede shello yikkarea; vehakkoro over belav, shezze mimminyan lavin shebbattora, vechen velo yizzach hachoshen, vechen lo yasuru mimmennu hanneemar bevadde haaron:

Choshen mishpat. shemmechapper al kilkul haddin. davar acher, mishpat shemmevarer devarav vehavetachato emet, dareyshenatenat belaaz; shehammishpat meshammesh shalosh leshonot, divre taanot habbaale dinim ugemar haddin veonesh haddin, im onesh mita, im onesh makkot, im onesh mamon, veze meshammesh leshon berur devarim, shemmefaresh umevarer devarav:
Kemaase efod. maase choshev umechameshet minin:
Leshochni vetocham. al menat lishkon ani betocham:
ohc: Ani Adonai elohehem. taam shekkafal lomar ken paam sheniyya, ulay shennitkavven lerabbot afillu bizman sheen shechinato betochenu hu Adonai elohenu velo anachnu. o yirtze al ze hadderech bidiatam uvehakkaratam haddavar, keamro battechilla "veyadu" vegomer, baze yihyu reuyim likro shemi alehem lomar Adonai elohehem, aval zulat ze yifreku ol veyihyu lelohim acherim bemakom acher:

rashi: Hachelev hamechasse et hakkerev. hu hakkerum sheal hakkeres, shekkorin tylo:
Veet hayyoteret. hu tarpesha dechavda, shekkorin aybareysh:
Al hakkaved. af min hakkaved tol immah (sifra):
Lereach nichoach. al hammincha neemar, shemminchat nesachim kullah kalil, veseder hakeravatam haevarim battechilla veachar kach hammincha, shenneemar ola umincha:
Veshibbatzta. ase otam mishbetzot mishbetzot, vechullah shel shesh:
Lechok olam meet bene yisrael. shehashshelamim labbealim, veet hechaze veet hashshok yittenu lakkohen:
Ki teruma hu. hechaze veshok hazze:
Veim kalon. tavo cherpa – mi shebbocher bekalon veniuf, cherpa hi lo:
targum: Kad ate rashia beshatyuta yete uvetzaara uvechisuda:

rashi: Gam mitrappe vimlachto. poresh min hattora vehu talmid chacham:
Levaal mashchit. lassatan:
targum: Veaf demitrappe baavidteh chavra hu legavra mechabbelana:

rashi: Al hakkippurim. bishvil hakkippurim, lechapper al hammizbeach mikkol zarut vetiuv; ulefi shenne shivat yamim temalle yadam, en li ella davar habba bishvilam, kegon haelim vehallechem, aval habba bishvil hammizbeach, kegon par shehu lechittuy hammizbeach, lo shamanu, lechach hutzrach mikra ze; umidrash tko omer kapparat hammizbeach hutzrecha shemma hitnaddev ish devar gezel bimlechet hammishkan vehammizbeach:
Vechitteta. utedakke, leshon mattenat damim hannetunim beetzba karuy chittuy:
Umashachta oto. beshemen hammishcha, vechol hammeshichot kemin chi:
Tamid. miyyom el yom – velo yafsik yom bentayim:

Asher ivvaed lachem. kesheekba moed ledabber elecha, sham ekbaennu lavo. veyesh merabbotenu lomdim mikkan shemmeal mizbach hannechoshet haya hakkabba medabber im moshe mishshehukam hammishkan, veyesh omrim meal hakkapporet, kemo shenneemar vedibbarti ittecha meal hakkapporet (Shemot 26), vaasher ivvaed lachem haamur kan eno amur al hammizbeach ella al ohel moed hannizkar bammikra:
Veissaron solet. asirit haefa – 43 betzim vechomesh betza:

Beshemen katit. lo lechova neemar katit, ella lehacheshir, lefi shenneemar katit lammaor – umashma lammaor velo lammenachot – yachol lefaslo lammenachot, talo kan katit velo neemar katit lammaor, ella lemaet menachot sheen tzarich katit, sheaf hattachun barechayim kasher bahen (menachot 86):
Reva hahin. shelosha luggin:

Venesech. lassefalim, kemo sheshshaninu vemassechet sukka (48) – shene sefalim shel kesef hayu verosh hammizbeach umenukkavim kemin shene chotamin dakkim, noten hayyayin letocho vehu mekalleach veyotze derech hachotem venofel al gag hammizbeach, umishsham yored lashshitin, bemizbach bet olamim, uvemizbach hannechoshet yored min hammizbeach laaretz:
Uvehaalot. kesheyyadlikem lehaalot lahavetan:
Yaktirenna. bechol yom, peras maktir shacharit uferas maktir ben haarbayim (keritut 6):
Sifte chesil yavou veriv. kol devarav baim bilshon tigra:
Ufiv lemahalumot yikra. kore leyissurin lahaviam alav:
targum: Sifvateh desichla maytan leh ledina ufumeh maste leh lecharta:

rashi: Behetivo. leshon nikkuy habbazichin shel hammenora middeshen happetilot shennisrefu vallayla, vehaya metivan bechol boker vavoker:
Hannerot. laveshaysh belaaz, vechen kol nerot haamurot bammenora, chutz mimmakom shenneemar sham haalaa shehu leshon hadelaka:
Veet shete ketzot shel shete avotot, shene rashehem shel kol achat.

Titten al shete hammishbetzot. hen hen hakketuvot lemala, ben parashat hachoshen ufarashat haefod, velo peresh et tzarkan veet mekoman, achshav mefaresh sheyyitka bahen rashe haavotot hattechuvot betabbeot hachoshen layyamin velassemol etzel hatztzavvar; shene rashe sharsheret hayemanit tokea bemmishbetzot shel yamin, vechen beshel semol shene rashe hashsharsheret hassemalit:
Venatatta. hammishbetzot

Al kitfot haefod, achat bezo veachat bezo, nimtzeu kitfot haefod machazikin et hachoshen shello yippol, uvahen hu taluy, vaadayin sefat hachoshen hattachtona holechet uvaa venokeshet al kereso veenah devuka lo yafe, lechach hutzrach od shete tabbaot letachtito, kemo shemmefaresh veholech:

El mul panav. shel efod, shello yitten hammishbetzot beever hakketefot shekkelafe hammeil, ella baever haelyon shekkelappe hachutz, vehu karuy mul panav shel efod, ki oto ever sheeno nire eno karuy panim:
Veatta hakerev elecha. leachar shettiggamer melechet hammishkan:
ohc: Veatta hakerev elecha. taam amro veatta, gam amar leshon hakerava, gam amar tevat elecha, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 3,17) ki hakkehuna lemoshe hayta lemana, ella letzad shemmeen lalechet bidvar Adonai achar kamma peamim chara Adonai bo vehesiro miggevirat hakkehuna, beamro (Shemot 4:14) "halo aharon achicha hallevi", perush shehaya levi veachshav naasa kohen, ad kan. laze amar lo bishat maase veatta, perush, lo letzad sheani metzavvecha levad ella gam atta mitztzad atzmecha hakerev et aharon bimkomcha vetaase haddavar keillu atta chafetz bo, ki ze lecha bimkom karban lechappara al asher heazta panecha lifne Adonai. veamro elecha lechapparatcha, behakeriv et aharon veyitten lo gedullato, en lecha karban gadol mizze.

Od yirmoz beamro hakerev elecha, ki al yede chet haadam mitrachek bechinat anaf nishmato shekkeneged oto anaf shebbo chata mishsharsho, haggadol kefi gadlo vehakkatan vechulei, vehinne beemtzaut hahaftzarot shehiftzir bishlichut Adonai garam lehitrachakut anaf echad meanfe nishmato mishsharshah, vahagam ki Adonai heenisho, af al pi chen kol od shello kibbel haonesh happegam omed bimkomo veharachok odennu meruchak, laze bishat tachlit haddavar hodio ki baze yihye mitkarev harachok, vehu amro veatta hakerev elecha, perush, hakerev leatzmecha, perush livchinatcha sherchoka beemtzaut hachet hahu, venitkavven Adonai lehodio ki ze tikkuno (Shemot 4:13).

Umizze ani maskil al davar sheamru zichronam livracha besof berachot (54:) chayyav adam levarech al haraa keshem shehu mevarech al hattova vechulei, umefaresh baggemara (sham 60:) lekabbel haraa besimcha keshem shessameach battova, ad kan. vehaya haddavar ketzat beenay rachok, veal pi haddevarim haamurim bainyan hinne hayyissurin hem makrivin anfe hanneshama shehayu rechokim mishsharsham, sheen lecha ra vamar keazvo et Adonai elohav, uveemtzaut hayyissurin yitkarev harachok, veal ze yismach lev hammaskil. veamar veasita vigde kodesh vegomer lechavod uletifaret shehem hem simane hassimcha sheyyare shechafetz vedibber lefaaro, asher ze hu sanuy leose haddavar letzad hahechreach, vahagam shehabbegadim hem chovat gavra haomed lesharet, im kol ze ratza Adonai lezakkot legalgel zechut ze al yado sheyyaase otam lechibba ulesimcha beachiv, vedavar ze hu bechinat neshama lanneshama beikkar maase ze. veulay shennitkavven Adonai lomar lo sheyyaase habbegadim mishshello, vahagam sheshshaninu (mishna yoma 83 47) bigde hakkohanim baim mishshel tzibbur, hare amru sheyyachid yachol lehitnaddevam ulemasram latztzibbur, uchemo chen tzivva Adonai laasot.

rashi: Kaas leaviv ben kesil. kegon yaravam kaas hu lehakkadosh baruch hu (Melachim 1 12:26-33):
Umemer leyoladto. lichneset yisrael, shehecheti otam:
targum: Bera sichla machbid avuy umemarmir leimeh:

rashi: Verachatzta. zo tevilat kol hagguf:

ohc: Ki kodesh hu. perush, velaze yissaref.

rashi: Hakkohanim haleviyyim. asher mishshevet levi:
Mizzera tzadok. lefi shehaya kohen gadol sheshshimmesh rishon bammikdash bime shelomo (Melachim 1 2:27, la), nikreu al shemo:
targum: Vetitten lechahanaya levae di inun mizara detzadok dekarivin lefulechani amar Adonai elohim leshamasha kodamay tor bar tore lechatata:

rashi: Ish al shemo. keseder toldotam seder haavanim, odem liruven, pitda leshimon, vechen kullam:
Al shene ketzot hachoshen. hen shete feotav hattachtonot layyamin velassemol:

Al sefato asher el ever haefod bayta. hare lecha shene simanin, haechad sheyyittenem bishne ketzavot shel tachtito shehu cheneged haefod, sheelyono eno cheneged haefod, shehare samuch latztzavvar hu vehaefod natun al matnav, veod natan siman, shello yikbaem beever hachoshen shekkelappe hachutz, elle baever shekkelappe penim, shenneemar bayta, veoto haever hu letzad haefod, shecheshev haefod chogro hakkohen venikpal hassinar lifne hakkohen al matnav, uketzat kereso mikkan umikkan ad keneged ketzot hachoshen uketzotav shochvin alav:
Tzalotav. kan hu leshon zaviyyot, ketargumo, lefi shenneemar al shene tziddav – al shete zaviyyot shebbishne tziddav:
Vehaya. maase hattabbaot haelle:
Levattim levaddim. bayit tihye hattabbaat labbad:
Veasita mishbetzot. miut mishbetzot shetayim; velo peresh lecha atta befarasha zo ella mikketzat tzarkan, uvefarashat hachoshen gomer lecha perushan:
Bemakom kadosh. bachatzar ohel moed, shehashshelamim hallalu kadshe kadashim hayu:
Al kappe aharon: vehenafta. shenehem asukim bitnufa – habbealim vehakkohen, ha ketzad? kohen manniach yado tachat yad habbealim umenif; uvaze hayu aharon uvanav bealim, umoshe kohen:

Tenufa. molich umevi lemi shearba ruchot haolam shello; tenufa meakkevet umevattelet puranuyyot veruchot raot, maale umorid lemi shehashshamayim vehaaretz shello, umeakkevet telalim raim (menachot 62):
Takriv seir izzim. ze lo haya bammishkan; uvammilluim shel leatid lavo – kach hem al pi haddibbur:
targum: Uveyoma tinyana takriv tzefir bar izay shelim lechatata vetidke yat madbecha kema dedakkiu betora:

rashi: Venatatta et shete avotot hazzahav. hen hen sharshot gavlut hakketuvot lemala, velo peresh mekom kibbuan bachoshen, achshav mefaresh lecha sheyyehe tochev otan battabbaot; veteda lach shehen hen harishonot, shehare befarashat elle fekude lo huchpelu:

Uven atzumim yafrid. ellu baale dinin, kemo "haggishu atzumotehem" (yeshaya 41:21). uvammishna (sanhedrin lo:): shenayim shennitatztzemu vaddin. al shem shemmerivotam atzumot keruyim atzumim, o leshon 'chozek o leshon 'otem, kemo "otzem enav" (yeshaya 33:15):
targum: Tigre mevatla fitzta uvenat takife farsha:

rashi: Vaase lahem. leaharon ulevanav:
Michnese vad. hare shemona vegadim lechohen gadol vearbaa lechohen hedyot:
ohc: Vaase lahem michnese vad. kashe lamma icher mitzvat hammichnasayim? veyesh lomar, letzad sheamar "vehilbashta otam et aharon", laze icher hammichnasayim lomar sheeno chozer alav mitzvat "vehilbashta" vegomer. veen lomar sheyyechavven lomar shettihye levishatam baacharona, shehare amar hakkatuv bemakom acher (Vayikra 16:4) "umichnese vad yihyu al besaro", vedarshu beyoma (yoma 23.) shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim, ella vadday lattaam shekkatavnu.

Od nire shennitkavven lechatvo baacharona ulehasmich lo mitzvat "vehayu al aharon" vegomer (Shemot 28:43) "velo yisu avon vametu", veim haya kollo im shear begadim veomer "vehayu al aharon" vegomer, tavo hassevara lomar ki lo baa haazhara ella al shear begadim, aval hammichnasayim enam baim ella kede shello tiggale erva veen bahem tzorech kedushshat avoda, laze amaram levassof vesamach lahem haazhara vehaonesh, lomar ki meakkev hu likdushshat hakkehunna kishar begadim.

rashi: Mechatte. milletaher:
targum: Beshetzayutach mildakkaa takriv tor bar tore shelim udechar min ana shelim:

rashi: Miktar ketoret. lehaalot alav kittur ashan sammim:
ohc: Veasita mizbeach vegomer. taam shessidder keli ze shel penim meuchar mikkol hammishkan vaavodato, kevar perashti befarashat teruma befasuk (Shemot 25:9) "vechen taasu". veamro taase lemaet maase sheasa shelomo shello haya atze shittim shehayu kullo zahav.
Chassalat parashat tetzavve

rashi: Vekiddashta et chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma vegomer. kaddeshem ledorot, lihyot noheget terumatam vahanafatam bechaze veshok shel shelamim, aval lo lehaketara, ella vehaya leaharon ulevanav leechol:
Tenufa. leshon holacha vahavaa, 110 belaaz:
Huram. leshon maale umorid:
ohc: Measher leaharon umeasher vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar, veulay sheyyechavven lomar shello yochal mikkol chaze veshok hannittanim leaharon ulevanav zulat ellu.

rashi: Veelle middot hammizbeach. shemmefaresh lematta: arba esre orech bearba esre rochav:
Baammot amma amma vatofach. beamma bat shishsha, shehi amma vatofach beamma bat chamishsha:

Vechek haamma. aval hayesod shello nimdad baamma shel chol, shehi bat chamishsha; chek leshon chikkuy ukeviut, vehu hayesod; haamma ammat chol, velo amma vatofach, shehi amma bat shishsha; vechen shaninu bimnachot (menachot 97.-97:), shehayesod vehassovev vehakkeranot nimdadin beamma bat chamishsha:
Vechek haamma. ze hayesod:
Veamma rochav. ze hassovev:
Ugevulah el sefatah saviv zeret haechad. ellu hakkeranot; zeret echad meemtzaito moddo zeret lechol ruach, hare amma al amma:

Veze gav hammizbeach. uveamma zo haya nimdad gav mizbach hazzahav "amma arko veamma rachbo ravua" (Shemot 37:25), kach meforash beeruvin, uvimnachot (daf 97:) meforash yoter lefi hacheshbon: chek haamma begovhah ala amma veamma rochav, kansa kenisat hassovev amma bat chamishsha, aval aliyyato sheshshaninu ala chamesh vechanas amma eno beamma bat chamishsha:
Ugevulah el sefatah. hakkeranot, ben lerachban ben legavhan, beamma bat chamishsha:
targum: Veilen mishchat madbecha beamaya beamta dehi ama ufeshach vetashvita amta veamta futeya ugedanfa makaf lah al sifte sechor sechor zerta chada veden tikus madbecha:

rashi: Meerev ad boker. ten lah middatah shettehe doleket meerev vead boker, veshiaru chachamim chatzi log lelele tevet haarukkin vechen lechol hallelot, veim yivvater en bechach kelum (menachot 89):
ohc: Meet bene yisrael. yitbaer al derech ma sheamru betosefta dishkalim (tosefta shekalim 2): kol karbenot hatztzibbur shennitnaddevu meatzman kesherim, uvilvad sheyyimserum latztzibbur, ad kan leshonam. vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv meet bene yisrael, perush ki shemen ze karban tzibbur, velaze lu yihye sheyyitnaddevo yachid, tzarich sheyyimserem latztzibbur, vetihye havaato lammishkan meet bene yisrael.

rashi: Meshubbatzim zahav yihyu. hatturim bemilluotam – mukkafim mishbetzot zahav beomek shiur sheyyitmalle beovi haeven, zehu leshon bemilluotam, keshiur milluy avyan shel avanim yihye omek hammishbetzot, lo fachot velo yoter:
Seet pene rasha lo tov. kaasher pershu rabbotenu (yoma paz.): lo tov lahem larshaim shennosim lahem panim baolam hazze venifrain mehen laolam habba:
Tov vegomer. tov lahem latztzaddikim shemmachriin lahem kaf moznayim lechayyevam baolam hazze venifrain mehen bechayyehen laolam habba. ulefi peshuto – kemashmao:
targum: Lemesav appe lerashia la shappir af la lemitzle dina letzadika:

rashi: Lekaddesho lechahano li. lekaddesho lehacheniso bichhunna ay habbegadim sheyyehe chohen li, uleshon kehunna sherut hu, shanetareyah belaaz:
ohc: Veatta tedabber. taam amro veatta, shetztzarich hu beatzmo lehittappel baddavar ledabber lechachme lev, vahagam sheamar "veasita bigde" vegomer, chazar Adonai uferesh devarav ki lo hu yaase ella al piv yihyu naasim. uchede shello yavin shehaikkar hu sheyyihyu naasim al pi moshe veen tzorech baddavar sheyyedabber moshe mippiv el chachme lev, laze baa hammitzva veamar veatta beficha tedabber el kol vegomer.

Vedikdek lomar el kol, ki ze hu echad missimanim hammuvhakim shehaddavar hu mehashelamat haddaat umertzon hallev, sheyyedabber haddevarim lechullam yachad. sheim haya haddavar ba bedaavon nefesh, yishtaddel lomar haddevarim shello bifne rabbim, vechol od sheyyachol ledabber devarav lifne echad lo yedabber bifne shenayim, ki haddavar hu pechitut lemoshe shello yihye hu rauy lesharet lifne hammelech. asher al ken tzivva Adonai laasot siman laddavar "el kol chachme lev", uvaze yivvada leene hakkol ki nefesh chafetza velev shalem.

Od nire ki taam sheamar Adonai bachamishsha pesukim ellu shalosh peamim veatta, ki va latet lo maala bishlosha devarim, vehem: nidvat hammishkan bichlaluteha echad, umelechet hammishkan vechelav uvigde kehuna echad, vaavodat bet hammikdash echad. veamar Adonai elav ki hu notel sachar keillu hu asa hakkol. keneged havaat nidvat hammishkan amar veatta tetzavve vegomer, veelecha hem meviin, vehu ma sheggamar omer veyikchu elecha, perush, ani lecha metzavve lehavi vehem yaviu elecha laasot. ucheneged melechet hammishkan amar veatta tedabber el kol chachme lev, uvaze enam ella sheluchecha. vedikdek lomar el kol kede shekkol hammaasim sheyyihyu naasim bammishkan yihyu naasim bishlichutecha ucheillu hu asaam. ucheneged avodat bet Adonai amar veatta hakerev elecha et aharon vegomer, sheyyavo veyaavod bishlichutecha, velaze dikdek lomar elecha. uletaam ze metzavve Adonai el moshe kol maase hammishkan umelachto vaavodato lenocheach, ki achar haemet alav hu hammetzuvve, ella shetztzivva lo shehu yetzavve acherim bimkomo.

rashi: Migdal oz shem Adonai bo yarutz tzaddik venisgav. vehu mitchazzek:
targum: Magdela deushena shemeh delaha uveh nirhat tzadika venitterim beh:

rashi: Chosech amarav. mi shehu yodea daat eno marbe bidvarim:
Yekar ruach. monea devarim ish tevuna:
targum: Dechasech miloy yadea yediata vedimchicha rucheh gavra demitbayen:

rashi: Umashachta oto. af meshicha zo kemin chi, noten shemen al rosho uven risse enav umechabberan beetzbao (keritut Adonai):
ohc: Veyatzakta al rosho umashachta. perush, tzarich yetzika al rosho vetzarich meshicha bifne atzmo, uchemo chen levanav, ki hakkatuv hishva otam yachad, dichtiv "umashachta otam" (Shemot 28:41), uchemo chen befarashat pekude (Shemot 40:15) katuv "umashachta otam kaasher mashachta et avihem", vechen hu meforash betorat kohanim (parashat tzav).

rashi: Et gaggo. ze haya lo gag, aval mizbach haola lo haya lo gag ella memalleim chalalo adama bechol chaniyyatan:
Zer zahav. siman hu lecheter kehunna:
Atta ven adam hagged et bet yisrael et habbayit veyikkalmu meavonotehem. behareoti lamo chasdi sheeni moasam baavonam, matzati:
Umaddu et tachnit. umaddu al yadecha, sheatta more et tochen cheshbon habbinyan:
targum: At bar adam chavi yat bet yisrael yat beta veyitkanun mechovehon veyimshechun yat tikuseh:

rashi: Vehayta lahem. milluy yadayim ze lichhunnat olam:
Umilleta. al yede haddevarim haelle:
Yad aharon veyad banav. beminnuy ufekuddat hakkehunna:
ohc: Umilleta yad aharon veyad banav. perush, sheyyimshach aharon uvanav kemo sheamar lemala (Shemot 28:41) "umashachta otam umilleta et yadam", vechan lo hizkir hammeshicha uremazah beamro "umilleta et yadam".

rashi: Vehaariel shetem esre orech. mekom hammaaracha haya esrim vearba al esrim vearba (middot 3:1), vezehu shetem esre bishtem esre:

El arbaat revaav. shemmeemtzaito hu moded shetem esre lechol ruach, hare esrim vearba al esrim vearba. kach meforash bizvachim (59:). vechen shaninu bemassechet middot (3:1): hammizbeach haya sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim, ala amma vechanas amma, ze hayesod, nimtza sheloshim al sheloshim. ala chamesh vechanas amma, ze hassovev, nimtza esrim ushemone al esrim ushemone. mekom hakkeranot amma mizze veamma mizze, nimtza esrim veshesh al esrim veshesh. mekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim amma mizze veamma mizze, nimtza esrim vearba al esrim vearba mekom hammaaracha:
targum: Umadbecha tarta asre ureka betarta asre puteya merubba al arbea sitrohi:

rashi: Zeret orko vezeret rochbo. kaful; umuttal lo lefanav keneged libbo, shenneemar vehayu al lev aharon, taluy bechitfot haefod habbaot meachorav al ketefav venikpalot veyordot lefanav meat, vehachoshen taluy bahen besharsherot vetabbaot kemo shemmeforash bainyan:

Veyirkesu. leshon chibbur; vechen meruchse ish (Tehillim 31) – chibbure chevle reshaim, vechen veharchasim levika (Yeshayahu 40) – harim hassemuchim ze laze, shei efshar lered laggay shebbenehem ella vekoshi gadol, shemmittoch semichatan haggay zekufa vaamukka – yehe levikat mishor venocha lelech:
Lihyot al cheshev haefod. lihyot hachoshen davuk el cheshev haefod:
Velo yizzach. leshon nittuk; uleshon aravi hu kedivre dunash ben lavrat:

Vehaazara arba esre orech. gag hammizbeach im mekom hakkeranot veim mekom ragle hakkohanim esrim ushemone al esrim ushemone, vearba esre haamurim kan – meemtzaito moded, kemo shemforash: el arbaat revaeha:
Vehaggevul saviv otah. yonatan tirgem: "vegadnefa", verabbotenu pershuhu al hakkeranot (zevachim sav:):
Chatzi haamma. meemtzaito moded; nimtza amma al amma:
Vehachek lah amma. zo kenisat hayesod:

Umaalotehu penot kadim. vechevesh sheolim bo haya baddarom, kede sheyyehe haole bo pone lammizrach; shekkol happeniyyot hayu derech yamin; uchesheatta noten hakkevesh baddarom, haole bo ufone derech yamin pone lammizrach:
targum: Umisamta arba asre futeya al arba sitraha ugedanfa makaf lah sechor sechor palgut amta vetashvita lah amta sechor sechor vedargan desalkin la mitpanan lemadincha:

rashi: Vehayu al aharon. kol habbegadim haelle, al aharon haruyin lo:
Veal banav. haamurin bahem:
Bevoam el ohel moed. lahechol, vechen lammishkan:
Vametu. ha lamadta shehameshammesh mechussar begadim bemita.
Chukkat olam lo. kol makom shenneemar chukkat olam hu gezera miyyad uledorot, leakkev bo (menachot 19):
Ruach ish. ruach gever shehu ish gibbor veeno noten deaga belibbo umekabbel kol habba alav besimcha uvechibba:
Yechalkel machalehu. en kocho sar mealav:
targum: Rucheh degavra tesovar kurhaneh verucha mechichta man natineh:

rashi: Et meil haefod. shehaefod natun alav lachagora:
Kelil techelet. kullo techelet, sheen min acher meorav bo:
Tenuch. hu hassechus haemtzai shebbetoch haozen, shekkorin 329 belaaz:
Bohen yadam. haggudal uvapperek haemtzai (sifra):
Venoadti shamma. etvaed immam bedibbur, kemelech hakkovea mekom moed ledabber im avadav sham:
Venikdash. hammishkan:

Bichvodi. – shettishre shechinati bo. umidrash aggada al tikre bichvodi ella bichvuday – bimchubbadim shelli – kan ramaz lo mitat bene aharon beyom hakamato, vezehu sheamar moshe hu asher dibber Adonai lemor bikrovay ekkadesh, vehechan dibber? venikdash bichvodi (zevachim 115):
ohc: Venoadti shamma livne yisrael venikdash vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat hakkatuv ma ba lelammedenu beamro venoadti shamma livne yisrael. veyerae ki va latet taam lema sheomer bigmar devarav venikdash bichvodi, veamru zichronam livracha (zevachim 115:) shekkan neemar lemoshe "bikrovay ekkadesh" (Vayikra 10:3), laze hikdim lomar venoadti shamma livne yisrael, perush, letzad sheani mezammen shechinati livne yisrael choshshani lahem mippirtzat gader umiut kavod mehem, laze tzarich lekaddesho bikrovay kede sheyyiru mimmikdashi. veramaz lo shello hutzrach asot davar ella letzad yisrael, aval letziddo eno tzarich leiyyum ze.

rashi: Veim nichlemu. sheyyitbayyeshu veyichbeshu fenehem mikkol asher asu, az hoda otam et ma sheani atid laasot lahem:
Tzurat habbayit. ugevul habbinyan, heach hu millefanav vead acharav sedurim learba ruchotav:
Utechunato. cheshbon taav velishkotav:
Vechol tzurotav. keruvim vetimorim veelim veelammim, matzati:
Kol tzurato. batra. lo porash:

Veyishmeru. yilmedu inyene hammiddot mippicha, sheyyedu laasotam leet ketz. matzati, reuya hayta bia sheniyya shel ezra kevia rishona shel yehoshua lavo bizroa uvenes, kiddarshinan "ad yaavor" (Shemot 15:16), uvinyan ze meaz haya rauy lahem keshealu min haggola ligullat olam, ella sheggaram hachet shello hayta teshuvatam hogenet al menat shello lachato, veyatzu birshut koresh uvanu leatzman. veyesh omrim bevavel nichshelu benachriyyot (Ezra 9:1-2):
targum: Veim yitkanaun mikkol daavedu vemechzehon tzurat beta vetikuseh umafkanohi umaalanohi vechol tzurate veyat kol gezerate vechol tzurate vechol dachaze leh hoda yathon uchetov leenehon veyitrun yat kol tzurate veyat kol gezerate veyabedun yathon:

rashi: Nezer hakkodesh. ze hatztzitz:
Al hammitznefet. kemo shepperashti lemala – al yede happetil haemtzai ushene fetilin shebberosho, hakkeshurin shelashtan meachore haoref, hu notno al hammitznefet kemin kova:
Shivat yamim. retzufin:
Yilbasham hakkohen. asher yakum mibbanav tachtav lichhunna gedola, kesheyyemannuhu lihyot kohen gadol:
Asher yavo el ohel moed. oto chohen hammuchan likkanes lifnay velifnim beyom hakkippurim, vezehu chohen gadol, sheen avodat yom hakkippurim keshera ella bo:
Tachtav mibbanav. melammed sheim yesh lo lechohen gadol ben memalle et mekomo, yemannuhu chohen gadol tachtav:
(Hakkohen tachtav mibbanav. mikkan reaya kol leshon chohen foel oved mammash, lefichach niggun tevir nimshach lefanav):

Vezarakta. bichli; ochez bammizrak vezorek keneged hakkeren kede sheyyerae lechan ulechan, veen karban taun mattana beetzba ella chattat bilvad, aval shear zevachim enan teunin keren velo etzba, shemmattan damam mechatzi hammizbeach ulematta, veeno ole bakkevesh ella omed baaretz vezorek (zevachim 53):

Saviv. kach meforash bishchitat kadashim sheen saviv ella shete mattanot shehen arba, haachat bekeren zavit zo, vehaachat shekkenegdah baalachson, vechol mattana niret bishne tzidde hakkeren elach vaelach, nimtza haddam natun bearba ruchot saviv, lechach karuy saviv:

Al hachoshen. letzorech hachoshen – kede lekavam bo: velo yittachen lomar shettehe techillat asiyyatan alav, sheim ken ma hu shechozer veomer venatatta et shete hattabbaot vahalo chevar netunin bo? haya lo lichtov bitchillat hammikra veasita al ketzot hachoshen shete tabbeot zahav, veaf besharsherot tzarich atta liftor ken:
Al shene ketzot hachoshen. lishte peot shekkeneged hatztzavvar, laymanit velassemalit, habbaim mul kitfot haefod:

Sagur yihye. rabbotenu heemidu hammikra hazze befishpash hadderomi shehaya leshaar hahechol; pishpash – petach katan. kach shaninu bemassechet middot (4, 2): shene fishpashin hayu lo lashshaar haggadol, echad bedarom veechad betzafon; shebbedarom – lo nichnas bo adam meolam, alav meforash al yede yechezkel: hashshaar hazze yihye sagur:
Ba vo. leatid lavo:
targum: Vaamar Adonai li tera haden achid yehe vela yitpetach veenash la yeol beh are Adonai elaha deyisrael itgele alohi vihe achid:

rashi: Et hannasi nasi hu vegomer. et hannasi ani noten reshut, nasi hu vechashuv, veen darko leshev veleechol im shear hakkohanim balleshachot:
Hu yeshev bo leechol lechem. betoch chalalo:

Midderech ulam hashshaar yavo. keshehu nichnas letoch hechatzer happenimit kede likkanes leshaar katan ze leechol bo, derech ulam hashshaar haazara shebbemizrach yikkanes letoch haazara, uvo badderech yashuv kesheyyashuv yetze beoto hadderech shennichnas. ulefi shehu omer lematta (Yechezkel 46:9) beinyan "uvevo am haaretz lifne Adonai bammoadim habba derech vegomer", shetztzivva laasot haazara kappandarya – lefi sheotah bia liriyyat panim vetzarich leheraot yafe, hutzrach lomar kan beviot shel kol yemot hashshana shello yaasenna kappandarya (berachot 9,5), lefi sheen bia zo liriyyat panim kemo shel regalim; vechen heid od lematta bainyan peamim rabbot:
Matzati. et hannasi. kohen gadol nasi hu, umechashivuto yehe rashshay leechol basar vlechem kadashim bo oto shaar sheppotchin lo bishat achilato:
Midderech ulam hashshaar yavo. derech ulam shaar mizrachi yikkanes laazara, veyavo ad oto pishpash leechol bo lachmo:
Umiddarko yetze. sheen ze rauy lekappandarya kishar shearim, vechol hayyom shello bishat achilat hannasi yihye sagur:
targum: Lerabba yehe rabba hu yetev beh lemechal lachma kodam Adonai meorach ulema detara yeol umeorcheh yippok:

rashi: Sharsherot zahav. shalshelaot:
Migbalot. lesof gevul hachoshen taase otam:
Maase avot. maase keliat chutin, velo maase nekavim uchefalim keotan sheosin levorot, ella keotan sheosin leardaskaot shekkorin aneshaneshaveyresh belaaz:

Venatatta et sharsherot. shel avotot haasuyot maase avot al mishbetzot hallalu; velo ze hu mekom tzavvaat asiyyatan shel sharsherot, velo tzavvaat keviatan, en taase haamur kan leshon tziuuy, veen venatatta haamur kan leshon tziuuy, ella leshon atid, ki befarashat hachoshen chozer umetzavve al asiyyatan veal keviatan, velo nichtav kan ella lehodia mikketzat tzorech hammishvetzot shetztzivva laasot im haefod, vechatav lecha zot lomar lecha hammishbetzot hallalu yizzakku lecha, lichshettaase sharsherot migbalot al hachoshen, tittenem al hammishbetzot hallalu:
Umechek haaretz. min hayesod, mikkarka haaretz:
Ad haazara hattachtona. ad gav malben harishon:
Shetayim ammot. velo haya chen bevet olamim, sheshsham shaninu (zevachim ned.): mevi malben shel sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim, vegavho amma; vechan gavho shetayim:

Verochav amma echat. keshehinniach malben hashsheni alav, haya malben hashsheni sheloshim al sheloshim (zevachim ned.), nimtzat kenisa lo saviv saviv rochav amma vehu hayesod, hare ala shetayim vechanas amma vehu hayesod; veyonatan tirgem azara: "mesattemta", leshon ritzpa, shehaya memalle et hammalben chaluke avanim mizzefet vesid vekuneya umemache veshofech umachliko lemala (zevachim ned.), vahare hu kemin ritzpa:
Umehaazara hakketanna ad haazara haggedola arba ammot. miggag malben hattachton ad gag malben shealav, arba ammot gova:
Verochav haamma. hu kenisat hassovev, ala arbaa vechanas amma, zehu sovev. vehattachton kore ketanna lefi sheen gavho ella shetayim, vehaelyon gavho arba:
targum: Umittashvet ara ad mesatimta arita tarten amin ufuteya amta chada umimsamta zeerta ad mesamta rabbeta arba amin ufuteya amta:

rashi: Veratziti. leshon ratzon:
targum: Veyishlemun yat yomaya vihe beyoma teminaa ulehala yaavdun kahanaya al madbecha yat alvatchon veyat nichsat kudeshechon veyitkabbelun kurebanechon beraava amar Adonai elohim:

rashi: Vehikravta otam. el chatzar hammishkan beyom hakamato:
Petach ohel moed. bachatzar hammishkan shellifne happetach:
Al arba karnotav. shel mizbeach:
Pinnot haazara. gag hammizbeach:
Vechippartahu. tekannach oto midderech chol shebbo, lehacheniso bikdushsha, lihyoto rauy lechapper alav mizze ulehallan:
targum: Vetisav midmeh vetitten al arba karnateh veal arba zivyat mesamta veal techuma sechor sechor utedakke yateh utechapper alohi:

rashi: Velechem matztzot vechallot matztzot urekike matztzot. hare ellu shelosha minin revucha, vechallot urekikim lechem matztzot, hi hakkeruya lematta bainyan (pasuk 23) challat lechem shemen, al shem shennoten shemen barvucha keneged hachallot veharkikin, vechol hamminin baim eser eser challot:
Belulot bashshemen. keshehen kemach yotzek bahen shemen uvollan:
Meshuchim bashshemen. achar afiyyatan moshchan kemin chi yevanit, shehi asuya kenun shellanu:
Uchechoma nisgava. ashro lo bechadre maskito. mippene shehabbayit nirtzaf beritzpat avanim hassochchim al haaretz, karuy even maskit:
targum: Mazaleh deattira kiryeta deusheneh ucheshura yerum mishreh:

rashi: Letaava yevakkesh nifrad. mi shehu nifrad mehakkadosh baruch hu shello lishmor mitzvotav, letaavat libbo veyitzro hara hu rodef, vesof bechol tushiyya yitgalla. ben chachamim tiggale cherpato. verabbotenu derashuhu (nazir 23:) belot shennifrad meavraham al taavat libbo, shenneemar "vayyivchar lo lot et kol kikkar hayyarden" (Bereshit 13:11). kol hammikra hazze al shem niuf neemar, vesofo nitgalla kelono bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot: "lo yavo ammoni umoavi" (Devarim 23:4):
targum: Rigta bae pachya uvechol malchana mitztede:

rashi: Vechipper aharon. mattan damim:
Achat bashshana. beyom hakkippurim, hu shenneemar beachare mot veyatza el hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai vechipper alav (Vayikra 16):
Chattat hakkippurim. hem par vesair shel yom hakkippurim hamechapperim al tumat mikdash vekadashav:
Kodesh kodashim. hammizbeach mekuddash lidvarim hallalu bilvad velo laavoda acheret:
Petach ohel moed. kol hechatzer karuy ken:
Lezikkaron. sheyyehe roe hakkabba et hashshevatim ketuvim lefanav veyizkor tzidkatam:
Divre fi ish. kol ish shebbammikra leshon gibbor gadol bigvura hu:
Mekor chachma. kenachal novea uchemayim amukkim:
targum: Maya amike pumeh degavra nachala denavea mabbua dechachmeta:

rashi: Levanav acharav. lemi shebba bigdulla acharav:
Lemoshcha. lehitgaddel bahem, sheyyesh meshicha shehi leshon serara, kemo lecha netattim lemashcha (Bamidbar 18), al tiggeu bimshichay (20 16):
Ulemalle vam et yadam. al yede habbegadim hu mitlabbesh bichhunna gedola:
Al netachav. im netachav – musaf al shear hannetachim:
Velivne aharon taase chuttonot. arbaa vegadim hallalu velo yoter, kuttonet veavnet umigbaot – hi mitznefet – umichnasayim ketuvim lematta bapparasha:
ohc: Lechavod uletifaret. taam sheamar ken paam sheniyya, lirmoz ma sheamru bizvachim (zevachim 18:) veze leshonam: hayu metushetashin o mekorain veavad – avodato pesula. vetanya od sham: "bad" – sheyyihyu chadashim. veamru bashshas: chadashim in, shechakim lo, vehattanya: meshuchakim kesherim vechulei, ella lemitzva vechulei. vehu amro lechavod keneged keruim veze leikkuva, uletifaret keneged chadashim veze lemitzva. velaze hutzrach hakkatuv lomar shenehem, vezulat ze haya lo lomar "letifaret" shehu yoter meamro "lechavod".

rashi: Ach nifsha mikkiryat oz. yesh ach nifsha meachiv umeabbed bemirdo kiryat oz, kegon lot beavraham (Bereshit 13), esav beyaakov (Bereshit 27:41-43):
Umidyanim kivriach armon. umeriva shebbenehem mafridatam leolam kivriach ze shennoalim bo shaare armon, shello yikkansu bo (nazir 23,1-2):
targum: Acha demitave min achuy hech kiryeta ashinta veachara hech sochara dechusena:

rashi: Veafadta. kashshet vetakken hachagora vehassinar sevivotav:

Veasu et haefod. im bati lefaresh maase haefod vehachoshen al seder hammikraot, hare perushan perakim, veyishge hakkore betzerufan, lechach ani chotev maasehem kemot shehu, lemaan yarutz hakkore vo, veachar kach afaresh al seder hammikraot. haefod asuy kemin sinar shel nashim rochvot susim, vechoger oto meachorav keneged libbo lematta meatzilav, rachbo kemiddat rochav gabbo shel adam veyoter, umaggia ad akevav, vehacheshev mechubbar berosho al pene rachbo maase oreg, umaarich lechan ulechan kede lehakkif velachgor bo, vehakketefot mechubbarot bacheshev, echad leyamin veechad lismol, meachore hakkohen, lishne ketzot rachbo shel sinar, ucheshezzokfan omdot lo al shete chetefav, vehen kemin shete retzuot asuyot mimmin haefod, arukkot kede shiur lezakfan etzel tzavvaro mikkan umikkan venikpalot lefanav lematta mikketefav meat, veavne hashshoham kevuot bahem, achat al ketef yamin veachat al ketef semol, vehammishbetzot netunot berashehem lifne ketefav, ushete avotot hazzahav techuvot bishte tabbaot shebbachoshen, bishne ketzot rachbo haelyon, achat leyamin veachat lismol, ushene rashe hashsharsheret tekuin bammishbetzet layyamin vechen shene rashe hashsharsheret hassemalit tekuin bammishbetzet shebbechatef semol, nimtza hachoshen taluy bemishbetzot haefod al libbo millefanav, veod shete tabbaot bishne ketzot hachoshen betachtito, uchenegdam shete tabbaot bishte kitfot haefod millematta, berosho hattachton hammechubbar bacheshev; tabbeot hachoshen el mul tabbeot haefod shochvim ze al ze, umerakkesan biftil techelet tachuv betabbeot haefod vehachoshen, sheyyehe tachtit hachoshen davuk lecheshev haefod velo yehe nad venivdal, holech vechozer:

Zahav techelet veargaman tolaat shani veshesh moshzar. chameshet minim hallalu shezurin bechol chut vachut; hayu meraddedin et hazzahav kemin tassin dakkin vekotztzin petilim mehem, vetovin oto chut shel zahav im shishsha chutin shel techelet, vechut shel zahav im shishsha chutin shel argaman, vechen betolaat shani vechen bashshesh – shekkol hamminin chutan kaful shishsha vechut shel zahav im kol echad veechad – veachar kach shozer et kullam keechad, nimtza chutan kaful 28, vechen meforash bemassechet yoma, velamed min hammikra hazze vayrakkeu et pache hazzahav vekitztzetz petilim laasot – et petile hazzahav – betoch hattechelet uvetoch haargaman vegomer, lamadnu shechut shel zahav shazur im kol min vamin:
Maase choshev. kevar perashti shehu arigat shete kirot, sheen tzurot shene avareha domot zo lazo:
Tisrof baesh. lo matzinu chattat chitzona nisrefet ella zo:
Reach nichoach. nachat ruach lefanay, sheamarti venaasa retzoni:
Ishshe. leshon esh, vehi haketarat evarim sheal haesh:

ohc: Vesamach vegomer. velo amar "vesamchu", sheaharon yismoch bifne atzmo veachar kach yismechu banav. shuv ba beyadi tosefta beferek 10 dimnachot veze leshonam: chamishsha sheheviu zevach echad, kullan somchin alav, lo kullan keechad ella kol echad somech umistallek, ad kan, ufasko rambam beferek 3 mehilchot maase hakkarbanot. uchefi ze amar hakkatuv vesamach lomar sheyyismechu echad echad velo yachad. ella shetztzarich ladaat lamma amar shete peamim velo hispik beachat kemo shekkatuv bammaase befarashat tzav (Vayikra 8:18). veulay ki meechad hayiti omer ki letzad shebbo taluy hachet shealav ba hakkarban, ki hu asa haegel velo banav, laze perto lehakedimo lirmoz al haddavar, veen lemedin mimmennu lechol zevach, laze kafal veamar shete peamim vesamach leshon yachid, umeatta yesh taam nachon lamma befarashat tzav behodaat hammaase lo amar leshon yachid ella barishon, ki yaspik lallimmud sheanu tzerichin lo, ki lo huchpal bammitzva ella lehasir hattaut, vehaven:

rashi: Vehilbashta otam et aharon. otam haamurin beaharon – choshen, veefod, umeil, uchetonet tashbetz, mitznefet, veavnet, vetzitz, umichnasayim hakketuvim lematta bechullam:
Veet banav itto. otam hakketuvim bahem:
Umashachta otam. et aharon veet banav beshemen hammishcha:

Umilleta et yadam. kol milluy yadayim leshon chinnuch, keshehu nichnas ledavar lihyot muchzak bo meoto yom vahala hu: uvelshon laaz keshemmemannin adam al pekidat davar, noten hashshallit beyado bet yad shel or, shekkorin 63 belaaz, veal yado hu machaziko baddavar, vekorin leoto mesira ravevayshateyr belaaz, vehu milluy yadayim:
ohc: Vehilbashta otam vegomer umashachta vegomer. perush, achar sheyyalbishem beod habbegadim alehem yimshachem velo kodem, uvaze higgiatam hakkehunna leyadam, vehu amro umilleta et yadam. veulay ki yechavven beamro et yadam baze lomar ki beemtzaut hammaase hem nishpaim bivchinat hachesed hammityacheset layyad haggedola, vehaven:

Vekiddashta. perush, bemaase hakkarbanot, keamro "veze asher taase lahem lekaddesh otam" (Shemot 29:1). vetaam shehizkir haddavar kan, lomar shello yekaddesh otam ad sheyyakdim laasot hallevisha vehammeshicha, vehaven:

rashi: Mattan adam yarchiv. kifshuto, umidrasho (Bamidbar Rabba 13:17): benotne tzedaka medabber, shemarchiv lo chelko leatid lavo, vegam bechayyav lifne gedolim yanchennu, veomrim alav shehu chashuv:
targum: Mohavteh devar nasha meravcha leh ukedam ravreve mekima leh:

rashi: Tzitz. kemin tas shel zahav haya, rochav shete etzbaot, makkif al hammetzach meozen leozen:
ohc: Kodesh laAdonai. mashma shekkol metziut sheyyichtov "kodesh laAdonai" kasher. uma sheamru baggemara (shabbat 63:) shehaya katuv shene shitin yod hei lemala, "kodesh laAdonai" lematta – lo leikkuva. velaze timtza sham sheamar rabbi eliezer bar yose: ani reitiv beromi katuv alav "kodesh laAdonai" beshita achat vegomer, hare sheen haddavar meakkev, vaafillu letanna kamma eno meakkev. uvaze lo yikshe beenecha pesak rambam (hilchot keli hammikdash perek 9) yeuyyan sham.

rashi: Al haola. al haayil harishon sheheelita ola:
Lereach nichoach. lenachat ruach lemi sheamar venaasa retzono:
Ishshe. leesh nittan:
LaAdonai. lishmo shel makom:
Choshen. tachshit keneged hallev:

Veefod. lo shamati velo matzati babbarayta perush tavnito, velibbi omer li shehu chagora lo meachorav, rachbo kerochav gav ish, kemin sinar shekkorin paveratzeynet belaaz, shechogrot hassarot kesherochvot al hassusim, kach maasehu millematta, shenneemar vedavid chagur efod bad, lamadnu shehaefod chagora hi; vei efshar lomar sheen bo ella chagora levaddah, shehare neemar vayyitten alav et haefod veachakka vayyachgor oto becheshev haefod vetirgem unkelos behemyan efoda, lamadnu shehacheshev hu hechagor vehaefod shem tachshit levaddo; vei efshar lomar sheal shem shete hakketefot shebbo hu karuy efod, shehare neemar shete chitfot haefod, lamadnu shehaefod shem levad vehakketefot shem levad vehacheshev shem levad, lechach ani omer sheal shem hassinar shel matta karuy efod – al shem sheofdo umekashsheto vo – kemo shenne vayyepod lo bo, vehacheshev hu chagur shellemala hemennu vehakketefot kevuot bo. veod omer li libbi sheyyesh reaya shehu min levush, shettirgem yonatan vedavid chagur efod bad (Shmuel 2 6) – kardut devutz, vetirgem kemo chen meilim kardutin, bemaase tamar achot avshalom, ki chen tilbashna venot hammelech habbetulot meilim (sham 13):
Meil. hu kemin chaluk, vechen hakkuttonet, ella shehakkuttonet samuch livsaro umeil karuy chaluk haelyon:

Tashbetz. asuyin mishbetzot lenoy, vehammishbetzot hem kemin gummot haasuyot betachshite zahav lemoshav keviat avanim tovot umargaliyyot, kemo shenneemar beavne haefod musabbot mishbetzot zahav, uvelaaz korin oto kashetavenash:
Mitznefet. kemin kippat kova, shekkorin kavepaya belaaz, shehare vemakom acher kore lahem migbaot umetargeminan kovain:

Veavnet. hi chagora al hakkuttonet vehaefod chagora al hammeil, kemo shemmatzinu beseder levishatan vayyitten alav et hakkuttonet vayyachgor oto baavnet vayyalbesh oto et hammeil vayyitten alav et haefod:
Vigde kodesh. mitteruma hamekuddeshet lishmi yaase otam:
ohc: Veelle habbegadim vegomer. kashe lamma lo mana hakkatuv ella shishsha begadim vehishmit tzitz hakkodesh umichnasayim? veulay shermazam hakkatuv shenehem, hatztzitz remazo befasuk shellifne ze veasu et bigde aharon lekaddesho, shello haya nitzrach lomar ella "veelle habbegadim" vegomer, ella nitkavven el hatztzitz shello hizkir befasuk "veelle habbegadim". velaze amar "leaharon" velo hizkir levanav ki lo nitkavven ella al hatztzitz. veamro leshon rabbim letzad shehu levaddo lo yoil ki shemona begadim meakkevin ze et ze, lachen amar alav leshon rabbim. uvaze yeduyyak gam ken amro veelle shennire kemosif al begadim acherim, letzad shekkevar kadam vetzivva al ketzat, velo hutzrach levaer ki samach al ma sheatid hu lefartam echad echad, uvifratan timtza mevoar haramuz. ucheneged hammichnasayim, achar shehizkir "elle habbegadim" vegomer amar veasu vigde kodesh leaharon achicha ulevanav, ufasuk ze meyuttar hu, lomar al hammichnasayim, velaze hizkir aharon uvanav ki hammichnasayim tzerichin ben lechohen gadol ben lechohen hedyot.

Venishar ladaat lamma lo sidderam hakkatuv yachad im hashshishsha velo haya tzarich lechol ze. veulay shene devarim ellu enam begeder echad im hashshishsha: hatztzitz letzad maalato yoter mishshelosha bigde kohen gadol, velaze hikdimo bifne atzmo, vehammichnasayim letzad heyotam behaderaga pechuta mishshelosha bigde kohen hedyot, velaze icharo bifne atzmo, vehashshishsha hem haderaga shava.

Od nire taam asoto kacha, shennitkavven lomar shetztzarich laasot bigde kehunna lishman, laze perat bappasuk veasu vigde kodesh shepperashnuhu bammichnasayim, veamar leaharon achicha ulevanav lechahano li, perush shetztzarich laasotam leshem aharon lesharet lifne Adonai, umizze tilmod lishar begadim. uvefasuk rishon shepperashnu batztzitz amar lekaddesho vegomer, ki millevad sheyyaasehu leshem kehunna od yosif lichtov bo "kodesh laAdonai".

rashi: Bene nechar. shennitnakkeru maasav leaviv shebbashshamayim, zehu meshummad; vehem arle lev (zevachim 22:):
Vearle vasar. kohen shemmetu echav mechamat mila:
targum: Beaytayutechon bene ammaya rashie libba vearle visra lemeheve bemakdeshi leafasa yat azarati bekarivchon yat kurebani terav vedam nichsat kudeshin veashniu keyami al kol toavatchon:

rashi: Paamon zahav verimmon paamon zahav verimmon. etzlo:
Divre nirgan kemitlahamim. mahalumot:
targum: Miloy deshigusha marchenan leh umachatan leh leomek dishyol:
