Pumeh desichla shatzya hu leh vesifvateh pacha inun lenafsheh:
Vaamar li bar adam kidnan amar Adonai elohim ilen gezerat madbecha beyom itabbedute leasaka alohi alata ulemizrak alohi dam nichsat kudeshaya:
Machazir pitgama ad la shamea shatyuta leh uvahatta:
Zakkay hava kadmaa vedineh vaata chavreh unetziach leh:
Veaalani orach tera tzippuna dikodam beta vachazet veha itmele yekara dayya yat bet makdesha dayya veishtatchet al appay:
Shava yomin yechapperun al madbecha veyidkun yateh veyakrivun kurebaneh:
Kodam tavra yitroram libbeh degavra ukedam yekara invetanuta:
Vetikrevinun kodam Adonai veyittenun kahanaya alehon milcha veyiskun yathon alata kodam Adonai:
Da orayta deveta al resh tura kol techume sechor sechor kodesh kodshaya ha da orayta deveta:

Vaamar li Adonai bar adam shavi libbach vachaze veenach uveudenach shema yat kol daana memalel imch lechol gezerat bet makdesha dayya ulechol dachaze leh uteshave libbach lemaalane veta vechol mafkanay makdesha:
Vetemar leama sarvana lidvet yisrael kidnan amar Adonai elohim sagi lechon mikkol toavatchon bet yisrael:
Vaatev yati orach tera makdesha varaa diftiach lemadincha vehu achid:
Libba demitbayen nikne yediata veudna dechakkime tive mandea:

bart: Nivle hashshara. nevalim shemmeshorrim bahem. leshon nevel vechinnor:

Temein. shehannevalim vehakkinnorot chalulim hem umenukkavim letzad hannimin lehashemia kol hanniggun, vederech hamenaggenim lehanniach betochan hammaot shemmekabbetzin mibbene adam habbaim lishmoa, vehave leh mittaltel male verekan:
Nivle vene levi. hammenaggenim al hadduchan:
Tehorin. sheenan asuyin latet betochan maot, veen asuyin lekabbel:
Kol hammashkin temein. kol echad mishshiva mashkin, shehen, mayim yayin shemen devash chalav dam tal, mekabbelin tuma, umachshirin hazzeraim lekabbel tuma:
Umashke vet matbechayya. hammayim vehaddam shebbevet hammitbachayim shebbaazara:
Tehorin. shehem enam mekabbelin tuma, velo machshirin hoochalim lekabbel tuma:

Kol hassefarim metammein et hayyadayim. lefi shebbitchilla hayu matzniim ochalim shel teruma etzel sefer tora, deamre hay kodesh vehay kodesh, kevan dechazu dekaatu sefarim lide feseda, shehaachbarim shehayu metzuyin etzel hoochalim hayu mafsidim otan, gazru sheyyihyu hassefarim kol kitve hakkodesh poslim et hatteruma vemaggaan, vegazru od shehayyadayim hannogot bassefarim yihyu sheniyyot lattuma ufoslot et hatteruma:
Missefer haazara. sefer tora shekkohen gadol kore vo beezrat nashim beyom hakkippurim. delekka lemechash shemma yasimu ochalim shel teruma etzlo, mippene morao vachashivuto:
Markof. sus shel etz sheosim halletzanim lirkov alav letzachek bo:
Habbatnon. keli niggun gadol, shehamenaggen bo somcho al bitno. vekorim lo belaaz 310:
Hanniktemon. min keli shel niggun asuy betzurat regel shel etz sheose mi shennechtecha raglo:
Vehaerus. asuy kemin nafa sheddafnoteha agullot veshotchin al piv or dak, umakkin alav bemakkel umotzi kol tzalul. uvelaaz 263:
Tame moshav. im yashav alav zav vezava nidda veyoledet, naase av hattuma letamme adam letamme vegadim. dichli hameyuchad lishiva hu:
Shehaallayit. kelomar hamekonenet umeyallelet yoshevet alav, lefi shergilin lispod ulekonen al yede niggun shel oto cheli. vechen hamminhag hayyom beartzot hayyishmeelim:
Allayit. leshon eli chivtula chagurat sak (Yoel 1). veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Metzuddat hachulda temea. sheyyesh aleha tzurat keli. ma sheen ken limtzodat achbar:
Vehappin. shinnayim shel mafteach shebbahen potchim haddelet. vetzurat ze hammafteach yadua bemalchut mitzrayim uvechol eretz yisrael:
Afillu achat temea. veaf al gav dehashshinnayim bifne atzman belo fotachat tehorim, kevaan bappotachat temeim, mikkol makom hashshinnayim chashuvim ikkar vehappotachat meshammeshet:
Almog. 347 belaaz, vehu tzomeach bimtzulat yam, utechillato rach kodem sheyyakpiehu haavir, umefattechim bo chotam. uvammikra, atze almuggim:
Hashshen shebbattas. lo dame lefin shel potachat, shehashshen meshammeshet bifne atzmah, ma sheen ken befin, hilkach temea bifne atzmah:
Rabbi shimon omer en sachin. kasavar lo nittan shemen shel maaser sheni lesicha ella laachila bilvad:
Im hekel bitruma. sheatta mode demutteret besicha, keditnan beferek shemini dishviit vechen bitruma vechen bemaaser sheni, velo ka miflagat bitruma:
Shehekel becharshinin uvetiltan. shel teruma yoter mibbemaaser sheni, kidvainan lememar lekamman, hilkach din hu nammi shennakel besicha gabbe teruma. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Rachat. shezzorim bah tevua vekitniyyot. baaravi 244, uvelaaz 112:
Haggarosot. haosim gerisim shel pol:
Temea. lefi sheyyesh lah bet kibbul vaasuya lehachenis bah larechayim:
Veshel otzarot. asuya lilkot bah hachitta shehi min hatztzedadim mikkan umikkan. ulenakkotah shettityashshev baotzar:
Veshel gittot. lehashelich hachartzannim vehazzagin chutz min haggat:
Lechinnus. mimmekom pezuran, aval lo lekabbel betocho:

Vechen haishsha shennatna reshut lishluchah. itzterich tanna leashmoinan beav sheasa shaliach lekaddesh et bitto uveishsha sheasta shaliach lekaddesh et atzmah. dei ashmoinan beav, hava amina av dekim leh beyochasin, ucheshemmatza meyuchas ze kiddeshah lo, hu deamrinan devittel et hashshaliach, aval itteta dela kim lah beyochasin af al gav dekiddesha et atzmah lo samcha al kiddusheha velo vittela et hashshaliach, desavra dilma mashkach shaliach adam meyuchas mizze. vei ashmoinan bedidah, hava amina mishshum deitteta dayka uminnasva, ki kiddesha atzmah bittela et hashshaliach, aval av delo kafed al bitto im tinnase levaal kol dehu, lo vatteleh lishlichut deshaliach, vehay dekadim vekiddeshah, savar dilma lo mashkach, tzericha:
Charirah. kemo chorah. hachor shemmachnisin bo hachut:
Uktzah. harosh hachad shemmachnisim babbeged keshettofrin. kemo uktze teenim, shehu hachod shebbatteenim:
Im hitkinah lemittuach. derech haorgim shellokchim machat shevura venotnim otah bisfat habbeged kede sheyyimmatchu siftoteha:
Machat shel sakkaim. machat gadol shettofrim bo hassakkim haasuyim missear izzim, vechayyotze vahen min habbegadim haggassin:
Shehu chotev bah. befinkas shel shaava:
Shel mittuach. im hitkinah limtoach bah sefat habbeged kederech shehaorgim osim:
Ben kach uven kach temea. shehare hi reuya limtoach belo uktzah uvelo charirah:

Im meakkevet et hattefira. sheeno yachol litpor bah mippene hachaludda. veyesh mefarshim, dechol zeman sheroshem hachaludda nikkeret babbeged, hayenu ikkuv hattefira, tehora, dehachi mashma beferek bamme behema [shabbat daf nov]:

Tzinnora. mazleg katan akom berosho, uregilin lehappech bo vasar al gabbe gechalim. veyesh mehen ketannim shemmochatin bahen petilot umekannechim bahen nerot. uchesheppeshatah have chemachat shennittal charirah veuktzah, utehora:

Ma shellikket likket lemaaser. kol ma shemmelakket hakkol lemaaser, ad sheyyashlim deme maaser. veyatne veyomar, im kol ma shellikkatti hem meot maaser mutav, veim lav otam shel maaser shennisharu yihyu mechullalin al ellu:
Veim balal vechafan. veim lo likket otan echad echad mikkan umikkan, ella shehayu velulin umeoravim velikket otam melo chafnav:
Lefi cheshbon. sheim laze mane velaze matayim, noten leze shel mane shelish uleze shel matayim shene shelishim:
Kele mattachot. shennitroau venishberu:
Kamma hu shiuran. kamma yihye shiur hashshever hannishar mehen veyikkare ose meen melachto veyihyu chashuvim kelim littamme:
Mecham. shemmechammemin bo mayim. vehu gadol mikkumkum:
Kede lekabbel selaim. shekkol sela arbaa dinarin:
Halleves. it degarse hallefes. vehu cheli nechoshet gadol shemmartichim betocho mayim venotnim bo kitonot ketannim lehadichan betocho:
Kullan bifrutot. kullan meshaarim im yesh bashshever shellahen kede lekabbel perutot. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Hamechussar hagafa tame. rabbi akiva mayre bitchillat asiyyatan shel kelim, vekaamar, dechelim hamechussarim hakkissuy shellahen, temein, demikkeru nigmera melachtan. hagafa, milleshon yagifu haddelatot (Nechemya 7). veharebe yesh bammishna, kede sheyyiftach veyiggof vetiggov. af al pi sheggafan lo kana divmassechet maser sheni [83 52], perush, shekkissa otan bimgufa:
Umechussar letisha tahor. shehu chashuv galme chele mattachot sheenan mekabbelin tuma. letisha, leshon lotesh kol choresh nechoshet uvarzel (Bereshit 4):
Aruvot shel nachtomim. luchot shehannachtomim orchim alehen et hallechem. veit sefarim degarse arevot:
Temeot. lefi sheasuyin betzurat keli. veaf al gav difshute chele etz ninhu, temeot middivre sofrim:
Shel baale vattim tehorot. sheen alehen tzurat keli:
Serkan. yippan bisrikon. vehu shashar bilshon mikra. umashoach bashshashar (yirmeya 22). baaravi 346. uvelaaz 116:
Kirkeman. tzevaan becharkom:
Daf shel nachtomin. daf shel mattechet. deillu daf shel etz, peshute chele etz en mekabbelin tuma. veaf al gav detame midderabbanan, keshekkevao vakkotel tahor ledivre hakkol:
Rabbi eliezer metaher. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Serod. hi sereda ditnan leel bechamma duchete. vehi areva ketanna shehannachtom mishtammesh bah. kedimtargeminan et bigde hasserad (Shemot lo) yat levushe shimmusha:
Gippefo. asa lo misgeret saviv. targum vaychabbek, vegappef:
Im hitkino. lasserod shel baale vattim:
Lihyot koretz alav. kelomar lachtoch alav habbatzek. leshon mechomer koratzti (Iyov 33):

Tame. disvira leh lerabbi shimon, mippene ma serod shel nachtomim tame, mippene shekkoretz alav et habbatzek umolich alav mikratzot lattannur, veshel baale vattim nammi im hitkino lihyot koretz alav et habbatzek uleholich alav mikratzot lattannur, tame. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Kesuy teni shel mattechet. shel baale vattim, tahor, kedivre chachamim diflige aleh derabban gamliel leel beferek 12 [mishna 6]. veim merko velittesho veasa mimmennu mara: rabbi yehuda metaher. disvira leh mara lo meshavve leh mana:
Vachachamim metammein. demara meshavve leh mana. vahalacha kachachamim:
Beav hattuma. sheretz unevela vechayyotze vahen:
Bivlad hattuma. hay velad hattuma ditnan bematnitin lav velad hattuma shennaga beav hattuma, shehu tame middeorayta, ella bivlad hattuma derabbanan, kegon shennaga bechelim shennitmeu vemashkin:
Yippade. demaaser sheni shennitma podin oto afillu virushalayim, dichtiv (Devarim 14) ki lo tuchal seeto, veen seet ella achila, kedichtiv (Bereshit 43) vayyissa masot meet panav alehem:

Veyeachel hakkol bifnim. shello yomru rainu maaser sheni shennichnas lirushalayim veyatza, mippene sheyyesh kol lammaaser hayyotze. aval en lachush kesheppodim oto shemma yomru rainu maaser sheni shennifda virushalayim, sheen kol lappaduy:
Chutz mishshennitma beav hattuma bachutz. shekkevan shennichnas keshehu tame en hammechitztza kolatto:

Chutz mishshennitma bivlad hattuma bifnim. aval nitma vivlad hattuma bachutz, af al pi shebbivlad hattuma shel divrehem nitma umin hattora tahor hu, yeachel bachutz. uvayrushalmi moke la kegon shehichniso al menat shello yikletuhu mechitztzot, aval im lo hitna, hoil venichnas vahare hu tahor deorayta, yeachel bifnim:
Al yede oro. im oro:

Rabbi shimon omer yippade. uveha kamiflege, detanna kamma savar en podin et hakkadashim lehaachilan lakkelavim, verabbi shimon savar podin et hakkadashim lehaachilan lakkelavim. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Lekacho chay ushechato venitma yippade. hacha lo faleg rabbi yehuda kidfaleg leel beferot hallekuchim bechesef maaser venitmeu, dechevan dilkacho chay en lo richuk makom, lefi sheyyachol leholicho bechol makom sheyyirtze, hilkach have kemaaser sheni atzmo, venifde keshennitma kederech shennifde maaser sheni keshennitma:
Rabbi yose omer yikkaver. demachmir tefe merabbi yehuda, vesavar deaf al pi shekkenao chay dino keferot hallekuchim bechesef maaser:
Lekacho shachut venitma hare hu cheferot. vechi hechi deifligu tanna kamma verabbi yehuda leel beferot hallekuchim bechesef maaser, hachi nammi ifligu veha:

En bodkin min hammizbeach ulemala. hitchil livdok baimmahot umatza sheavi aviha shimmesh al gabbe hammizbeach, en tzarich livdok achar em avi aviha, dechevan divnah shimmesh al gabbe hammizbeach beyadua shemmeyuchas haya:
Velo min hadduchan ulemala. im matza shehaya meshorer al hadduchan:

Velo min hassanhedrin ulemala. vedavka min hassanhedrin shebbirushalayim, vaafillu meotan sheddanin dine mamonot bilvad, shello hayu maamidin min hassanhedrin birushalayim ella chohen velevi veyisrael meyuchas, shenneemar (Bamidbar 11) vehityatztzevu sham immach, bedomin lecha beyachas uvechachma:
Vegabbae tzedaka. kevan deminnetzu bahade enashe, shemmemashkenin al hatztzedaka vaafillu beerev shabbat, i hava vehu milleta, kala hava lehu:
Baarchi yeshana shel tzippori. besanhedraot shel ir sheshshemah yeshana, hassemucha letzippori:
Archi. sanhedraot shehayu orchin umesadderin hayyuchasin:

Beisteratya shel melech. bachalukkat chodesh bechodesh latzet lemilchemet bet david mishpacha felonit bechodesh peloni. velo hayu yotzim lammilchama ella meyuchasin, shettehe zechutan uzechut avotan mesayyeatan:
Kol haasurim lavo vakkahal. af al gav ditninan la baresha mamzere unetine vechulei‏ muttarim lavo ze vaze, ha kamashma lan kegon ger ammoni umoavi im mamzer shetuki vaasufi:

Rabbi yehuda oser. mefaresh baggemara dehachi kaamar, afillu rabbi yehuda sheoser ger bemamzeret, hane mille ger shel shear nachrim shemmuttar lavo vakkahal hu deasur bemamzeret lerabbi yehuda, disvira leh kehal gerim ikkere kahal, aval ger ammoni umoavi sheasur lavo bakkahal mode rabbi yehuda shemmuttar bemamzeret:
Vaddaan bevaddaan muttar. kegon mamzere bintine:
Vaddaan bisfekan. mamzere unetine bishtuke vaasufe:
Sefekan bisfekan. shetuki vishtukit, vaasufi baasufit, vaasufi vishtukit. af al pi shezze safek veze safek, asur, shemma ze chasher veze fasul. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Kuti. have sefekayhu lefi sheen bekiin betorat gittin vekiddushin. vehaidna asaum kenachrim gemurim lechol divrehem:
Bat chalal zachar pesula min hakkehunna leolam. bat beno o bat ben beno, ad sof kol haddorot. aval bat bitto miyyisrael keshera lakkehunna, devat chalal atzmah miyyisrael keshera lakkehunna:
Bat ger zachar. afillu miyyisreelit, pesula lakkehunna chevat chalal zachar:
Hammashil kankannim lemaaser sheni. mi shemmashil kankannav lehachenis bahen yayin shekkara lo kevar shem maaser sheni:
Af al pi sheggafan. shessatam pihen bimgufa achar shemmillean:
Lo kana maaser. lo nitpas hakkankan bikdushshat maaser:
Zalaf letochan setam. shehichnis letochan yayin shel tevel kodem shekkara lo shem maaser:
Ad shello gafan. im kara lo shem maaser kodem shessetaman bimgufa:
Im mishsheggafan. im leachar shessetaman bimgufa kara shem maaser:
Kana maaser. nitpas hakkankan bikdushshat maaser, vetaun chillul kemo hayyayin, im ba lechallelo al hakkesef:

Olot beechad umea. beshel teruma ayre, im nitarev kankan shel teruma bemea kankannim shel chullin, velo haya fihen satum bimgufa, chashvinan lehu keillu kullan meoravot zo vazo, veolot beechad umea kedin teruma shennitarva vechullin:
Mishsheggafan mekaddeshot bechol shehen. vaafillu echad beelef enan olot, veyimmachru chullan lakkohen bidme teruma, chutz meachat shebbahen shennotlah hakkohen belo damim:
Ad shello gafan torem meachat al hakkol. dechashiv mukkaf:
En lokchin avadim vekarkaot. lefi sheenan ochel, verachamana amar (Devarim 14) babbakar uvatztzon veachalta sham:

Yochal kenegdan. keneged meot maaser sheni shehotzi baddevarim hallalu, yotzi mishshello veyikne davar shehu ochel veyochal bikdushshat maaser birushalayim. vehacha mayre keshebbarach hammocher, umishshum hachi lo tena yachzeru damim limkoman. i nammi matnitin ayre bemezid, aval shogeg yachzeru damim limkoman:

Kinne zavim vekinne zavot. shete torim o shene vene yona shechayyavin hazzavim vehazzavot lehavi. vekayma lan dechol davar shehu chova eno va ella min hachullin, sheen adam porea chovo bimot maaser sheni:
Mippene shehu memaet baachilato. ditruma asura litvul yom ulezarim:
Verabbi shimon mattir. desavar muttar lehavi kadashim levet happesul:

Ma im hekel bezivche shelamim. shekkonim shelamim bechesef maaser sheni, veaf al pi shemmemaet baachilato, sheyyecholin lavo lide figgul venotar vetame, lo nakel batteruma liknotah bechesef maaser sheni, sheen bah din piggul venotar velo din tame, shello chol haddevarim hametammein et hakkodesh metammein et hatteruma. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hammolich. davka avar veholich, dilchattechilla asur leholicho mimmakom lemakom, ella podehu vimkomo o maalehu lirushalayim:
Keshaar mekomo. keshaar hammakom shehu vishat pidyon, ben lekulla ben lechumra:
Hashshevach lashsheni. ma sheshshavin bair yoter, harevach shel maaser sheni. uma shehotzi lahavian min hassade lair yeshallem mibbeto:

Hakkaddumin. etz gadol aroch veyotzim mimmennu unkelayot elach vaelach, vetolin beotan unkelayot tzelochiyyot shel mayim baavir kede letzannenan. verambam peresh, kemin zer veunkelayot sevivotav uvo maalin hakkelim shennaflu labbor:
Haashkelonin. shennaasim beashkelon:

Hammaber vehammazre vehammagog. kelim asuyin lenakkot hattevua min hatteven ulehaavir hatteven mimmakom lemakom. hammaber yesh lo shinnayim vedome leyad shel bene adam, uvo maavirin hatteven mimmakom lemakom. vehammazre vo zorin hachittin baggoren, lefichach nikra mazre, veshinnav merubbot mishshinne hammaber. vehammagog, shinnav merubbot mishshinne hammazre, uvo vorrim hattevua achar shezzaru otah bammazre:
Davar chadash chiddeshu sofrim. reuyin hayu lihyot tehorim, difshute chele etz ninhu, umishshum shen achat shel mattechet lo nachata lehu tuma:
Veen li ma lehashiv. mippene ma amru chen:

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer kulei. massekinan baggemara shehabba limmalech morin lo kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov shello yissa chohen bat ger vegiyyoret. aval im nasa, halacha kerabbi yose, veen motziin otah miyyado, vezaro mimmenna kasher:
Teachel tzimchonim. keshehen yerakot lachin, velo yenichem ad sheyyigdelu velo yihyu reuyot laachila. aval bitruma teachel ben tzimchonin ben yeveshim:

Bet shammay omrim kol maaseha betohora. af al gav detiltan lav ochel gamur hu, veen teruma noheget bo ella lefi shenneechol liktzat bene adam, hilkach neechol betuma, mikkol makom levet shammay tzarich sheyyihyu kol maaseha betohora uvintilat yadayim, kedin kol shear ochalim shel teruma, shehannogea bahem tzarich netilat yadayim techilla, vetaama kede sheyyedu shehem teruma velo yeachlu lezarim:
Chutz mechafifatah. shebbelo netilat yadayim yecholim lachof bahen roshan. vechach haya darkan lachof roshan betiltan:

Kol maaseha vetuma chutz mishsheriyyatah. bemayim, shetztzarich lishrotan betohora. sheim shore otan belo netilat yadayim sheriyyatan machshiratan lekabbel tuma, vehu metammean miyyad beyadav. veasru ze bilvad mishshum hekker kede sheyyedu shehi teruma:
Malkot. or shemmesimin beene happara kede shettesabbev vetadush:
Hechasum. kemin metzoda ketanna shel chavalim shechosmim bah pi happara shello tochal:
Maddaf shel devorim. keli shemmesimim bo esh ugelale vakar umeashshenim kede sheyyivrechu hannechilim shel devorim min hakkavveret veyikkach haddevash. milleshon asher tidfennu ruach (tehillim 1):
Vehammenafa. keli shemmenifin bo vimot hachamma lehavi haruach:
Kufsa. kemin argaz katan shehaishsha notenet bo tachshiteha venotenet alav kesut millemala:
Kamtera. teva sheshshomrim bah habbegadim. al hammeltacha (Melachim 2 10), metargeminan al kumetra:
Vehammachbesh. [kol charash etzim] lefi melachto yesh lo makom shekkovesh veotzer haetz keshehu meuvvat veakom ad shemmeyashshero:
Vehakkimron. hammichse sheal hatteva heasuy keen kubba:
Angelin. nartik shel or sheosin lassefer umachnisim oto vetocho:
Bet hanneger. nartik shel or shennotnim betocho hanneger, hu hayyated shemmesimim achore haddelet:
Uvet hammanul. nartik shel or shennotnim bo hammanul shennoalim bo haddelet:
Uvet hammezuza. kane shel mattachot shennotnim bo hammezuza:
Vehaemum shel godle mitznafot. defus keen rosh shel adam shemmetakkenim alav hammitznefet:
Vehammarkof. kemin sus shel etz shehalletzanim mesachakim bo. veit dimfarshe, keli shel etz erez heasuy lezammer:
Ureviit shel allayit. uvimnaanim uvimtzaltzelin, metargeminan uvirviin uvetzeltzelin:
Shel allayit. shel hamekonenet. kemo (Yoel 1) eli chivtula chagurat sak:
Genognit heani. tarmilo shel ani:
Vesamochot hammitta. korot shessomchin bahen hammitta shello tippol:
Tefus shel tefillin. kemo defus shel tefillin:

Emum shel ose saggot. defus shel ose shalshelaot. sheosin otan al gabbe emum hayenu [al gabbe] defus. verambam gares, ose sutot, leshon uvedam anavim suto (Bereshit 49), vehu haddefus shel etz sheorgin alav habbegadim:
Meshammeshe meshammeshav shel adam. kegon kissuye chelim venartike chelim, shehem naasu leshammesh hakkelim hameshammeshim et haadam:

Bishat melacha veshello vishat melacha. bizman shehakkissuy meshammesh et hakkeli lishmor ma shebbetocho, vehayenu sheat melacha dideh, uchesheen kelum bakkeli sheeno tzarich lechissuy kare leh shello vishat melacha. veyesh kelim shemmannichim alehen hakkissuy tamid ben keshehu male ben keshehu rekan, af al pi sheen hakkissuy mechubbar bo, chashiv kakkeli gufeh lekabbel tuma afillu bizman sheeno mechubbar bo, kevan sheragil lihyot tamid alav. vehay kelala derabbi yose, appeshute chele etz hameshammeshin et hakkelim kae. aval kele kibbul, mittammein bechol inyan. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Magrefa. asuya ligrof et haefer min hakkira umin hattannur, ucheshehusera chappah nishar habbet yad shellah asuy keen kurnas shel nappachim, veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Megera. hi massor bilshon mikra. 74 belaaz:
Achat mibbentayim tehora. im nittal mikkol ben shete shinnayim shen achat, i efshar yoter ligror bah, hilkach tehora, delo chazya letashmishah:
Nishtayyer bah. min hashshinnayim hashshelemim shiur hassit bemakom echad:
Temea. hammegera, divoto melo hassit shehu shalem chazya ligror. veshiur melo hassit, kol ma sheefshar laadam leharechiv ben etzba laamma:
Maatzad. keli barzel shehecharash menasser bo hannesarim. 251 belaaz:
Izmel. taar katan shemmalin bo et hattinok. targum charvot tzurim, izmelin charifin:
Vehammafselet. barzel mechuddad kavua betoch etz, umolichin umeviin oto al halluach umachalikin oto. leshon pesal lecha:
Makdeach. keli shebbo menakkevim halluchot:
Shennifgemu. nitbakkeu:

Nittal chissuman. befi hacherev uvefi hassakkin uvefi hakkurdom uvechuddo shel makdeach notnim barzel tov venechshav, 128 belaaz, vechosmin pihen bo kede sheyyehe chad lachtoch yafe, veze karuy chissuman:
Veharukeni. haetz shehammafselet kevua vo karuy rukeni. veim nittal habbarzel shepposel umachlik venishar haetz levaddo belo habbarzel, tahor:
Yam nafa. yeria aruga missear lehotzi et hassolet naki min hassubbin. ulefi sheyyesh seviv hayeria zer shel luach gavoah, nikra yam, kemo sheyyesh seviv hayyam yabbasha:
Shel sillatim. borrim hassolet:
Godelet. haishsha sheggodelet vekosheret sear hannashim:
Mippene shehabbanot. hannearot beshaa sheggodlot roshan moshivot otan betoch yam nafa, lekabbel sham ma sheyyippol meroshan min haafrurit veirbuvita deresha. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haomer beni ze mamzer hu, eno neeman. dekarov hu etzlo, veen karov kasher lehaid:
Vaafillu shenehem. habbaal veishto. velo mibbaya keshehaav levaddo meid shehu mamzer, delo meheman, delo kim leh begavveh. ella afillu immo dekim lah begavveh, enah neemenet:
Afillu al ubbar shebbemeeha. shello haya leolam bechezkat kashrut:

Rabbi yehuda omer neemanim. taama derabbi yehuda dichtiv yakkir, yakkirennu laacherim. mikkan shehaav neeman lifsol et beno, veen haem neemenet al benah. vedavka al beno hu neeman, aval lo al ben beno, sheim hayu leven ze vanim eno neeman lefaslam. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Halleshachot benuyot bakkodesh. baazara:
Ufetuchot lachol. lehar habbayit:
Vegaggotehen kodesh. vehu shehayu gaggotehen shavot lekarka haazara, kegon shehayta hallishka beshippua hahar. sheim en gaggotehen shavot lekarka haazara, kayma lan daaliyyot vegaggot lo nitkaddeshu:
Tochan kodesh. lishchitat kadashim kallim, velaachilat kadshe kadashim, ulehitchayyev alehen mishshum tuma:
Haol hametzuppe. barzel, tahor, lefi shehu mattechet shemmeshammesh et haetz:
Ushefofarot. kemin shefoferet shel kane chalul regilin laasot mimmattachot lehashemia kol:
Vehaavar. oferet shennotnin betzad tzavvere behema lenoy:
Vehassovev shel galgal. galgal agala shel etz osim sevivoteha shel barzel shello yishshaver batterashim uvasselaim:
Tassin. luchot dakkot. pache hazzahav, metargeminan tasse dedahava:
Sandele vehema shel mattachot temein. lefi sheasuyin lishtot bahen anshe hachayil bammilchama:
Shaam. min gemi:
Hassayif meematay mekabbel tuma. besayif sheheela chaludda mayre, shehu tahor. umeematay mekabbel tuma:
Mishsheyyeshufennu. keli yesh letzorfin ulecharashe varzel shekkaruy hatztzorfim bilshon mikra, vetargumo shufina, uvo shafin umachalikin et hakkelim sheheelu chaludda lehasir chaluddatan:
Mishsheyyashchizennu. bammashchezet shello lehasir chaluddato:
Arba immahot. shetayim mitztzad haav ushetayim mitztzad haem:

Shehem shemone. arba min haav. vearba min haem. veellu hen, immah, em immah, em avi immah, em em avi immah, em aviha, em em aviha, em avi aviha, em em avi aviha. bodkim bahem shello haya veachat mehen min happesulot:
Veim hayta leviyya veyisreelit. vechohen ba lechansah:

Mosifin alehen od echat. em achat bechol zug vezug. kegon immah veem immah veim em immah, vechen kullam. veha devadkinan baimmahot velo vadkinan baavot shemma yesh pesul beaviha o baavi aviha, mishshum dederech haanashim keshemmegannim ze et ze mittoch ketata, megannin beyochasin, veim haya shum pesul mitztzad haavot haya yadua. aval hannashim en zo meganna et zo bifsul yichus ella viznut, vechi ikka vehu milleta vifsul yochasin let leh kala. velo neemra chiyyuv bedika zo ella bemishpacha shekkara aleha arar, aval mishpacha sheen bah chashad eno tzarich livdok, shekkol hammishpachot bechezkat kashrut hen omdot. vehaish bilvad hu shetztzarich livdok keshebba lissa ishsha mimmishpacha sheyyesh bah chashad, aval kohenet shebbat linnase enah tzericha livdok achar haish, shello huzharu kesherot linnase lappesulim, vechohenet mutteret lechattechilla lehinnase leger ulechalal, vechol shekken leviyya veyisreelit:
Bifnim. min hachoma:
Venote lachutz. lechomat yerushalayim:

Mikkeneged hachoma velifnim kelifnim. deven nof uven ikkar mikkeneged hachoma velifnim kelifnim, veochlin sham maaser sheni velo fodin. uven nof uven ikkar mikkeneged hachoma velachutz kelachutz, ufodin sham maaser sheni velo ochlin. vehayenu ditnan bemassechet maasrot perek 3‏ uvirushalayim holech achar hannof, kelomar af achar hannof:
Batte habbaddim. sheotzrim bahem shemen, uregilim hayu laasot battim hallalu bechomat hammedina:
Sheppitchehen lifnim. mechomat yerushalayim vachalalan chutz lechomat yerushalayim:
Mikkeneged hachoma velifnim kelifnim. veochlim sham maaser sheni vekadashim kallim, veen podin sham maaser sheni:
Mikkeneged hachoma velachutz kelachutz. veen ochlim sham maaser sheni vekadashim, ufodim sham maaser sheni:
Ravvak. panuy belo ishsha:
Lo yilmad sofrim. lo yargil atzmo lihyot min hassofrim, kelomar melammed tinokot, mippene immotehen shel tinokot shemmetzuyot etzlo lehavi et benehen el bet hassefer:
Af mi sheen lo ishsha. af al pi sheeno fanuy ella yesh lo ishsha veenah sheruya immo, lo yilmad sofrim. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Hakkenonin. kanon shebborrim bo kitnit. vehu naase mechariyyot shel dekel:
Kelatot. kuppot ketannot:
Sugim. kuppot gedolot:
Shene durim larochav shellahen. leachar sheargu shule hakkuppa, orgim sevivoteha iggulim kefi ma sherotze shettihye rechava vedafnoteha begavhah, veotan iggulim shel defanot keruyin durim:
Vechan shel moznayim. habbasis shennotnim alav hammoznayim:
Dur echad. mishsheyyagbiah al sefato iggul echad:
Shete tzefirot. shete sibbuvim:
Vehearak. sheen sefato gevoha kisfat hakkuppa:

Mishsheyyaase tzefira achat tame. vearak asuy mishshaam vearko yoter merachbo, keteva shel ratzanim. vekaruy arak. vead seroch naal (Bereshit 14), targum vead arkat mesana. umishshum dichle gemi veshaam din kele etz yesh lahem, hilkach teninhu gabbe hadade im kele etz:
Turemel. kis shel or gadol, sheharoe noten bo mezonot vechol davar. vedome lo, velo haroe vetarmilo:
Kichotav. misgerotav, kemin aznayim ketannot sevivot hatturemel, umachnisim beotan aznayim chavalim shessogrim oto:
Sekorteya. or shellovshim haabbedanim bishat melachtan:

Tzitzatah. keen tzitzit shel tallit, kach osin lah petilim al kenafayim lekashram bahen. verambam peresh, sekorteya or sheochlim alav, vetzitzatah, hu emtza haor shennotnim bo tas shel mattechet lenoy, leshon tzitz hazzahav, shehu tas shel zahav:
Tabbeoteha. tabbaat nechoshet o barzel shennotnim biktze hassekorteya:

Katavolya. or shemmatztziim al gabbe mitta. vekorim lo vaaravi 129, ufeshute chele or mekabbelim tuma midderabbanan bilvad, kifshute chele etz, vedinan baze shave, sheen mekabbelim tuma middeorayta ella midderabbanan bechol shear tumot, chutz mimmishkav umoshav, shehen naasim mishkav umoshav middeorayta keshehen meyuchadim lechach:
Hakkar vehakkeset. kar katan mikkeset, veasuy lehanniach tachat meraashotav. vecheset tachat kol gufo:
Pachot mechamishsha tefachim. meshayyerim mishshum petach lehachenis mishsham hammoch lemalleot hakkar vehakkeset:
Hassallim shel etz. meematay gemar melachtan:
Mishsheyyachsom. kesheadam ose kuppa o sal vegomer et sefato zo hi chasima:
Vikannev. leachar sheggomer hassafa, venishtayyeru kismin rashe kerumiyyot habboltin, poskan vekotman, vezo hi keniva:
Shel temara. sallim haasuyin mechariyyot shel dekel:
Shekken mekayyemin. belo keniva:
Kalkala. sal shel gemi:
Hatteloya. sheyyigmor hachevel shettole vah:
Bet halleginim. keli shemmannichin bo leginin lishmor:
Bet hakkosot. keli shemmatzniin bo kosot:
Vachachamim mattirin. vahalacha kachachamim. shello nechshedu yisrael al hazzachur:
Kol sheummanuto ben hannashim. shemmelechet ummanuto naaset lenashim, vehannashim tzerichot lo:

Lo yityached im hannashim. vaafillu im harebe nashim. lefi shellibban gas bo umechappot alav. veillu enash acharina im shete nashim tenan delo, shalosh vearba shappir dame. verambam peresh delo sharinan afillu mishshum kede chayyav lehityached im hannashim, hoil ufarnasato mehen:
Chammar gammal vesappan. kol ellu ummanut listut, keshellanin badderachim nichnasim veloktim etzim uferot min hakkeramim. veod shenniskarim livne adam umaavirin al tenaam:
Roe. [behemot shello] shemmaavir habbehemot lirot bisde acherim:
Chenvani. melummad beonaa, lehatil mayim beyayin, utzerorot bechittin. shechayyav adam lelammed et beno ummanut nekiyya:
Mefatteach umeare laggat. im ba litrom meachat al hakkol achar sheggafan, tzarich learotan laggat:
Veeno tzarich learot. desaggi lehu bifticha kiddemeikkara:
Bamme devarim amurim. deim leachar sheggafan kara shem, kana maaser et hakkankannim:
Bemakom sheddarkan limkor setumot. divchi hay gavna birushalayim hakkankan tefela layyayin, keditnan leel beferek kamma, hilkach bigvulin nammi kana maaser:
Aval bemakom sheddarkan limkor petuchot lo yatza hakkankan lechullin. birushalayim, hilkach [bigvulin] nammi lo kana maaser:

Aval im ratza lehachemir al atzmo limkor bemidda. hakkone yayin mimmeot maaser sheni birushalayim, ucheshebba hammocher limkor ratza ledakdek al atzmo veamar kach vechach yayin bemidda ani mocher lecha bechach vechach maot:
Yatza kankan lechullin. vaafillu hakkankannim setumot:

Hachi garsinan rabbi shimon omer af haomer lachavero yayin ze ani mocher lecha chutz mikkankannim yatza kankan lechullin. uvayrushalmi mefaresh la derabbi shimon kae aha ditna leel deim mishsheggafan kara shem maaser kana maaser. veashmeinan rabbi shimon davka shekkara shem maaser lechol hayyayin shebbakkankan, aval im amar kol hayyayin maaser chutz merviit, af al pi shekkeshebba limdod lachavero oto reviit, amar lo yayin ze ani mocher lecha chutz min hakkankan sheani rotze leshayyer bishvil maaser shebbetochah, afillu hachi lo naaset hakkankan tefela lammaaser, veyatza kankan lechullin velo kana maaser:
Haol shel mattechet tame. difshute chele mattachot mekabbelin tuma:

Katrav. shene etzim yesh, mitztzad ze min haol umitztzad ze min haol, vehen nekuvim, umachnisin betoch oto nekev etz ushemo katrav, vekoshrim oto shello yishshamtu habbakar. verambam peresh, shehakkatrav hu haetz shennimshach al shene tzedade habbehemot, vehaol beemtzao:
Vehakkenafayim. hem shene ketzavot shel katrav. milleshon al kanfe vigdehem. vehem shel barzel:

Hamekabbelot et hartzuot. kelomar, im naasu hakketzavot shel katrav lekabbel bahem et hartzuot, hen temeim, shechashuvin keli. aval im naasu lenoy, tehorim, lefi shehi mattechet hameshammeshet et haetz:
Vehabbarzel shettachat tzavvere vehema. koshrim al tzavvere vehema barzel kede shello techanek bachevel shekkoshrim bo hakkatrav:
Hassomech. yesh beemtza haol kemin tabbaat gedola uvo nichnas rosh hammachresha verosh haagala, veoto tabbaat karuy somech:
Machger. chevel shekkoshrim tachat tzavvar hashshor. veit degarse vehammasger, vehu yated [shel barzel] shennotnim biktze haol shello titavvet haagala mippene orech haol:
Tamchuyot. kemin kearot ketannot shel ol, ukeruyin tamchuyot:
Inbal. hu habbarzel hamekashkesh betoch hazzog:
Tzinnora. unkeli shettochavim bammasseoy shebbaagala shello yippol:
Umasmer hamechabber et kullam. kelomar, kol masmer shennaasa lechabber happerakin shel agala zo bezo. laafoke hammasmerim sheenan asuyin lechabber, ella lenoy. sheellu en metammein:
Mafteach shel arkubba. shemmitkappel kearkubba im hashshok, sheasuy chemin nun kefufa shellanu. verov maftechot shebbeeretz yishmael hem ken:
Rabbi yehuda metamme. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veshel gam. kemin gam yevanit shehi kemin nun hafucha:

Hayu bo chafin. keshennishbar mittoch gumo, nishtayyeru vo chafin o nekavin. chafin hem hashshinnayim. nekavin, shennichnasim bahen shinne hammanul, sheppeamim yesh bammafteach shinnayim vehen nichnasim benikve hammanul ufotchim, ufeamim yesh nekavim bammafteach umachnis otan nekavim beshinne hammanul ufoteach:
O sheppartzu ze letoch ze. shello nittelu hechafin velo nistemu hannekavin, ella sheppartzu, kegon shenneekmu hechafin venitrachavu hannekavin, shennogim ze vaze:
Mesannenet shel chardal. kemin nafa shel mattechet shehachardal natun bah umistannen vekoletet et happesolet:
Millemattan. beshule hamesannenet mishshennifretzu vah shelosha nekavin venaasu shelashtan nekev echad, tu lo chazya lesannen bah:
Afarkes. keli shel rechayim rachav millemala umetzer veholech millematta, venotnim bo chittim vehu motzi otam kima kima barechayim:
Miktzat banav temein umiktzatan tehorim. verotze sheyyishtu yachad mikkad echad, vehattemeim asurim beyayin hakkanuy bidme maaser:

Manniach et hassela veomer. ma sheyyishtu hattehorim min hayyayin, lichsheyyishtu tehe sela zo mechullelet alav meachshav. nimtza ma sheshshatu tehorim haya maaser uma sheshshatu temeim haya chullin. veeno chullin umaaser sheni meoravim ze vaze, sheen hayyayin kadosh bikdushshat maaser, ella lichsheyyishtu chozer hayyayin sheshshatu bilvad lihyot maaser lemafrea:
Hakkantar shel bannay. pershu bo shehu shevet umatte shel barzel shehabbannaim chotchim bo et hakkotel:
Haddakor. yated. kemo yachpor baddeker vichasse ditnan beresh perek kamma devetza:
Charash. naggar:
Yitdot ohalim. noatzim yetedot shel barzel baaretz umotchim ohalim vekoshrim metarim baytedot. veen ze tashmisho al yede karka, shehare ledavar hammittaltel hen meshammeshim:
Veyitdot hammashochot. modde hakkarka lachalukkat achim, noatzim yetedot bakkarka vekoshrim bo chevel umoddim:
Shalshelet shel mashochot temea. lefi shebbimdidat hachevel yesh avel. peamim shemmoteach laze yoter mizze, lefichach regilim laasot shalshelet limdod bah:

Asuya laetzim. likshor bah chavila shel etzim, o limdod bah etzim, sheyyesh mekomot shemmochrim etzim bemidda melo chevel. vehashshalshelet hameyuchedet lechach tehora, dehavya chemattechet hameshammeshet et haetz:
Arbaa tefachim. veyoter mikken la chashiv yad:

Chamor shel nappachim. haetz shehammappuach shel nappachim rochev alav nikra chamor. kach pershuha li rabbotay. uvemakom acher matzati shehu cheli varzel ketzurat chamor, vehaumman rochev al hakkatze haechad umakke al hakkatze hashsheni, veosim kach kesherotzim lehakkot al hakkelim haggedolim shessefatan gevoha ugedola meod:

Megera. hammassar shennosrim bah halluchot, shennitmet, veasa shinneha betoch hachor shel delet, lo yatza mide tuma, vahare hi temea kemo shehayta, ad sheyyikbeenna vaddelet bemasmer. vehachi meforash battosefta:
Asaah millematta lemala. shehafachah unetanah hafucha vechor haddelet:
Tehora. af al pi shello kevaah bemasmer:
Kol hakkesuyin tehorin. lefi sheen lakkissuyin shem bifne atzman:

Chutz mishshel mecham. vechol kayyotze vo sheyyesh lo shem bifne atzmo umishtammeshin bo bifne atzmo, kemo chissuy teni shel rofim ditnan leel perek tabbaat adam [mishna 3] detame ledivre hakkol, lefi shemmannichin vo sammanim:
Asara yochasin alu mibbavel. shehifrish ezra kol happesulim shehayu bevavel veholichan immo, kede shello yitarvu im hameyuchasin, meachar sheen sham bet din:
Chalale. kohanim shennoldu min happesulot lakkehunna, kegon almana lechohen gadol, gerusha chalalah zona lechohen hedyot:
Charure. avadim meshuchrarim:
Netine. givonim shemmalu bime yehoshua, veneesru lavo vakkahal:
Shetuke vaasufe. mefaresh lehu veazel:

Gere vacharure mamzerin kulei‏ kullam muttarin lavo ze vaze. dikhal gerim lo ikkere kahal, velo huzharu mamzerim lavo bikhal gerim. aval leviyye veyisreele bemamzere lo. ushetuke vaasufe safek mamzerim hem umuttarin lehitarev bemamzer vadday, deamrinan bekahal vadday hu delo yavo, ha vekahal safek yavo:
Shennigmera melachtan. lammaaser, keditnan beferek kamma demaasrot ezehu garnan lammaaser:
Veavru vetoch yerushalayim. beodan tevel:
Yachazor maaser sheni shellahen. dekasavar mattanot shello huremu kemi shehuremu damyan, ukelatuhu mechitztzot lemaaser sheni:
Veshello nigmera melachtan. kegon salle anavim laggat vechulei. aval salle anavim laachila nigmera melachtan:
Lammuktze. makom sheshshotchin bo teenim leyabbesh karuy muktze:

Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer vechulei. savar dilvet hillel mattanot shello huremu lav kemi shehuremu damyan. i nammi afillu kemi shehuremu damyan, hanne mile [leinyan] shear devarim, aval leinyan kelitat mechitztzot derabbanan, mekillin bet hillel. veen halacha kerabbi shimon ben yehuda, shello nechleku vet shammay uvet hillel ella al perot shello nigmera melachtan, kedivre tanna kamma:
Vehaddemay. tevel shel demay:
Nichnas. lirushalayim:
Veyotze venifde. chutz lirushalayim achar sheyyatza, veen tzarich lachazor. vehach sefa letanna kamma itzterich veallibba devet hillel:
Masrek shel pishtan. yesh lo shinnayim merubbot keen mechatim arukkim techuvim baetz, uvo sorkim happishtan:
Venishtayyer bo shetayim tame. im lo nishtayyeru vo ella shete shinnayim bilvad, tame hammasrek, deakkatti chazu limlachtan:
Achat achat bifne atzman temeot. kol shen vashen bifne atzmah shennittela min hammasrek, temea, dechazya lichtov bah befinkas shel shaava:
Veshel tzemer. masrek shel tzemer:
Achat mibbentayim. shemmikkol shalosh hassemuchot nittela haemtzait, tu lo chazi:

Hayta hachitzona achat mehen tahor. hashshen hachitzona shel hammasrek hi rechava veenah reuya lisrok bah, keen hachitzona shebbemasrek harosh shellanu, hilkach im hachitzona achat min hashshalosh shennisharu, tahor hammasrek, sheenah reuya lisrok bah sheen kan ella shete shinnayim:
Vaasaan lemalketet. lilkot bahen et hassear:
Vehitkinah lener. lehotzi vah happetila ulehetiv bah et hanner:
Ulemittuach. garsinan. kelomar limtoach bah sefat habbeged kederech haorgim [shettochavim] machat bisfat habbeged kede sheyyimmatchu siftoteha:
Patilya. kuppa asuya mimminim shel arava, veotzrim bah gerogarot:
Vachasina. kemin kuppa asuya mikkotzim, umesimin bah tit:
Sugeniyyot. leshon suga vashshoshannim, osin kemin kefifa ketanna min healim umechassim bah perot, veenah ella melechet aray:
Netzarim. mitztzure haddekel:
Chotal. keli sheosim mecharayyot shel dekel, umannichin bo temarim lachim vehen mitbashshelim betocho:
Noten letocho venotel mittocho. aval im eno yachol lehotzi hattemarim ella im ken yikraennu o yattir hachariyyot shello, tahor, dechevan dekoro o mattiro mashlicho laashpa, vehave letashmish aray:

Kol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veen avera. shekkiddushin tofsin bah veen avera venissueha. vehay kelala lav davka, shehare ger shennasa mamzeret yesh kiddushin veen avera, dikhal gerim lo ikkere kahal, veaf al pi chen en havvalad holech achar hazzachar, shehavvalad mamzer, echad ger shennasa mamzeret veechad mamzer shennasa giyyoret:

Vechol mi sheen lah alav kiddushin vechulei‏ havvalad mamzer. bivamot nafka lan mikkera dichtiv (Devarim 23) lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv, usemich leh lo yavo mamzer, umokminan la beshomeret yavam shel aviv, shehi eshet achi aviv shehi alav becharet:
Al achat mikkol haarayot. shel chayyave cheretot:

Velad shifcha venachrit. dichtiv beshifcha (Shemot 21) haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha, uvenachrit ketiv (Devarim 7) ki yasir et bincha meacharay, vemiddela chetiv ki tasir, shema minnah hachi kaamar, bittecha lo titten livno, ki yasir baal bittecha et bincha asher teled lo vittecha meacharay, aval abbitto lo tikkach livnecha lo mehaddar, sheen habben habba min hannachrit karuy bincha ella venah:

Mamzer shennasa shifcha. vaafillu lechattechilla yachol mamzer lissa shifcha kede letaher et banav. vahalacha kerabbi tarfon. umode rabbi tarfon sheeved shennasa mamzeret, havvalad mamzer, sheeved en lo yichus:
Hare at mekuddeshet li. bifruta zo al menat sheetten lach matayim zuz:
Veyitten. umishsheyyitten nitkaddesha lemafrea, dechol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dame:
Hare zo mekuddeshet veyesh lo. im yesh edim sheyyesh lo. veim lo noda sheyyesh lo, hare zo mekuddeshet missafek, shemma yesh lo umitkavven lekalkelah:
Veim herah al hashshulchan. shehaya shulchani veherah al hashshulchan maot sheenan shello, enah mekuddeshet:
Maot. shel maaser sheni:
Nichnasot lirushalayim veyotzot. sheen hammechitztzot koltot maot kederech shekkoltot perot:

Af happerot nichnasim veyotzim. vedavka lehotzian kede letachanan veleefotan ulehachaziran achar kach lirushalayim share rabban shimon ben gamliel, lefi sheyyoter hayu motzin litchon veleefot chutz lirushalayim mibbirushalayim atzmah. vetanna kamma asar nammi beha. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Kele etz. mishna zo shenuya lemala beferek 2, vahadar tanya hacha mishshum dina dichle etz uchele or devae leoruye vehu vehanach pirkin:
Hashshidda. kemin aron:
Vehatteva. tevat hashshulchanin:
Vehammigdal. bet haotzar shel etz. belaaz 458, uvaaravi 381:
Vechavveret hakkash. chashuva kichli etz, lefi sheasuya mizzanvot hashshibbolin shehen kashin:

Uvor sefina alekkesanderit. sefina gedola shepporshin bah layyam haggadol, keruya sefina alekkesanderit, lefi sheen porshim bayyam meeretz yisrael laalekkesanderiyya ella visfina gedola. umippene shemme hayyam meluchim veen reuyin lishtiyya, osim bisfinot gedolot keen bor shel etz umemalleim oto mayim metukin haruyin lishtiyya:
Sheyyesh lahem shulayim. sheen tachtehen chad millematta, ella rachav veyoshev al hakkarka:
Korayim. shishshim sea:
Beyavesh. kegon hattevua vezeronim uferot:
Tehorin. deittakkash kele etz uchele or, lesak hammittaltel male verekan, veze eno mittaltel male lefi sheggadol yoter midday, veim yetalteluhu male yishshaver:
Ben mekabbelim ben sheenan mekabbelim. ben shemmekabbelin yoter mearbaim sea, ben sheen mekabbelin ella pachot:

Dardur agala. chavit shel etz agulla asuya luchot, keen otan sheosin beeretz romi. veaf al pi shehi gedola, kevan shehi laagala, mittaltelet melea verekanit, desavar hay tanna tiltul al yede shevarim shemeh tiltul:
Vekustot hammelachim. kemin migdal shel etz asuy chadarim chadarim, shennotnim bo mine maachol vechelim shel mashke. vehammelachim molichin oto vaagala sheholchim bah:
Vaarevat haabbedanim. areva shel etz shehaabbedanim shorin bah orotehen:
Af al pi shemmekabbelin, temein. kelomar, af al pi shemmekabbelin arbaim sea o yoter:
Temein. kedimfaresh taama, sheen mittaltelim ella vema shebbetochan, keshehen meleim darkan littaltel:

Arevat baal habbayit. lerabbi meir temea, dehu tehorin kachashiv, lememra dehane davka tehorin, vehashshear temein. lerabbi yehuda tehora, derabbi yehuda temeim kachashiv, lememra dehane davka temein, vehashshear tehorin. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shennitarvu. verotze lehotzi shel chullin chutz lirushalayim:
Mevi vesela maot. shel nechoshet sheyyesh alehem tzura, sheshshavin sela shel kesef:
Uvorer et hayyafa shebbahen. shebbishne hasselaim, umechallel ellu hammaot aleha, vehassela hashsheni vehammaot nisharim chullin:
Middochak. keshehu dachuk veeno yachol laasot bederech acheret:

Velo sheyyitkayyem ken. sheyyishshaer hammaot shel nechoshet maaser, ella chozer umechallelam al hakkesef. vei kashya velamma mevi vesela maot, yikkach echad mishshene selaim shennitarvu veyomar im zo hi shel maaser mutav veim lav hare hashsheni shehi shel maaser mechullelet aleha. i sharet leh likkach achat mehen ulehatnot, chayshinan dilma ate lemishkal chad minnayhu belo tenay:
Mi shehayu lo maot. shel maaser sheni, vetzarich liknot mehem devarim shel chullin shello laachila ushetiyya vesicha:
Velachavero ferot. shel chullin, verotze laasot immo tova sheyyitchallelu maot maaser chavero al perotav:
Ochel perotav betohora. shechala kedushshat maaser al happerot, vetzarich leachlan betohora:
Velo yomar ken leam haaretz. shehu chashud leechol perot maaser betuma:
Ella vidmay. kegon im hayu otan meot maaser sheni shel demay, az muttar lomar ken afillu leam haaretz, deshemma hammaot enan maaser:

Kele mattachot mittammein umittaharin shevurim. kele mattachot shennitmeu vemet venishberu, vechazar veasa mehen kelim bo vayyom, shechazru letumatan yeshana, kevan shehizza alehen beodan shelemim venishberu, en tzarich lehametin lehazzaa sheniyya ad hashshevii, ella afillu veyom echad mazze shete hazzaot, achat kodem shevira veachat leachar shevira, vehen tehorin miyyad. derabbi eliezer kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira leh, deamar leel beferek 11 delo amru chazru letumatan yeshana ella lechelim shennitmeu vetumat nefesh bilvad, vetaam gezera zo mishshum geder me chattat kidfareshna leel, hilkach lo chashu ella sheyyehe kan shete hazzaot. umihu veodan shevurim lo mahane hazzaa, delo shaycha hazzaa bishvarim. uvae nammi shettehe shevira mafseket ben hazzaa lehazzaa, lefi sheyyesh hefsek yamim ben hazzaat shelishi lehazzaat shevii. velo ratzu lehachemir bachazarat tuma yeshana, shehi derabbanan, vehekellu shettoil bah hazzaa afillu shetehen hahazzaot beyom echad:
Rabbi yehoshua omer en hazzaa pachot mishshelishi ushevii. detakkun keen deorayta. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Chazyana. nohagim laasot berosh hammakkel kemin tappuach shel barzel vehu hannikra chazyana. vechol avde melech mitzrayim hayyom nosim beyadam maklot hallalu, vekorin lahem 103. ufeamim shennoatzim bahem masmerim kede sheyyakku bahem makka rabba vekasha:
Shelosha sedarim. shel masmerim, veaz chashuv keli. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Asaan lenoy. kegon sheasao vemasmerim dakkim metzuyyarim kede leyappot et hammakkel:
Tahor. dahave mattechet hameshammesh et haetz, ditnan leel shehu tahor. aval kesheasao lehakkot velachbot, hare etz meshammesh et hammattechet vetame:
Menikat. kemin shefoferet shel mattechet, vehichnis bah et hammakkel:
Vechen baddelet. tachat haddelet kede shello tochlenna haaretz:
Hayta cheli. hayta shefoferet zo keli bifne atzmah vechibberah lemakkel veachar shechibberah rauy lehishtammesh bah bichli:
Temea. mekabbelet tuma, utemea kemo shehayta:
Meematay hi tohoratah. menikat shennitmea meematay tithar vetetze mide tumatah:
Mishsheyyechabbel. mishsheyyashchitenna veyifchot tzuratah:
Mishsheyyechabber. mishsheyyechabberenna vaddelet o vammakkel veyikbeenna bemasmerim shello teshammesh od bichli, kevar batal shem keli mimmenna veyatza mide tumatah:

Umaot bammedina. umaot shel maaser sheni chutz lirushalayim vetzarich lahen, veka mashma lan sheen tzarich sheyyihyu happerot vehammaot bemakom echad. veod ashmuinan bematnitin deaf al gav deferot maaser en yecholin lippadot birushalayim, maot maaser mitchallelin hen birushalayim:
Happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim. shehaya machalif sela shebbeyado venotel perutot lehotzian letzarche seuddat maaser:
Bet shammay omrim. im ba lehachalif kol hasselaim shebbeyado bemaot, yachalif:

Uvet hillel omrim. lo yachalif ella chetzyan, shemma lo yishhe bair ad sheyyotzi et kullan veyafkidam bair ad regel acher, vehapperutot mitappeshot, veim yachazor veyachalifam bislaim nimtza shulchani mistakker shene feamim umaaser sheni nifsad:
Haddanin lifne chachamim. shimon ben azzay veshimon ben zoma vechanan hammitzri:
Bishlosha dinarin kesef uvedinar maot. hassela hu arbaa dinarim, ucheshebba lehachalif hassela lo yikkach ella vedinar echad perutot ushelosha dinarim yihyu chesef:
Reviit kesef birviit maot. bedinar revii shel kesef lo yikkach ella birviito maot shel nechoshet, ushelosha chalakim kesef. shennimtza lokeach maot echad mishshishsha asar besela bilvad:

Arbaa aspere chesef. haddinar chamishsha aspere, umatbea hu beeretz yavan vead hayyom korin lo aspero. nimtza hassela esrim aspere. ucheshehu mechallel haddinar yechallelennu al arbaa aspere chesef veasper echad nechoshet. nimtza lokeach nechoshet echad meesrim besela bilvad:

Yannichenna vachanut veyochal kenegdah. lo yechallel kelal al perutot, shemma yishkach veyaase otan chullin, ella yanniach hassela etzel hachenvani veyochal kenegdah ad shettichle. veen halacha ella chedivre vet hillel bilvad:
Vegerashtiha. kibbalti et gittah:
Vahare hi ketanna. achshav kesheamar aleha chach:

Neeman. lefaslah min hakkehunna. shehaav neeman al bitto kol zeman shehi ketanna, dichtiv (Devarim 22) et bitti natatti laish hazze, kesheamar laish, asarah al hakkol, sheen anu yodim lemi, keshechazar veamar laze, hittirah lo:
Vahare hi gedola. veim leachar sheggadla amar kach, uvekatnutah lo amar, eno neeman:
Nishbet ufeditiha vechulei‏ eno neeman. lefaslah min hakkehunna. divnissuin hemneh rachamana laav. lishvuya lo hemneh:
Yesh li vanim. veen ishti zekuka leyavam:
Yesh li achim. veishti zekuka leyavam. vead achshav hayta vechezkat sheenah zekuka:

En habbogrot bichlal. lefi sheenan birshut haav lekaddeshan. veaf al pi sheasaattu habbogeret shaliach lekabbel kiddusheha, amrinan lo shavek enash mitzva deramya aleh veaved mitzva delo ramya aleh. aval hakketannot vehannearot kullan tzerichot get missafek, delo yadinan ezo mehen kiddesh:

Vehukkar ubbarah, devarav kayyamin. katav harambam deen lo lavo aleha ad sheyyekaddeshenna kiddushin sheniyyim, sheen adam makne davar shello ba laolam. velo amru devarav kayyamim ella lehachemir aleha sheasura linnase laacherim:
Tikkaver al yede orah. im orah, lefi sheggam orah asur:
Kol tenay. sheeno chaful vechulei: eno tenay. veaf al pi shello nitkayyem hattenay nitkayyemu haddevarim:

Im yaavru veim lo yaavru. vei lo chafal haddevarim hayta mattenato kayyemet vehayu nochalim et eretz haggilad af al pi shello hayu ovrim. veaf al gav deamar im yaavru ittechem, let lan mikkelal hen atta shomea lav. veshaminan minnah nammi, devainan tenay kodem lemaase, middelo amar tenu lahem im yaavru, mashma dei hava amar hachi, lo ate tenaa umevattel maase demattana dekadmeh. ushema minnah nammi devainan hen kodem lelav, delo amar techilla im lo yaavru al tittenu veim yaavru unetattem:

Rabbi chanina kulei. attenay kaful paleg, deen tzarich lichpol, demikkelal hen nishma lav. veze shekkefalo moshe, tzorech haya haddavar. uleinyan pesak halacha, im amar al menat, en tzarich tenay kaful velo hen kodem lelav velo tenay kodem lemaase, ella hattenay kayyam. veim lo amar al menat, tzarich kol hane deamrinan. veim lav, hattenay batel vehammaase kayyam. velo shena bitnay shebbedine mamonot, velo shena bitnay shebbegittin vekiddushin, hakkol shave ledavar ze:
Ani kiddashtiha neeman. lechansah. delo chatzif lememar kammeh deav shekkibbel hakkiddushin, ani hu, im lo haya emet, demirtat dilma machchish leh:

Kiddashti et bitti gedola. itzterich tanna leashmoinan pelugta derabbi meir verabbi yose bekiddashti et haggedola uvekiddashti et hakketanna. dei ashmoinan bekiddashti et haggedola, hava amina, beha kaamar rabbi meir, dechevan deikka dezutera minnah, lehach "gedola" kare lah, deshevach hu laadam likrot bitto belashon gedola af al pi shehi ketanna, kesheyyesh ketanna lematta mimmenna. aval ketanna ema mode leh lerabbi yose dechol shehu yachol likrot otah gedola en kore otah ketanna. vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yose, aval behach ema mode leh lerabbi meir, lechach hutzrechu shetehen. vahalacha kerabbi yose vishtehen:
Eno tzarich lehavi reaya lo al haishsha. shehi meyucheset, shekkevar bedakah keshennesaah:
Velo al habbanim. bevanim ketannim shekkeruchim achare imman:

Haomer leishsha kiddashtich vechulei. itzterich leashmoinan beomer kiddashtich, uveomeret kiddashtani. dei ashmoinan beomer leishsha kiddashticha shehu asur bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav, hava amina dina hu delo mittasra ihi vikrovav, deihu shakkore ka meshakker, degavra lo ichpat leh im oser atzmo chinnam bikrovoteha, umeshakker veamar kiddashtich af al pi shello kiddeshah, aval ihi ki amra kiddashtani, deasra nafshah akkulle alma ad sheyyitten lah get, i lav dekim lah, lo hava amra, venittesar ihu al piha bikrovoteha, vaafillu yehav lah get. ka mashma lan:

Kiddashtich vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella vitti vechulei. mishshum dahava salka datin lomar meachar shehaav neeman al bitto min hattora, tihye haem neemenet al bittah midderabbanan, ka mashma lan deenah neemenet:
Bet kor. makom harauy lizroa kor, shehu sheloshim sein:

Veyesh lo. im yesh edim sheyyesh lo, mekuddeshet vadday. veim en yadua sheyyesh lo, mekuddeshet missafek, velo amrinan zuze daavide enashe dematznee chayyshinan dilma it leh umitkavven lekalkelah, aval ara lo chayyshinan dilma it leh, deim ita deit leh ara, kala it leh:
Veim herah babbika. sheenah shello. veaf al gav denachat bah lachachirut o lekabbelanut, enah mekuddeshet:
Kol keli etz. shulchan hakkaful. asuy chulyot o ferakim, uleachar shemmesirim oto koflim chulyotav o ferakav zo al zo, vechol chulya haveya keli bifne atzmah:

Vetamchuy hammiznon. keara gedola meod uvetochah kearot ketannot, venotnim bechol keara min hakketannot min echad shel tavshil. ulefi sheyyesh betochah minim harebe, nikra tamchuy hammiznon. targum lemino liznohi:
Efiforin. kisse shel perakim:
Hammages. targum keara megista:

Vekod habbavli. kemin keara shel etz. uleshon chachamim hu, bimkeda vezuya, perush keara vezuya. vechol hakkelim hallalu, af al pi shennechleku, nishar lechol chelek mehem tzurat keli. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Mishsheyyeshufem beor haddag. lehasir kismin shebbahem, dekodem lachen lo chazu limlachtan, shemmesartim et habbasar. aval im enan mechussarin ella shifa shel tzichtzuach umerika, ha kayma lan [chullin ko] degalme chele etz sheatid leshabbetz velashuf temein:
Gamar shello lashuf. sheggamar belibbo lehishtammesh bahem af al pi shello yashuf od:
Shelosha vattim. keshemmesargim hammitta vachavalim, ben kol chevel lechevel karuy bayit. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Shetuke. kol shehu makkir et immo. shekkore abba, veimmo mashtakto:
Beduke. shebbodkin et immo. im amra lechasher nivalti, havvalad kasher. vahalacha cheabba shaul:
Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni. mi sheyyesh lo meot nechoshet shel maaser sheni, uva lefartan besela kesef lehaalot lirushalayim mippene masseoy hadderech:
Bet shammay omrim bechol hassela maot. im ba lefartan yachol lifrot kullan velatet bishvil kol hassela:

Uvet hillel omrim. lo yifrot ella chetzyan, shehapperutot yotzot birushalayim, uchesheyyavo sham yihye tzarich lifrutot miyyad liknot tzarche seudda, veim yarutzu hakkol etzel shulchani lifrot yokiru happerutot venimtza maaser sheni nifsad. lefichach yisseu perutot immahen lehotzi bemiktzat, velichsheyyichlu yifrot bakkesef shebbeyado meat meat:
Shekel. hu chatzi sela:
En mechallelin kesef uferot al kesef. mi sheyyesh lo chatzi dinar kesef shel maaser uferot shel maaser shavin chatzi dinar, lo yetzarfam yachad lechallelam al dinar:

Vachachamim mattirin. bechi hay gavna al yede tzeruf perot, kevan sheen lo ella chatzi dinar kesef. aval lechallel dinar kesef uferot shavin dinar al chatzi sela shehu shene dinarin, modim chachamim sheen mechallelim. vahalacha kachachamim:

Kiddashti et bittech vechulei. ayyde detana lehane bave dilel, tana nammi leha, veaf al pi shehi mishna sheenah tzericha. uvechol hane dehi omeret kiddashtani, mevakshim mimmennu litten get kede lehattirah. veim meatzmo natan get, kofin oto litten ketubba:
Karshine. bilshon aravi 331, veenam maachal adam ella middochak bishnot reavon:
Venichnasim lirushalayim veyotzim. af al gav devishar perot kayma lan demaaser sheni hannichnas lirushalayim en yecholin lehotzio mishsham, becharshinin hekellu:

Yitchalleku leissot. veeno chishar maaser shennitma sheppodin oto vaafillu birushalayim, aval karshinim lefi sheenan maachal adam en podin otan, desavar rabbi tarfon en podin et hakkadashim lehaachilan lakkelavim, hilkach yitchalleku leissot tehorot shel maaser sheni veyasimu bechol issa veissa min hakkarshinim hallalu shennitmeu pachot pachot mikkabbetza, deochel pachot mikkabbetza eno lo mittamme meacherim, velo metamme acherim, vechacha yochlu otan:
Vachachamim omrim yippadu. kishar maaser sheni. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shorin. bemayim veshafin al habbasar betohora, bintilat yadayim, shessetam yadayim sheniyyot ufoslot et hatteruma:
Umaachilin. labbehema:

Yeachlu tzarid. leshon yovesh, kemo tzarid shel menachot [pesachim 20.] shehu makom shel hammincha shello higgia sham shemen. kelomar yeachlu yeveshim, shello yehe alehem mashke bishat achila, kede shello yihye nikkar shehuchsheru lekabbel tuma:
Kol maasehem betuma. vaafillu hashsheriyya. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni. perot shenniknu middeme maaser sheni:
Yikkaver. hoil venigmera mitzvato vekana ferot mimmeot maaser sheni, shuv lo yippade:

Shekken nifde tahor berichuk makom. shemmaaser sheni podin oto keshehu tahor chutz lirushalayim, kedichtiv (Devarim 14) vechi yirchak mimmecha hammakom vegomer. aval hallakuach bechesef maaser eno nifde chutz lirushalayim keshehu tahor, ditnan leel beferek kamma mezid yaalu veyeachlu vammakom. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Maaser sheni nittan laachila velishtiyya. dichtiv (Devarim 14) babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar veachalta sham, ushetiyya bichlal achila. vesicha kishtiyya dichtiv (tehillim kat) vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav:

Leechol davar sheddarko leechol. sheim kana bechesef maaser pat venitappesha, yayin vehikrim, tavshil venivash, en mechayyevin oto leechol davar sheen darko leechol kede shello yippasdu maot shel maaser sheni. i nammi bikkesh leechol teradin lachin chayyin o lachos chittin chayyot, en shomin lo, kevan sheen darkan leachlan kach:
En mefattemin et hashshemen. lasim betocho ikkarin verashe vesamim, mishshum devale hashshemen veazel leibbud, shehashsharashim enan neechalin:
Veen lokchin bidme maaser sheni shemen mefuttam. mishshum devainan davar hashshave lechol adam, veze eno ella limfunnakim velimunnagim:
Aval mefattem hu et hayyayin. laasoto yenumulin vechayyotze vahen:

Nafal. letoch yayin shel maaser sheni keshehu chutz lirushalayim devash utevalin vehishbiach, cholkin et hashshevach lefi cheshbon, kegon im hayyayin shave shete selaim udevash utevalin shavin sela vehishbichu veamdu al arba selaim, pode et hayyayin bishte selaim ushene shelishe sela:
Kaflotot. karti, 592 belaaz:
Hashshevach lashsheni. ufode et happat beshavyo, veen cholkin hashshevach laetzim shel chullin, ella kol hashshevach lemaaser sheni, lefi sheen shevach etzim nikkar bappat:

Kol sheshshivcho nikkar. sheshshevach hachullin nikkar bammaaser sheni, shehosifu hachullin al hammaaser bemidda uvemishkal, aval im lo hosifu ella battaam, af al pi shennitalla vedamim mechamat hattaam, en ze shivcho nikkar:
Lo yityached ish echad im shete nashim. mippene sheddatan kalla ushetehen nochot lehitpattot:

Aval ishsha achat mityachedet im shene anashim. shehaechad bosh mechavero. ufesak hahalacha, lo tityached ishsha achat im shene anashim, vechol shekken ish echad im shete nashim, ella im ken hayu shete hannashim tzarot o yevamot, o ishsha uvat balah, o ishsha vachamotah, o ishsha im tinoket sheyyodaat taam bia veenah moseret atzmah levia, lefi sheellu sonot zo et zo, umityarot zo mizzo, vechen hi mityaret min hakketanna shemma tire vetaggid. umalkim al yichud happenuya, veal yichud im haarayot, chutz meeshet ish sheen malkin aleha, shello lehotzi laaz al baneha. umuttar lehityached im habbehema veim hazzachar, shello nechshedu yisrael al hazzachur veal habbehema:

Higdilu zo yeshena vichsutah vechulei. vehu shettihye habbat mishshetem esre shana veyom echad, vehabben mishshelosh esre shana veyom echad. uvizman shehi bosha laamod lefanav arumma, afillu befachot mikken yeshenim hu bevigdo vehi vevigdah:
Kesaya. bet yad shel or:

Shel zore geranot veholche derachim veshel ose fishtan temea. dechevan dehi asuya kede leechoz haddavar beyado yafe shello yishshamet mimmennu, o chede shello yitchov lo kotz beyado, mikkere asuy lekabbala, kevan shehaddavar shehu ochez bo nishan al habbet yad umekabbelo:
Shel garosot. haosim gerisot shel pol barechayim:
Mippene hazzea. lishov et hazzea kede lehaker besaro shello yazzia. i nammi, shello tetannef zeat yadav haddavar shehu ochez bo:
Tahor. detashmish aray chashuv:
Kol hatteloyim. haasuyin lakkeli litloto bo:
Temein. dahavu chibbur lakkeli:

Kivrat geranot. asuya lehotzi hachittim veliklot hammotz, umannichim hakkevara al shene etzim umenahalin, ucheshehen yegeim machnisim yedehen batteloy shellah umenahalin, vehayenu dekatane dimsayyein bishat melacha:
Makkel habballashin. hamechappesin betoch hakkelim lirot im yesh bo davar sherauy litten mimmennu meches lammelech. targum vaychappes, uvelash:
Shehem mesayyeim bishat melacha. machnisin yedehem batteloy kesherotzim lehishtammesh bakkeli, umistayyeim bo laasot melachtan. vahalacha kachachamim:

Veeese immach kefoel. bifullat yom echad. velav dimkaddesh lah bischar peulla, dechevan dekayma lan yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof, nimtza chesheggamar peullato have sechiruto milve etzlah, vehamekaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet. ella dimkaddesh lah hasheta bifruta al menat sheyyaase achar kach immah kefoel:

Al menat sheyyirtze abba. baggemara mefaresh shello yimche abba, ucheshekkava zeman limchaato, kegon sheamar shello yimche abba kol sheloshim yom. hilkach ratza haav, sheavru sheloshim yom velo micha, hare zo mekuddeshet. lo ratza, shemmicha vetoch sheloshim, enah mekuddeshet:
Met haav. toch sheloshim, hare zo mekuddeshet, deamrinan man mache:
Met habben. betoch sheloshim, melammedim et haav sheyyimche, kede shello tehe zekuka leyavam:
Lo yomar. lechallek. shettittol chelek bahem. lefi shealav muttal lehavi maasro lirushalayim, venimtza porea chovo mimmaaser sheni:
Haalem shennochlem venishtem. denire demazmino leechol immo, veze muttar:
Aval notnim ze laze mattenat chinnam. meforash leel beresh perek kamma:

Lo yaase adam selaav dinre zahav. selaim shel kesef sheyyesh lo mimmaaser sheni lo yaase otam dinre zahav, shemma yashhe aliyyotav ad sheyyachalif selaav veyitbattel millaalot laregel. uvet hillel savre lo gazrinan:
